new_roles.title: Director of Quality Assurance
new_roles.description:
**About CAMP Systems:**
At CAMP Systems, we are the trusted leader in aircraft compliance and health management, proudly serving the global business aviation industry. With over 20,000 aircraft and 33,000 engines supported on our cutting-edge platforms, and partnerships with more than 1,300 maintenance facilities and parts suppliers worldwide, we’re shaping the future of aviation technology. Since our founding in 1968, we’ve grown to a dynamic team of 1,600+ employees across 14 locations globally—all united by a passion for innovation and excellence.

**Our Mission & Vision:**
We connect the aviation industry through smart technology to make flight safer and more efficient, driving the future of aviation with intelligence and exceptional customer experiences.

**Our Values & Excellence Mindset:**
We are customer obsessed, trust-driven, owners of our work, stronger together, constantly curious, and boldly innovative.

**What You Will Experience in This Role:**

The Director - Quality Assurance drives quality across CAMP's Aircraft Health Management business and provides quality oversight for data and process quality concerns. The role owns the QMS, the internal audit program, and the full quality escape lifecycle, and serves as CAMP's quality voice with OEMs, regulators, and key customers. The right candidate combines deep aviation maintenance knowledge with a disciplined, data-driven approach to compliance and continuous improvement.

This is a high-visibility leadership role reporting to the Vice President, Aviation Health Management Operations. The Director partners with senior leaders across a global organization and will build on an established quality program: strengthening the QMS, deepening OEM and customer confidence, and scaling quality practices as AHM grows.

**Responsibilities:**

**Strategy & Leadership**

* Own and lead quality strategy across the full Aircraft Health Management organization, spanning maintenance tracking and engine health monitoring services, aligned with CAMP's business objectives.
* Serve as the escalation point for quality complaints from customer-facing, maintenance compliance, engine health monitoring, flight scheduling, and inventory functions.
* Partner with senior management and departmental leaders to embed quality methodologies across the organization and lead the associated change management.
* Own the quality budget, resource plan, and tooling (QMS, audit, and corrective action platforms), and build the succession pipeline for the quality team.

**Quality Management System & Certification**

* Own the Quality Management System (QMS) and quality SOPs, driving continuous improvement and ensuring processes meet strict regulatory and OEM requirements.
* Maintain ISO 9001 (or higher) certification for the engine health monitoring business, serving as external certification audit lead and ensuring ongoing audit readiness.
* Lead QMS management review with executive leadership, setting risk-based quality objectives and ensuring consistent QMS implementation (document control, competency records, data integrity) across all AHM locations in North America, Europe, and India.

**Audit & Compliance**

* Own the internal audit program end to end, including audit planning, execution, reporting, and the selection, training, and management of internal auditors.
* Host and manage OEM, customer, and third-party audits, driving findings to timely closure.

**Quality Escapes & Corrective Action**

* Manage all quality escapes from intake through investigation, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action, and verification of effectiveness, with clear accountability to customers and OEM partners.
* Define and report corrective action performance metrics (e.g., escape rate, time to containment, on-time closure, recurrence) with clear thresholds and escalation paths.

**OEM & Customer Engagement**

* Facilitate and chair weekly, monthly, and quarterly strategic OEM meetings covering quality trends, KPI compliance, and corrective action status.
* Serve as primary quality liaison to OEM partners, regulatory bodies, and high-profile customers and large fleet operators under significant OEM contracts.
* Facilitate weekly, monthly, and quarterly quality reviews with senior management and functional leaders, translating escape, audit, and customer feedback data into trends and strategic quality initiatives.

**Continuous Improvement & Team Leadership**

* Lead process improvement using Lean Six Sigma methods, mentoring teams and driving measurable reductions in escapes, rework, and risk.
* Maintain an executive quality scorecard (customer feedback, escapes, audit results, corrective action performance) to drive data-based decisions.
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of four, setting priorities and fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and collaboration.
* Partner with AHM operations, training, and product leaders to ensure analyst competency, training effectiveness, and quality readiness for new products, processes, and teams.

**You have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Engineering, Quality Management, or a related field; advanced degree a plus.
* Minimum of 10 years of proven leadership experience in the aviation or aerospace sector, with senior quality assurance experience preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of aviation maintenance and its regulatory requirements (FAA, EASA, and OEM requirements). Hands-on aviation maintenance experience may offset formal credentials.
* Experience managing quality escapes, investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action programs.
* Experience owning or managing a QMS in a regulated environment, with working knowledge of ISO 9001 (AS9100 familiarity a plus).
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn quality data into executive-level metrics, insights, and recommendations.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to build relationships with OEMs, customers, and leaders at all levels of the organization.
* Strategic thinking with a strong focus on results and the ability to manage complex projects and initiatives.
* Ability to lead across a multi-site, multi-region team; willingness to travel to CAMP offices, OEM, and customer sites as needed.

**Nice to have:**

* Certified ISO 9001 Internal/External Auditor (or equivalent lead auditor certification) with hands-on audit experience.
* Six Sigma Black Belt, with demonstrated process improvement results.
* Quality manager certification (e.g., ASQ CQM) or Certified Quality Auditor (CQA) is a bonus.
* Experience working with large OEM contracts and high-profile customers or large fleet operators.
* Experience in aircraft maintenance tracking, engine trend monitoring, or other SaaS/data-driven service environments.

**Why Work at CAMP?**

Join a culture where your ideas matter, your impact is real, and your growth is supported. Be part of a team reimagining the future of aviation.

CAMP is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer - vets/disabled

CAMP is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. To request reasonable accommodation, please contact hr@campsystems.com.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status EEO.

Equal Opportunity Employer
 
 
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws.
 
For further information, please review the Know Your Rights notice from the Department of Labor.

new_roles.title: Director, Quality
new_roles.description:
At Ensign-Bickford Aerospace & Defense Company (EBAD), we believe that our strengths are built on our most important resource - our people. Join EBAD and you'll be a part of a team who creates cutting edge technology that will blast us into the future. No other company can match the innovative energetic solutions that we provide. At EBAD you will actively contribute to successful missions putting men, women and satellites into space, and protecting our armed service men and women around the world. If this is the culture and work environment you are seeking, then EBAD is the place for you!
 
 
**Job Description**
**Location:**
Simsbury, CT
 
 
**Reports to:**
VP of Operations
 
 
**Industry:**
Aerospace & Defense
 
 
**Experience Level:**
Director (15+ years)
 
 
**Shape the Future. Deliver Excellence. Achieve Zero Failure.**
At
**Ensign-Bickford Aerospace & Defense (EBAD),**
we’ve been innovating for nearly
**200 years,**
delivering mission-critical technologies that protect lives and advance exploration. As we prepare to double in size over the next 3–5 years, we’re investing in our people and culture to support this transformation.
 
 
We’re seeking a dynamic
**Director of Quality**
to lead a complex, multi-site quality organization and drive performance at scale. Based at our headquarters in Simsbury, Connecticut, this role is critical to ensure the highest levels of product integrity, compliance, and customer trust across a rapidly growing business. This is not just about maintaining standards but about building a future-state vision for quality that enables growth, safeguards mission success, and strengthens EBAD’s reputation as a trusted partner.
 
 
**The Opportunity:**
EBAD’s customers depend on us to deliver our products with zero failure in mission-critical environments. The Director of Quality will be responsible for developing and executing a strategic Quality Management System (QMS) while leading quality operations across multiple sites. This leader will be tasked with driving measurable quality improvement, while also championing a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
 
 
This is an exciting opportunity for a leader to make an immediate impact by providing direction, driving the strategy for the business, and developing a problem-solving culture.
 
 
**Core Competencies for Success:**

* Quality & Compliance Leadership: Proven success leading complex, multi-site quality organizations in aerospace, defense, or other high-reliability industries, with expertise in zero-failure mission environments.
* Continuous Improvement & Performance: Skilled in EBOS, Lean, and Kaizen practices with the ability to drive metrics-based improvement and systemic problem-solving.
* Team Development & Leadership: Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and build strong teams while fostering engagement and accountability.
* Collaboration & Influence: Strong cross-functional partnership with credibility to influence senior leadership, customers, and suppliers.
* Resilience & Adaptability: Able to manage ambiguity, drive change, and motivate teams in a fast-scaling environment.

**The Candidate We Are Looking For:**

* BS in an engineering discipline (MS preferred)
* Minimum 10 years of experience in high-mix, low-volume operations and manufacturing environment
* Proven success leading complex, multi-site quality organizations in aerospace, defense, or other mission-critical industries
* Demonstrated expertise in leading audits and managing compliance across regulatory bodies, customers, and suppliers, with deep knowledge of standards such as AS9100, ISO9001, and DoD requirements
* Proven ability to enhance customer quality by partnering closely with engineering, operations, and supply chain teams to consistently meet customer demand
* Strong record of measurable quality improvements
* Skilled in continuous improvement, performance metrics, and problem-solving through EBOS, Lean, and Kaizen practices
* Track record of building and developing strong teams, fostering high engagement, and driving accountability

**A Defining Leadership Opportunity:**

* Legacy: Join a privately held, 188-year-old business that takes a long-term approach, free from the short-term pressures of quarterly-driven reporting.
* Impact: Lead a mission-critical function where zero failure is the standard and success is business-defining.
* Partnership: Work directly with the BU President, senior leadership, and enterprise HR leaders in a highly influential role at the intersection of people and business strategy.
* Culture of Excellence: Help shape a culture that values people, integrity, and mission-driven excellence, driven by a Kaizen mindset and a commitment to quality and continuous improvement.

**Ready to Make a Difference?**
If you’re a proven quality engineering leader with the vision, discipline, and drive to achieve zero failure in a complex and growing business, this is your opportunity.
 
 
**Compensation and Rewards:**
We recognize that world-class leaders deliver world-class impact, and we reward accordingly. This role offers a competitive executive package that includes:
 
 
**Base Salary:**
$175k – $225k plus annual bonus
 
 
**Executive Relocation:**
Comprehensive support for a seamless transition
 
 
**Additional Enhancements:**
Potential sign-on incentives and tailored rewards based on experience
 
 
*We offer a competitive compensation package aligned with skills & experience, with flexibility to reward top talent and extraordinary qualifications.*
*Ensign-Bickford Aerospace & Defense Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE). Qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, genetic information, national origin, or veteran status.*

new_roles.title: Regional Quality Director - NA
new_roles.description:
**Job descriptions may display in multiple languages based on your language selection.**
**What We Offer**
At Magna, you can expect an engaging and dynamic environment where you can help to develop industry-leading automotive technologies. We invest in our employees, providing them with the support and resources they need to succeed. As a member of our global team, you can expect exciting, varied responsibilities as well as a wide range of development prospects. Because we believe that your career path should be as unique as you are.
 
 
**Group Summary**
Transforming mobility. Making automotive technology that is smarter, cleaner, safer and lighter. That’s what we’re passionate about at Magna Electronics, and we do it by creating world-class Electronic systems. We are a premier supplier for the global automotive industry with full capabilities in design, development, testing and manufacturing of complex Electronic systems. Our name stands for quality, environmental consciousness, and safety. Innovation is what drives us and we drive innovation. Dream big and create the future of mobility at Magna Electronics.
 
 
**Job Responsibilities**
**Role Summary**
The Regional Quality Director will be responsible for QM systems with regard to Product Portfolio, Programs and Projects to secure quality according to effective internal and external standards such as QS 9000, ISO/TS 16949/IATF, 14001, 18001, VDA, MQS, etc. to meet Legal, Company and Customer requirements and standards.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**

* Ensure effectiveness of the Magna Electronics Quality Management (QM) System.
* Managing all QM activities with regards to execution and achievement of corporate Quality goals.
* Executing the global quality strategy and goals, in particular the achievement of certified QM systems in the Division and Engineering Centers.
* Track and maintain data analysis of key metrics and performance data as it relates to the global quality strategy and results.
* Support Division management in executing quality policies; improve the sense of quality ownership in employees by corresponding measures, including establishing standards.
* Support Divisions and Engineering Centers to achieve site targets and ensure Lessons Learned / Best Practice in respect of Quality.
* Support Divisions and Engineering Centers in cases of containments, customer and warranty claims; executing root cause analysis, corrective actions and verification of effectiveness.
* Ownership in change management systems with respect to all quality-system related subjects.
* Engage in internal Program and Project reviews of Program Management and customer meetings in aspects of Quality.
* Interact with Division Quality, Production Operations, Product Development and Program Quality to meet or exceed internal and external customer quality performance targets.
* Support the sales and purchasing team in customer negotiations and supplier quality relevant topics.
* Engage in Quality advance planning and execution and support launch activities to meet timing and quality standards.
* Promote quality performance improvement throughout the organization.
* Ensure QM systems correspond to Magna Corporate and ME Group Requirements.
* Maintains regular attendance.
* Follows safe work procedures; Uses appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE); Uses workplace tools and equipment as instructed; Reports workplace hazards, injuries and illness as soon as possible following event.
* Complies with the requirements of Magna Quality System (MQS).

**Key Qualifications/Requirements**

* Excellent knowledge in effective quality standards within the automotive industry
* Knowledge of implementing and maintaining QM systems and its auditing/assessment internal and external dealing with suppliers and customers
* Experience with presentation and moderation techniques
* Comprehensive knowledge of APQP/PPAP
* Excellent knowledge in use of statistical methods and Quality Core Tools (e.g. SPC, 8D, 5Why, Ishikawa, FMEA & CP, etc.)
* Comprehensive knowledge of Root cause analysis and Problem Solving Methods (e.g. Shainin, Red X, Six Sigma, etc.)

**Education**

* Technical degree in Mechanics or Electronics required. Experienced in Quality Operations; Quality Manager/Director. Minimum of 10+ years’ global quality management experience working within the automotive electronics industry.

**Experience**

* 10+ years of progressive quality leadership experience within the automotive electronics industry, including responsibility for multi-site or regional quality management systems.
* Demonstrated experience leading quality strategy, certified QM systems, audits, customer quality performance, and continuous improvement initiatives across manufacturing and engineering environments.
* Proven ability to partner with Division, Engineering, Program Management, Operations, Sales, Purchasing, and customer teams to resolve complex quality issues and improve performance.
* Experience leading containment, warranty, customer claim, root cause analysis, corrective action, and verification of effectiveness processes.
* Prior experience as a Quality Manager, Quality Director, or equivalent senior quality leadership role in a global or matrixed organization.

**Awareness, Unity, Empowerment**
At Magna, we believe that a diverse workforce is critical to our success. That’s why we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire on the basis of experience and qualifications, and in consideration of job requirements, regardless of, in particular, color, ancestry, religion, gender, origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity. Magna takes the privacy of your personal information seriously. We discourage you from sending applications via email or traditional mail to comply with GDPR requirements and your local Data Privacy Law.
 
 
**AI-Assisted Screening Disclosure**
As part of our commitment to a fair, consistent, and efficient recruitment process, we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in the initial screening of applications submitted through our Workday system. These tools help identify qualifications and experience that align with the role requirements. Please note that AI is used solely to support our recruiters. Final decisions are always made by the hiring manager and the hiring team. Importantly, no applicant data is shared externally through these AI tools. All information remains securely within our systems and is handled in accordance with our privacy and data protection policies.
 
 
**Under conditions defined by applicable law, you may have the right to request an explanation of how AI is used to support decision-making.**
If you have any questions or concerns about this process, feel free to contact our Talent Attraction team.
 
 
**Worker Type**
Regular / Permanent
 
 
**Group**
Magna Electronics

new_roles.title: Director Quality
new_roles.description:
Reporting to the President, C.E.O., Directs and coordinates activities of personnel at all Hutchinson
 
Sealing Systems facilities engaged in Quality Management System to prevent or eliminate defects in
 
new or existing products or process by performing the following duties personally or through
 
subordinates. This position is designated as a sensitive function for quality, engineering,
 
manufacturing, supplier, audit, compliance, and operational information, including quality performance
 
data, customer requirements, product and process development information, audit findings, corrective
 
actions, supplier performance records, and proprietary company information.

We are 40 000 men and women who meet the challenges faced by our automotive, aviation, defence and industry customers every day. Our passion for challenge and our enthusiasm encourage us to imagine, design and produce high performance and innovative fluid, sealing system and anti-vibration solutions. Working at Hutchinson means being curious about everything, contributing to the evolution of mobility and reducing carbon emissions.
 
 
Join us and show what drives you!
 
 
A French company with an international presence (25 countries): 170 years of history and passing on our know-how.
 
5 billion in turnover, with 5% invested in R&D.

**SUMMARY:**

Reporting to the President, C.E.O., Directs and coordinates activities of personnel at all Hutchinson Sealing Systems facilities engaged in Quality Management System to prevent or eliminate defects in new or existing products or process by performing the following duties personally or through subordinates. This position is designated as a sensitive function for quality, engineering, manufacturing, supplier, audit, compliance, and operational information, including quality performance data, customer requirements, product and process development information, audit findings, corrective actions, supplier performance records, and proprietary company information. The incumbent is responsible for protecting the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets in accordance with company policies and customer requirements.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

Include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

* Analyzes, evaluates, and presents information concerning factors such as quality performance, production capabilities, manufacturing problems, customer quality trends, and quality planning of new products for consideration by other members of the management team.
* Presents and evaluates alternative methods and procedures to establish standardized quality systems based on best practices.
* Participates with other top management personnel in formulating and establishing company policies, operating procedures, and goals.
* Participates in review of product development activities and APQP milestones.
* Conducts Quality System Management review meetings with top management to assess performance and compliance to customer quality requirements.
* Reviews technical problems and procedures of departments and recommends solutions to problems or changes in procedures.
* Confers with engineers and managers about quality assurance of new products and process to improve manufacturing capability.
* Reviews technical publications, articles, and abstracts to stay abreast of technical and quality system developments in industry.
* Travel required on a frequent basis to suppliers and customer facilities as well as other Hutchinson facilities.
* Provides internal quality system audit of Hutchinson Sealing Systems locations.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

Master's degree (M.A.) or equivalent; or four to ten years' related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Qualifications may be waived by management. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:**

None.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

Manages subordinates in department. Is responsible for the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of this unit. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complains and resolving problems.

**TEAM SKILLS:**

Hutchinson is built around teamwork. This position requires the use of good team skills such as cooperation, information sharing, task sharing, timely completion of assignments, good listening and communication skills and overall respect for other team members.

**LANGUAGE SKILLS:**

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret common scientific and technical journals, financial reports, and legal documents. Ability to respond to common inquiries or complaints from customers, regulatory agencies, or members of the business community. Ability to write speeches and articles for publication that conform to prescribed style and format. Ability to effectively present information to top management, public groups and/or boards of directors.

**MATHEMATICAL SKILLS:**

Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry. Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.

**COMPUTER SKILLS:**

Ability to use word processing, spreadsheet applications. Must be familiar with internet research, Microsoft Office software, and the use of e-mail.

**REASONING ABILITY:**

Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT:**

new_roles.title: Director, Quality - Aero-Glen International
new_roles.description:
**Overview Of The Position**
The Director of Quality provides strategic direction and operational oversight for the company’s Quality Assurance and Quality Control functions. As the principal owner of the company’s Quality Management System (QMS), this role is accountable for maintaining compliance with AS9100, AS9120, and applicable customer and regulatory requirements; driving continuous improvement; and ensuring that Aero Glen consistently delivers products and services that meet the highest standards of quality, reliability, and customer satisfaction.
 
 
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Establish and execute the company's quality strategy in alignment with business objectives, customer expectations, and applicable industry requirements. Develop measurable targets and provide visibility of quality performance and risks.
* Develop and manage the department’s staffing plan, training strategy and resource requirements. Ensure clarity of accountability, roles, responsibilities and decision making throughout the quality organization.
* Balance customer requirements, compliance obligations, operational efficiency, and business performance without compromising product conformity or regulatory compliance.
* Maintain overall accountability for the effectiveness and continual improvement of the company's AS9100- and AS9120-certified Quality Management System, ensuring operating procedures are approached with a risk-based thought process and effectively integrated and monitored.
* Oversee the company’s audit program ensuring readiness and execution of internal audits, external certification audits and customer audits. Maintain relationships with certification bodies, auditors and external stakeholders. Execute effective and timely responses to all notifications, findings and corrective actions.
* Evaluate the quality and compliance implications of new contracts, acquisitions and significant business process changes.
* Manage the supplier quality management program, including supplier approval, qualification, monitoring, risk assessment, and performance evaluation.
* Oversee the investigation and resolution of customer quality issues, including root cause analysis, containment, corrective action, and effectiveness verification. Utilize structured analysis methods such as 5Whys and 8 Disciplines in response to quality issues.
* Oversee processes and controls for first article inspection and receiving inspection, including inspection plans, workflow and disposition of non-conforming materials. Ensuring that inspection activities are well documented and appropriate for product or vendor risk, customer expectations and company procedures.
* Partner with Sales, Supply Chain and Operations to identify and implement continuous improvement initiatives to address reoccurring deficits in process, performance or product.
* Handle Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) for assigned accounts and Federal Contract Information (FCI) as required.

**Other Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**

* Demonstrated ability leading a team to achieve business objectives.
* Demonstrated ability to identify process issues and drive process improvement.
* Open-minded self-starter with the ability to adapt, improvise and problem solve.
* Ability to work independently on multiple tasks and projects with various stakeholders.
* Organizational skills to manage transactional details.
* Experience supporting organizational growth, acquisitions or system implementations preferred.
* LEAN certification highly desired.
* Experience managing and maintaining current quality assurance control principles.
* Exceptional Microsoft Office proficiency (Excel, Access, PowerPoint Presentations).

new_roles.title: Vice President, Quality Assurance (North America)
new_roles.description:
**Role Description**
The Vice President, Quality Assurance (North America) is a full-time remote role responsible for overseeing all quality assurance activities related to Bento Amaral Wine Consulting’s services and partnerships in the North American market. This role includes designing and implementing quality management frameworks, defining standards and procedures, and monitoring adherence across consulting projects, educational programs, and content deliverables. The VP will lead quality audits, manage continuous improvement initiatives, and ensure compliance with relevant regulatory requirements and industry best practices. Day-to-day tasks involve collaborating with internal teams and external partners, reviewing processes and documentation, analyzing quality metrics, and providing guidance to ensure consistent, high-quality outcomes. The role also includes strategic input into service development, risk management, and client communications relating to quality assurance.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrated expertise in Quality Assurance and Quality Management, with the ability to design and oversee robust quality systems.
* Strong skills in Quality Control, including setting quality standards, monitoring performance, and implementing corrective actions.
* Experience in Quality Auditing, with the capability to plan, conduct, and report internal and external audits.
* Solid understanding of applicable Regulatory Requirements and industry guidelines relevant to wine, food, or beverage sectors.
* Proven leadership experience in a senior quality role, ideally within wine, food, beverage, or related industries.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with attention to detail and consistency.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively in a remote, international environment.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Quality Management, Oenology, Food Science, Engineering, or a related field; professional certifications in quality (e.g., ISO, Six Sigma) are an advantage.
* Familiarity with North American regulatory and certification frameworks in wine, food, or beverage is highly beneficial.

new_roles.title: Vice President of Quality
new_roles.description:
We are partnering with a leading global prestige beauty and skincare company to identify a
**Vice President of Quality**
to lead its North American Quality organization.

This is a high-impact executive leadership opportunity for a commercially minded quality professional who can connect quality, regulatory compliance, manufacturing excellence, and business performance within a complex, global organization.

The successful candidate will oversee Quality across North American manufacturing and distribution operations, providing leadership to a network of internal manufacturing operations and external manufacturing partners across multiple continents.

**About The Opportunity**

Reporting into senior global leadership, the Vice President of Quality will lead an organization of approximately 100 professionals, with four Directors reporting directly into the role.

The scope encompasses contract manufacturing quality, factory quality (QA, QC, laboratories, and Quality Management Systems), and quality assurance across North America, while providing technical quality leadership and guidance to teams in Canada and Brazil.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Lead the North American Quality organization:**
 Provide strategic direction and leadership across manufacturing, quality assurance, quality control, laboratories, and quality systems.
* **Act as the business voice of Quality:**
 Partner with commercial, brand, manufacturing, and executive stakeholders to translate quality and regulatory requirements into sound business decisions.
* **Drive regulatory and compliance excellence:**
 Ensure alignment between global quality standards and US regulatory requirements, particularly FDA OTC regulations and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).
* **Oversee contract manufacturing quality:**
 Provide quality leadership and oversight across a network of approximately 30–40 contract manufacturing partners, including key strategic suppliers.
* **Strengthen organizational capabilities:**
 Develop a technically strong team, promote greater autonomy, build leadership capabilities, and establish succession depth.
* **Partner with manufacturing leadership:**
 Work closely with plant and operational leaders to balance quality expectations with production demands, providing constructive challenge and driving continuous improvement.
* **Lead through influence:**
 Build strong relationships across a global, multicultural, and matrixed organization, including teams and stakeholders outside of the direct reporting structure.
* **Prepare the organization for future growth:**
 Build the organizational structure, capabilities, and relationships necessary to support a potentially broader international Quality remit.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

* Extensive leadership experience in Quality within beauty, personal care, consumer health, or complex consumer goods manufacturing environments.
* Strong hands-on experience with
 **FDA OTC regulations and GMP requirements**
 .
* Proven experience leading large, multi-layered Quality organizations and developing senior leadership teams.
* Experience overseeing contract manufacturers, external manufacturing partners, and complex supplier networks.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing quality, QA, QC, laboratory operations, and Quality Management Systems.
* Commercially oriented leadership approach, with the ability to translate technical and regulatory considerations into practical business decisions.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and operate effectively within global, matrixed organizations.
* Experience balancing quality standards, operational performance, and business priorities.
* Conversational French is considered a strong advantage.

new_roles.title: Director, Operations - Drug Product (Biologics)
new_roles.description:
**Job Description**
**Director Operations for Drug Product**
Do you aspire to secure a critical role in the production of biologics-based medicines? Are you excited to lead dynamic teams in a state-of-the-art facility that brings transformative biotech treatments to patients globally? We invite you to become a part of our journey as the Director Operations for Drug Product. This role offers you the chance to contribute to the site's development and wield technical leadership to ensure successful GMP manufacturing.
 
 
**Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities**

* The Director, Operations – Drug Product plays a critical part in strategic project realization of the Wilmington Biotech facility, a new hi-potent facility in our company's Biologic manufacturing network, ensuring that site’s mission and objectives are effectively achieved, consistent with our company's requirements to ensure compliance, safety and reliable supply to our customers.
* As a key member of the Site Leadership Team, you'll have the opportunity to shape site and organizational strategies, overseeing drug product manufacturing for commercial and new product introductions.
* Be part of facility start-up to manufacture high-potent products, eg antibody drug conjugates (ADCs)
* You will work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to streamline technology transfers and commercial approvals, meanwhile nurturing and empowering your operations team.
* You'll get to foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement, leading or supporting various site functional and cross-functional structures for departmental alignment.
* Tackling resource constraints and needs, you will champion operational and technical excellence for efficient production and implement Lean principles for process optimization.
* Upholding our Manufacturing Division Quality Management System (QMS) requirements, you will manage relevant quality topics, and ensure permanent inspection readiness.
* You will oversee financial forecasts and workload for departmental cost improvements, aligning with capital and expense targets while contributing to sustainability and cost reduction initiatives.
* You will have the chance to leverage digital tools for operational efficiency and informed decision-making, keeping pace with emerging digital technologies relevant to manufacturing processes.
* You will be accountable for achieving onsite Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), monitoring and striving to improve performance metrics related to hiring, uptime, training, change controls, investigations, CAPAs, yield, volume, production cadence, operational availability, and more.

**Qualification And Experience**
**Required Experience and Skills:**

* A degree or equivalent in Engineering, Science, Technical, or other relevant fields: Bachelor’s degree + 12 years industry experience Or Masters + 10 years Or PhD + 8 years
* 6 or more years demonstrated leadership ability and experience managing, coaching, and mentoring high-performing cross function teams.
* Demonstrated experience in a biotech/vaccines/pharma manufacturing site, project, or other relevant roles, specifically drug product sterile manufacturing.
* Demonstrated experience in manufacturing clinical and commercial products.
* Understanding of cGMP requirements for commercial high-potent ADC manufacturing of drug product

**Preferred Experience And Skills**

* Sterile manufacturing leadership & operations, with preferred multi-product experience.
* A leader who inspires, coaches, and fosters a high-performance organizational culture.
* A continuous learner who cultivates a culture of ongoing development within your team.
* An innovative thinker with excellent decision-making and problem-solving skills.
* Experienced in leading highly effective cross-functional teams with a passion for shaping the future of our organization.
* Capable of influencing and building relationships across organizational layers, as well as externally with partners.

#ADC #ADC2026
 
 
**Required Skills**
Adaptability, Adaptability, Business Agility, Continuous Development, Cross-Functional Project Management, Customer Delivery, Data Analysis, Decision Making, Lean Manufacturing, Manufacturing, Manufacturing Quality Control, Manufacturing Technologies, Operations Management, Organizational Leadership, People Leadership, Performance Metrics, Process Improvements, Process Optimization, Product Compliance, Production Scheduling, Quality Compliance, Quality Control Management, Quality Control Systems, Quality Management, Regulatory Compliance {+ 7 more}

new_roles.title: Director of Manufacturing and Quality
new_roles.description:
For our client, we are seeking a Director of Manufacturing and Quality to join the team of a leader in the Consumer Technology space.
 
 
This leader will own the global manufacturing strategy and quality execution for a hardware-driven business operating across design, production, and supply chain partners. The role will be central to scaling high-volume manufacturing, improving operational efficiency, and ensuring product quality from early design through full production. You will work closely with engineering, contract manufacturers, and cross-functional partners to strengthen launch readiness, vendor accountability, and long-term quality performance.
 
 
Location: Sunnyvale, CA
 
 
Compensation: $200,000 – $250,000 annually
 
 
**Responsibilities**

* Architect and execute the global manufacturing strategy, including optimization of production facilities
* Drive NPI handoffs from design to high-volume manufacturing with robust playbooks
* Optimize production capacity and efficiency through innovative layout and automation designs
* Manage technical execution at tier-1 contract manufacturers and oversee vendor accountability
* Own and improve the global Quality Management System across all sites and partners
* Implement early design quality practices to mitigate manufacturing issues through the lifecycle
* Lead global failure analysis and corrective action processes to maintain product quality

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of leadership experience in hardware manufacturing operations, NPI, and quality engineering in high-tech industries
* Direct experience establishing and scaling overseas manufacturing facilities, particularly in Asia
* Deep understanding of electrical fabrication and mechanical processes
* Expertise in advanced quality methodologies such as Six Sigma and Lean Manufacturing
* Bachelor's degree in a technical field; an MS or MBA is a plus

**Benefits**

* 100% premium coverage for Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
* Equity options available in the form of stock options
* 401(k) match to support retirement savings
* Reimbursement for work-from-home hardware expenses

Our client is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every qualification—your background could be exactly what this team needs.

new_roles.title: Southwest Regional Director of Production and Logistics
new_roles.description:
About PopUp Bagels

 

PopUp Bagels is not just a bagel company—we’re a cultural movement. Our stores are small, our vibes are loud, and our energy is contagious. From signature neon and iconic bullhorns to our “Not Famous but Known” mirror, we’ve reimagined not just how a bagel is created, but how it’s enjoyed: Grip, Rip and Dip! With a cult-like following, massive social presence, and unparalleled collaborations with top companies, partners and Brand Ambassadors PopUp Bagels is defining a new food lifestyle brand.

 

We keep things simple, but we do them really, really well. And our customers agree.

 

The Role

 

We're looking for a Regional Director to lead operations at our Nevada cream cheese production facility. This facility will play an important role in supporting PopUp's continued growth and our ability to deliver the products our customers love.

 

This is a senior operational leadership role responsible for overseeing the day-to-day performance of the facility, from the moment raw materials come through the door to the second finished goods ship out to shops around the country.

 

Here's what makes this role different from other operations roles: we're building something big, and we're building quickly. With established production facilities and operating procedures already in place, the right person for this role will know how to take proven processes, put them into practice, and continue improving them as we grow.

 

We're looking for a problem-solver who isn't afraid to roll up their sleeves and find solutions, a leader who earns trust on the floor just as easily as they collaborate with senior leadership, and someone who can translate operational expectations into consistent, measurable results.

 

This role serves as a key connection between the Nevada production facility and our broader operations leadership team. You'll have the opportunity to influence how we operate, develop our people, and contribute to the continued evolution of our production processes as PopUp expands.

 

If you're a driven leader who thrives in fast-moving environments, values collaboration, and takes pride in building strong teams and efficient operations, this could be the role for you.

 

What You'll Do:

 

Run the Facility. You'll provide day-to-day operational leadership and oversight across Cream Cheese and Schmear production, Warehouse, Quality Assurance, Sanitation, and Equipment Maintenance Working closely with the President of Operations and other facility leaders, you'll implement and maintain established SOPs, manage production schedules, drive throughput targets, and identify opportunities to continuously improve how we operate. You'll be responsible for addressing operational challenges, escalating significant issues when appropriate, and ensuring the facility consistently meets established performance, quality, and safety expectations.

 

Lead People Who Make an Impact. Building a strong team culture is at the core of this role. You'll recruit, develop, and retain a workforce that makes a genuine impact at PopUp Bagels. You'll coach and support your management team, reinforce established training programs, and identify opportunities to strengthen employee development as the operation grows. You'll create an environment where accountability and recognition go hand in hand. Our hourly workforce is the backbone of this operation, and how you show up for them defines everything.

 

Manage the Numbers. You'll be accountable for facility-level operational performance, including production costs, labor efficiency, waste reduction, and budget adherence. You'll partner closely with the President of Operations, Finance, and Accounting on budgeting, forecasting, and period-end reporting, and regularly communicate facility performance, challenges, and opportunities to senior leadership. You'll identify ways to improve efficiency and control costs without compromising quality, safety, or people, while supporting broader capital planning and investment decisions.

 

Drive Supply Chain Alignment. Work directly with our VP of Supply Chain to align production schedules with material availability. You'll oversee raw material procurement planning, inventory controls, and warehouse operations, ensuring established FIFO and food safety standards are consistently followed. You'll collaborate with Supply Chain and other production facilities to support inventory accuracy, product availability, and efficient distribution.

 

Lead Food Safety & Regulatory Compliance. Champion a food-safety-first culture across every part of the facility. You'll ensure consistent execution of established food safety programs and compliance with applicable FDA regulations, FSMA requirements, HACCP plans, and third-party audit standards (SQF, BRC), as applicable. You'll partner with Quality Assurance and the President of Operations to maintain rigorous in-process and finished product quality standards, address compliance concerns, and implement corrective actions when something doesn't meet the bar.

 

Collaborate Across the Company. You'll represent Nevada facility operations in company-wide leadership meetings and collaborate with Distribution & Logistics, Supply Chain, Quality Assurance, and corporate leadership. You'll translate what's happening on the floor into meaningful operational insights, communicate opportunities for improvement, and ensure company priorities and decisions are effectively implemented at the facility level.

 

Who You Are and What You Bring

 

     We're looking for a leader who is genuinely:

 

A scrappy problem-solver. When something breaks at 7am or a key ingredient is backordered, you find a way. You're resourceful, calm under pressure, and put in the time to figure it out. You know when to make decisions, when to collaborate, and when to escalate an issue.

 

A trust-builder. Your team respects you because you've worked to build trust, not because of your title. You're on the floor, you know people's names, and you follow through on what you say.

 

A galvanizing leader. You provide clear direction, get buy-in, and bring your team along with energy and conviction. People want to work hard for you because they know you'll do the same for them.

 

Equally at home in a leadership meeting and a production room. You can review financial and operational performance in the morning and troubleshoot a production issue in the afternoon. You don't ask your team to do what you're not willing to do yourself.

 

Built for growth and continuous improvement. PopUp is growing fast, and our processes will continue to evolve. You appreciate the value of established systems and standards, but you're also comfortable identifying opportunities to make them better. You know how to balance consistency with adaptability as the business scales.

 

       You bring:

 

 
* Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience. Master's degree (MBA or MS) preferred.
 
* 8–10+ years of progressive plant or manufacturing operations leadership experience, including demonstrated responsibility for facility performance, team leadership, and operational budgets.
 
* Experience leading operations in fast-paced manufacturing environments, preferably within growing or multi-site organizations.
 
* Proven track record of leading high-performing, cross-functional manufacturing teams.
 
* Prior food and beverage industry experience strongly preferred; dairy, cream cheese, spreads, or related refrigerated food production experience is a significant plus.
 
* Familiarity with food safety regulatory frameworks, including FSMA, HACCP, GMP, and third-party audit standards (SQF, BRC, AIB).
 
* Strong financial acumen, including budget management, cost analysis, labor efficiency, and operational performance reporting.
 
* Working knowledge of production cost drivers, manufacturing KPIs, and continuous improvement methodologies (Lean, Production Excellence, or equivalent).
 
* Demonstrated experience implementing and maintaining standardized operating procedures, production processes, and operational controls.
 
* Experience partnering with corporate Finance, Supply Chain, Quality Assurance, and Distribution teams.
 
* Availability and willingness to be on-call on weekends and off-hours to respond to facility disruptions or emergencies.
 
* Experience supporting capital improvement projects and operational efficiency initiatives.
 
* A history of building positive, rewarding workplace cultures for hourly workforces.
 

 

Physical Requirements

 

The following physical requirements are representative of those needed to perform the essential functions of this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with qualifying disabilities.

 

 
* Ability to walk, stand, and move throughout a production facility for extended periods during daily floor presence and inspections.
 
* Must be able to work in a manufacturing environment with varying temperatures, including refrigerated dairy production and storage areas, moderate to loud noise levels, and exposure to dairy ingredients and food-grade cleaning agents.
 
* Occasional lifting of up to 50 pounds may be required.
 
* Must be able to wear required PPE, including hair nets, beard nets, gloves, and safety footwear when on the production floor.
 
* Ability to use standard office equipment (computer, monitor, phone, conferencing technology) for extended periods.
 
* Occasional travel to corporate offices, other production facilities, or external meetings (estimated up to 30%).
 

 

PopUp Bagels is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

 

We do not discriminate based on race, age, ancestry, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, pregnancy, childbirth or related condition, unemployment status, gender identity or expression, transgender status, marital status, domestic violence or sexual violence victim status, national origin, citizenship, disability, covered veteran and/or military status, genetic information, familial status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, and local law. PopUp Bagels conducts pre-employment screenings in compliance with local, state, and federal laws, and utilizes E-Verify to confirm U.S. employment eligibility.

 

The duties of this position may change from time to time. PopUp Bagels reserves the right to add or delete duties and responsibilities at its discretion. This posting describes the general nature and level of work expected and is not intended to be all-inclusive.

new_roles.description:
**Application Close Date**
Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.
 
 
At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!
 
 
This role is part of Blue Origin Operations, which is comprised of Integrated Supply Chain, Test Operations, Safety, Quality, and Mission Assurance. This includes Manufacturing and Supply Chain support across all Blue Origin facilities.
 
 
We are a team of collaborators, doers, and problem-solvers who are relentlessly committed to a culture of safety. This position will directly impact the history of space exploration and require your commitment and detailed attention toward safe and repeatable space flight. Join us in lowering the cost of access to space and enabling Blue Origin's vision of millions of people living and working in space to benefit Earth.
 
 
We are looking for someone to apply their technical expertise, leadership skills, and commitment to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight. Passion for our mission and vision is required!
 
 
Blue Origin is scaling production of its electric propulsion systems. We are hiring a Director to own the manufacturing outcome for that product line and to carry it from development hardware into rate production.
 
 
You will be the single-threaded leader for Operations of this program: one person accountable for rate, quality, cost, and people, with full authority over the entire in-program production flow.
 
 
This is a build-it role, not a run-it role. You will define the value streams, stand up integration with support organizations, and build the team that runs the line — working concurrently with an active design program rather than behind a frozen one.
 
 
**Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To**

* Own the strategy, roadmap, and priorities for successful manufacturing outcomes of the electric propulsion thruster line — delivery rate, quality, cost, and the people who produce it.
* Build the production organization. Define the value streams, stand up production control and manufacturing engineering, and hire and develop the leadership beneath you as the program scales.
* Own the get-to-rate plan. Define the path from development build to sustained rate production, and demonstrate cycle time at the rate-readiness gate as a committed acceptance number rather than a projection.
* Lead the transition from development build into rate production, including the qualification of tooling, processes, and work instructions required to produce repeatably at rate.
* Drive producibility into the product during design, rather than absorbing it on the floor later. Own the manufacturing view of the bill of materials as the product configuration evolves.
* Establish and own the program's working interfaces with quality, supply chain, material planning, and test operations.
* Build and manage the program's manufacturing operating budget and capital plan, owning responsibility for product delivery at cost and rate.
* Set the safety and quality culture for a new production team, and hold it as the organization grows.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in an engineering or technical discipline.
* 12+ years of experience in manufacturing, production, supply chain, or operations, including 5+ years leading manufacturing organizations.
* Direct, hands-on experience taking a new product or production line from development into rate production.
* Experience carrying a product through a production-readiness or rate-readiness gate, and owning the cycle-time and capability evidence presented at it.
* Experience building an organization — defining structure, hiring leaders, and developing a team through significant growth.
* Line management of both salaried professionals and craft or technician populations.
* Demonstrated ability to operate in ambiguity: making defensible assumptions and moving forward on an incomplete definition, then correcting as information arrives.
* Ability to travel frequently, up to approximately 35%, to other Blue Origin sites.
* Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 15+ years of manufacturing and operations experience.
* Propulsion, spacecraft, satellite, or other high-reliability low-volume hardware experience.
* Experience transitioning a product from low-volume, high-mix build into repeatable rate production.
* Demonstrated cycle-time or throughput improvement with measured results.
* Experience standing up production at a new or greenfield manufacturing site.
* Experience managing a build against a bill of materials that changed materially during production ramp.
* Formal lean or continuous-improvement training, with applied results on a production line.
* Master’s degree in engineering or technical field, or MBA.

**Base Pay Range For**
WA applicants is $203,165.00 - $284,430.30
 
 
**Other Site Ranges May Differ**
**Culture Statement**
Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
 
 
**Export Control Regulations**
Applicants for employment at Blue Origin must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e. current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.
 
 
**Background Check**

* Required for all positions: Blue’s Standard Background Check
* Required for Certain Job Profiles: Defense Biometric Identification System (DBIDS) background check if at any time the role requires one to be on a military installation
* Required for Certain Job Profiles: Drivers who operate Commercial Motor Vehicles with a Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW), Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) or combination of power unit and trailer that meets or exceeds 10,001 lbs. and/or transports placardable amounts of hazardous materials by ground in any vehicle on a public road while in commerce, may be subject to additional Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations including: Driver Qualification Files, Medical Certification (obtained before onboarding), Road Test, Hours of Service, Drug and Alcohol Testing, vehicle inspection requirements, CDL requirements (if applicable) and hazardous materials transportation/shipping training.
* Required for certain Job Profiles: Ability to obtain and maintain Merchant Mariner Credential, which includes pre-employment and random drug testing as well as DOT physical

**Benefits**

* Benefits include: Medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability, 401(k) with a company match of up to 5%, and an Education Support Program.
* Stock Options for all regular employees (working at least 20 hours/week)
* Paid Time Off: Up to four (4) weeks per year based on weekly scheduled hours, and up to 14 company-paid holidays.
* Dependent on role type and job level, employees may be eligible for benefits and bonuses based on the company's intent to reward individual contributions and enable them to share in the company's results, or other factors at the company's sole discretion. Bonus amounts and eligibility are not guaranteed and subject to change and cancellation. Please check with your recruiter for more details.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**
Blue Origin is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer and is committed to attracting, retaining, and developing a highly qualified and dedicated work force. Blue Origin hires and promotes people on the basis of their qualifications, performance, and abilities. We support the establishment and maintenance of a workplace that fosters trust, equality, and teamwork. We provide all qualified applicants for employment and employees with equal opportunities for hire, promotion, and other terms and conditions of employment, regardless of their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin/ethnicity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status, or any other status or characteristic protected by federal, state, and/or local law. Blue Origin will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the Washington Fair Chance Act, the California Fair Chance Act, the Los Angeles Fair Chance in Hiring Ordinance, and other applicable laws. For more information on “Know Your Rights,” please see here.
 
 
**Affirmative Action and Disability Accommodation**
Applicants wishing to receive information on Blue Origin’s Affirmative Action Plans, or applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation in order to participate in the application and/or interview process, please contact us at EEOCompliance@blueorigin.com. Please note this is a publicly managed inbox. Please do not include any personal medical information in your request.

new_roles.title: Director Internal Fill Finish Manufacturing
new_roles.description:
**Build Our Future Together**
At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. Regeneron is currently looking for a Director of Internal Fill Finish Manufacturing to join our Industrial Operations and Product Supply (IOPS) team. This leadership role is accountable for the aseptic filling operation for clinical and commercial drug products, including vials and syringes in both liquid and lyophilized formats. The Director owns the full filling value stream: materials management; preparation of equipment, format parts, and components; formulation of drug product and placebo; aseptic filling; and lyophilization. The Director also ensures a seamless handoff to downstream finishing operations (Visual Inspection, syringe safety systems and autoinjector assembly, packaging, labeling, and serialization) and oversees facility cleaning and contamination control for the filling suites.
 
 
This role focuses on the start-up and execution of compliant GMP aseptic operations, ensuring the facility is properly staffed and trained, and supporting a dynamic, flexible production planning process that meets the needs of Regeneron’s patients. The Director will work directly with Drug Substance and Finish manufacturing management to ensure production timelines are met and will be a key member of various management teams within IOPS.
 
 
This position offers the opportunity to contribute to a fast-growing, science-driven organization making a meaningful difference to patients worldwide.
 
 
**When & Where**

* Location: Rensselaer, NY
* Work model: Monday- Friday, 8am-4:30pm

**Discover Your Role**

* Provides leadership, vision, and management to the Filling team and its supporting functions, and leads all aspects of Filling operations at the facility to manufacture commercial and clinical parenteral medicines according to approved protocols, regulations, and schedules
* Directly oversees aseptic filling of drug product and placebo into vials and syringes, in liquid and lyophilized formats, including stoppering, capping, and crimping
* Directly oversees formulation of bulk drug product and placebo, including solution preparation and sterile filtration
* Directly oversees preparation of equipment, format parts, and components to support aseptic filling, including washing, depyrogenation, sterilization, and setup of filling lines
* Directly oversees lyophilization operations, including loading, cycle execution, and unloading, as well as the management of materials and components required to support filling operations
* Directly oversees cleaning and sanitization of filling suites, including Graded space (Grade A–D) and Controlled Non-Classified rooms (iCNC), and supports the site contamination control strategy, environmental monitoring, and aseptic process simulations (media fills)
* Ensures a smooth, timely handoff of filled product to downstream finishing operations (Visual Inspection, assembly, packaging, and labeling) in partnership with the leaders of those areas
* Troubleshoots and resolves issues impeding filling deliverables, including equipment performance, line interventions, and yield; provides technical input to resolve filling and aseptic process challenges
* Partners with department Directors and Project Management to implement new filling processes, including new formats, PFS and vial filling lines, formulation, aseptic filling, and lyophilization
* Manages department metrics and goals, monitors performance to objectives, and drives continuous improvement initiatives essential to meeting patient and business needs
* Leads the annual merit performance review process, builds departmental structure, and develops long-term staffing plans, including aseptic gowning qualification and training programs
* Collaborates with department Directors to support development of the annual budget, and rapidly and accurately communicates issues to department Directors
* Writes, reviews, and/or approves Standard Operating Procedures, specifications, regulatory filings, or other controlled documents as needed
* Executes Quality Management System assignments (CAPA, Deviation, Investigation, Change Control, etc.)
* Participates in the development and maintenance of a safe manufacturing environment and ensures that IOPS safety standards are maintained
* Oversees, supports, and participates in cGMP audits of all filling areas within the facility; maintains site inspection readiness and represents the filling operation during regulatory and client audits

**This Role Requires**

* BS in any of the physical or biological sciences or chemical engineering, with biopharmaceutical/biotech experience in a GMP drug product production facility, including aseptic filling experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience

+ Director: 12+ years of experience
+ Senior Director: 15+ years of experience
+ Level will be determined based on experience

* Experience overseeing aseptic filling operations in a biologics manufacturing environment, including vial and prefilled syringe filling
* Working knowledge of lyophilization, formulation, and aseptic technique, including barrier and isolator/RABS technologies
* Working knowledge of contamination control, environmental monitoring, and aseptic process simulation requirements
* Experience with multiproduct biologics facility start-up is preferred
* Experience interacting with multiple health authorities (e.g., FDA, EMA, PMDA)

Does this sound like you? Apply now to take your first step towards living the Regeneron Way! We are committed to building a workplace with an inclusive culture. Regeneron is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief (or lack thereof), sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, civil status, pregnancy or parental status, age, disability, nationality, citizenship status, ethnic or national origin, membership of the Traveler community, familial status, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. Where required, we will provide reasonable accommodation to applicants with known disabilities or chronic illnesses during the recruitment process, unless such accommodation would impose undue hardship.
 
 
Where necessary, we disclose salary ranges for roles in all countries in which we operate. The final offer will be determined within the relevant range based on the country of employment, specific role level, and your skills and experience. In some countries, collective bargaining agreements (CBAs) may apply and influence certain elements of pay or benefits. Regeneron offers a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package which may include, depending on country and role: annual bonuses or other incentive plans, equity awards, pension or retirement benefits, 401(k) company match, health and wellness programs, fitness centers, insurance benefits (e.g. medical, dental, vision, life and disability), paid time off, and family support benefits. For additional information about Regeneron benefits in the U.S., please visit https://careers.regeneron.com/en/working-at-regeneron/total-rewards/. For other locations, additional information will be provided during the recruitment process. If you have any questions, please speak with your recruiter.
 
 
Please be advised that at Regeneron, we believe we do our best work when we are together. For that reason, many roles are required to be performed on‑site. Please speak with your recruiter and hiring manager for more information about on‑site expectations for your role and location.
 
 
As part of the recruitment process, certain background checks may be conducted in accordance with the laws of the country where the position is based. The purpose of such checks is to verify certain information prior to the commencement of employment such as identity, right to work and educational qualifications.
 
 
For jobs in Canada: this posting is for an existing position.
 
 
**Salary Range (annually)**
$175,700.00 - $292,700.00
