new_roles.title: Director, R&D and New Product Development
new_roles.description:
**Location:**
Conrona, CA or Brecksville, OH with a planned transitioning to Wickliffe, OH in 2028.
 
 
*As Lubrizol approaches its centennial in 2028, our Wickliffe campus will become the unified home of Lubrizol’s*
*global headquarters, integrating Lubrizol’s Brecksville site capabilities and employees to the Wickliffe campus.*
**Job Type:**
Hybrid. 4 days on-site
 
 
**Travel Expectancy:**
20 - 40%
 
 
**Salary Range:**
$160,000.00 - $220,000.00 + Bonus
 
 
**Shape the Future with Us.**
At Lubrizol, we’re bringing to life the chemistry behind clean water, efficient transportation, reliable infrastructure, critical medicines, and the products people rely on every day through science, sustainability, and a culture of inclusion.
 
 
As part of our global team, you’ll be empowered to make a real impact - on your career, your community, and the world around you.
 
 
****How You’ll Make An Impact****
The Global Leader, New Product Development – Medical Devices is a senior technical and people leader responsible for medical device new product development, from concept through commercialization. This role owns NPD strategy, talent development, governance, and execution across multiple geographies and development centers, ensuring strong alignment with customer needs, regulatory requirements, and business strategy.
 
 
The role leads a global, multidisciplinary NPD organization, partners closely with Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, Commercial, and Executive Leadership, and acts as a senior technical representative to key medical device OEM customers.
 
 
****Required Qualifications That Enable Your Success****

* Define and execute the global medical device NPD strategy aligned with business growth priorities, customer roadmaps, and portfolio strategy.
* Identify and pursue adjacent medical device applications where our technologies and platforms can create differentiated value and drive organic growth.
* Lead capability road mapping to define and build the new technical, testing, and development capabilities the group must invest in to sustain growth and capture high value programs.
* Establish scalable development governance, stage-gate rigor, and portfolio prioritization to ensure consistent execution excellence.
* Oversee complex, multi-site development programs from concept through commercialization, ensuring delivery to cost, schedule, performance, and quality expectations.
* Partner with Quality and Regulatory to ensure compliance with FDA, CE/MDR, ISO 13485, and applicable global regulatory requirements.
* Serve as senior technical interface with strategic OEM customers, supporting complex development engagements and long-term partnerships.
* Collaborate with Commercial, Marketing, and Business Development to shape development proposals, technology roadmaps, and differentiated customer solutions.
* Champion design-for-manufacturability, design-for-quality, and design-for-cost principles across global manufacturing platforms.
* Ensure effective transfer of products from NPD to Manufacturing, preserving design intent, robustness, and scalability during launch and ramp-up.
* Lead and develop a global organization of NPD engineers, scientists, and program leaders across multiple regions and sites.
* Build technical bench strength through hiring, development, coaching, and succession planning.

****Required Qualifications That Enable Your Success****

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Biomedical, Chemical Engineering, or related technical discipline; advanced degree preferred.
* 10 or more years of progressive experience in medical device product development in a regulated environment., including experience in thermoplastic precision extrusion and silicone processing.
* Demonstrated experience leading global or multi-site technical teams.
* Strong working knowledge of FDA design controls, ISO 13485, FDA 21 CFR Part 820, and CE/MDR requirements.
* Proven track record delivering complex development programs from concept through commercialization and manufacturing transfer.

****Preferred Qualifications That Drive You Forward****

* Advanced technical degree (MS or PhD).
* Experience with catheter-based or minimally invasive medical device technologies.
* Strong understanding of polymer-based medical devices and associated manufacturing processes.
* Formal training or certification in program or portfolio management.
* Experience operating effectively within matrixed global organizations.

****Benefits That Empower You****

* Competitive salary with performance-based bonus plans
* 401(k) match + Age-Weighted Defined Contribution
* Comprehensive medical, dental & vision coverage
* Health Savings Account (HSA)
* Paid holidays, vacation, and parental leave
* Flexible work environment
* Learning and development opportunities
* Career and professional growth
* Inclusive culture and vibrant community engagement Learn more at benefits.lubrizol.com!

**Lubrizol: Imagined for Life. Enabled by Science. ™ Delivered by You.**
For nearly 100 years, The Lubrizol Corporation, a Berkshire Hathaway company, has been at the forefront of innovation to enhance everyday life, advance mobility, and make the modern world work better. Our specialty chemistry solutions—from engine oils, performance coatings, and skincare to medical devices and plumbing systems —are powered by the expertise, passion, and commitment of people like you. We tackle the world’s toughest challenges with science-based solutions, deeply understanding our customers to deliver innovative chemistry and differentiated value.
 
 
Our inclusive culture, dedication to safety, and incredible global talent drive our success. Our solutions meet the evolving needs of the modern world—brought to life by science and, most importantly, delivered by you. Whether you're in the lab, on the production floor, or in the office, you'll be part of a team around the world that empowers you to think boldly, drive results, and contribute to solutions that shape a better, more sustainable future.
 
 
**We win because of you. Let’s build the future together.**

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Product Development & Production
new_roles.description:
Studs is a category-defining ear piercing and earring brand named one of "the 10 most innovative companies in retail for 2023" by Fast Company. Studs connects ear piercing with aftercare and earring shopping to create an end-to-end Earscaping® experience. We offer a better retail and digital experience that prioritizes safety and expertise in a cool, fun and welcoming environment, along with a wide earring assortment—all at an accessible price point.
 
 
The Senior Manager of Product Development & Production is responsible for execution of proposed product and design. They will take the product from the proposed design state to commercialization including physical product development and final production. They will also be responsible for building out a team org structure and training new team members
 
 
**Salary Range:**
$130,000
 
 
**Key Responsibilities:**
Product Development
 
 

* Establish strategic partnerships with suppliers, manufacturers, and other vendors in order to develop new products or improve existing products
* Oversee the product life cycle of new products from concept to commercialization
* Develop and manage the development calendar with milestones that aligns with the organization's strategic objective
* Manage all vendor WIPs, sample requests and inbound samples
* Price negotiation to achieve margin goals
* Work with external partners on brand collaboration products and key initiatives

Production
 
 

* Oversee production process from PO placement through ex-factory including vendor payment and credits
* Ensure bulk goods produced conform with approved designs and standards
* Set factory allocation to ensure they align with factories' capacity supporting the businesses growth and key initiatives
* Negotiate bulk inventory costs, lead times and deliveries
* Manage and resolve any manufacturing issues including delivery delays with factories
* Communicate delivery timelines and collaborate with cross functional partners on product launches

Testing & Relations
 
 

* Foster and maintain vendor relationships
* Lead on boarding process ensuring factory and vendor adherence to Stud's processes and standards, and that clear understanding of processes and nuances between vendors is maintained
* Develop and monitor, and continually improve quality assurance procedures and processes with external testing vendors
* Ensure all products manufactured that will be commercially sold are tested to STUDS standards prior to shipment
* Evaluate, improve, and define processes and policies, process implementation, and identify errors and areas of improvement
* Address the root causes of quality issues, create corrective action plans and implement long term solutions in partnership with external vendors

**Requirements:**

* 5+ years of experience in product development and/or production, with hands-on ownership of products from concept through bulk delivery.
* Jewelry experience strongly preferred, but not required. Experience in accessories or another consumer product category is a plus.

new_roles.title: Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
**Salary:**
$180,000 - $220,000 annually

**Location:**
Onsite - Fremont, CA

**Job Summary:**

The Director of Operations will be responsible for overseeing and optimizing the company's operational processes to ensure efficiency, productivity, and the highest quality of service. This role involves strategic planning, management of operational teams, and implementation of best practices to support the company's goals and growth. The Director of Operations will work closely with senior leadership to align operational strategies with organizational objectives.

**Duties/Responsibilities:**

**Strategic Planning and Implementation**

* Develop and implement operational strategies that align with the company’s overall goals and objectives.
* Analyze operational performance and make recommendations for improvements.
* Ensure the effective execution of the company’s strategic initiatives.

**Team Management**

* Lead, mentor, and manage the operations team, including setting performance goals and conducting regular evaluations.
* Foster a positive and productive work environment that encourages team collaboration and professional development.

**Process Optimization**

* Identify opportunities for process improvements and efficiency gains across various departments.
* Implement best practices and standard operating procedures to enhance productivity and service quality.

**Financial Oversight**

* Develop and manage the operations budget, ensuring cost-effectiveness and alignment with financial targets.
* Monitor financial performance and report on key metrics related to operational efficiency and profitability.

**Quality Management**

* Oversee the quality management system to ensure adherence to industry standards and regulatory requirements.
* Address and resolve operational issues and customer complaints in a timely manner.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with other departments such as PM, Quality, and Engineering to ensure cohesive operational support and alignment.
* Coordinate with external partners, customers and vendors as needed.

**Data Analysis and Reporting**

* Utilize data analytics to track performance, identify trends, and make informed decisions.
* Prepare and present reports on operational performance to senior management.

**Compliance and Risk Management**

* Ensure that all operational activities comply with company policies, industry regulations, and legal requirements.
* Develop and implement risk management strategies to mitigate potential operational risks

**Skills/Competencies**

* Expertise in Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies.
* Strong knowledge of production planning, supply chain management, and quality assurance.
* Excellent leadership, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
* Proficiency in ERP systems and manufacturing software.

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in industrial engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, or a related field (MBA or advanced degree preferred).
* Minimum of 7 years of experience in manufacturing operations, including at least 10+ years in a leadership role.
* Proven track record of driving operational improvements and achieving production goals.

**Our company does not guarantee immigration sponsorship. We may offer immigration sponsorship for employees in select critical roles. Any sponsorship will be subject to internal review and approval based on employee performance, current immigration law and business needs.**

new_roles.title: Director, Continuous Improvement
new_roles.description:
**Job Description**
The Director, Continuous Improvement leads the Supply Chain-wide capability for identifying, prioritizing, enabling, and sustaining improvements that increase business performance and organizational effectiveness across functions and end-to-end processes. This role establishes a culture of continuous improvement, advances operational and business process excellence, and enables measurable improvements in productivity, cost, quality, service, and capacity.
 
 
Working closely with cross-functional Supply Chain leaders, this position standardizes processes, uses data and insights to prioritize opportunities, and implements sustainable solutions aligned with strategic objectives. The Director maintains a strong connection to frontline operations by working directly in Supply Chain Centers and other functional environments to understand processes firsthand and translate observations into meaningful improvements.
 
 
**What You’ll Do**

* Develop and execute a comprehensive Continuous Improvement strategy and multi-year roadmap aligned with Supply Chain priorities, and advise Supply Chain leadership on opportunities that improve productivity, efficiency, cost, service, quality, capacity, and organizational effectiveness.
* Lead the deployment of consistent Continuous Improvement methodologies, tools, governance, performance expectations, and resource prioritization across Supply Chain functions.
* Work directly with Supply Chain Centers and functional teams to observe work at the point of execution, identify process variation and non-value-added activities, and implement standardized processes, operating practices, management systems, standard work, and process controls.
* Lead cross-functional transformation and productivity initiatives, including process redesign, technology-enabled improvement, automation, and new ways of working, in partnership with functional leaders, the PMO, Finance, and other stakeholders.
* Establish measurable outcomes, baselines, KPI definitions, reporting standards, dashboards, and processes for tracking, validating, and sustaining financial benefits, productivity improvements, and business value.
* Build organizational Continuous Improvement capability through training, coaching, structured problem-solving, knowledge sharing, and the development of CI team members and functional leaders.
* Lead change management and cross-functional alignment, manage risks and barriers, strengthen process integration, and communicate priorities, progress, results, and recommendations to Supply Chain leadership and key stakeholders.

**What You’ll Bring**
In addition to the technical and functional requirements of this role, successful candidates demonstrate Domino's Hungry for MORE Ways of Working:
 
 
Be Curious
 
 

* Seeks clarity, asks thoughtful questions, and uncovers root causes to solve problems effectively.
* Actively pursues learning opportunities, applies feedback, and continuously develops new skills.

Connect the Dots
 
 

* Uses information and insights to identify opportunities and drive informed decisions.
* Builds strong partnerships across teams and considers the broader organizational impact of decisions.

Aim High
 
 

* Sets ambitious goals, challenges the status quo, and focuses on work that drives meaningful business results.
* Uses feedback and data to continuously improve performance and outcomes.

Shift Fast
 
 

* Adapts quickly to changing priorities and business needs while maintaining focus on results.
* Demonstrates resilience, sound judgment, and the ability to learn from setbacks.

Deliver More
 
 

* Takes ownership, executes with discipline, and consistently produces measurable results.
* Identifies opportunities to create additional value for customers, team members, and the business.

Leadership Expectations
 
 

* Builds and develops high-performing teams aligned to Domino’s Ways of Working.
* Creates accountability, fosters collaboration, and delivers results through others.
* Leads confidently through change while maintaining team engagement and performance.
* Demonstrates enterprise thinking and drives cross-functional alignment to achieve business goals.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Manufacturing, or a related discipline; an advanced degree or MBA is preferred.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in Continuous Improvement, Supply Chain, business transformation, operational excellence, or related disciplines, including demonstrated leadership experience in complex, cross-functional organizations.
* Demonstrated experience developing and executing Continuous Improvement strategies and delivering measurable business results across multiple functions or complex organizations.
* Strong knowledge and practical application of Lean Six Sigma, structured problem-solving, process optimization, standardization, and change management methodologies.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional improvement initiatives, influence stakeholders, and drive organizational change without direct authority.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience leading Continuous Improvement initiatives in manufacturing, distribution, logistics, or other complex operational environments, including the ability to engage frontline employees, site leaders, and senior executives to diagnose issues, implement solutions, and deliver measurable results.
* Strong business and financial acumen, including experience identifying, quantifying, and validating productivity improvements, cost savings, and business value.
* Well-developed team building and influencing skills, unquestioned integrity, and the experience and confidence to work effectively across multiple functions and levels of the organization.
* Experience developing performance management frameworks, leveraging data analytics, and translating insights into actionable business recommendations.
* Demonstrated ability to build organizational capability through coaching, talent development, and deployment of Continuous Improvement methodologies.
* Strong strategic thinking, communication, collaboration, and executive presentation skills.
* Experience managing complex improvement portfolios, prioritizing competing business needs, and delivering sustainable outcomes.
* Lean Six Sigma certification or equivalent demonstrated Continuous Improvement expertise is preferred.
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally, including Canada, as business needs require. Expected travel is up to 50%

Additional Information
 
 
Benefits:
 
 

* Paid Holidays and Vacation
* Medical, Dental & Vision benefits that start on the first day of employment
* No-cost mental health support for employee and dependents
* Childcare tuition discounts
* No-cost fitness, nutrition, and wellness programs
* Fertility benefits
* Adoption assistance
* 401k matching contributions
* 15% off the purchase price of stock
* Company bonus

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

new_roles.title: Director of Process Engineering & Continuous Improvement
new_roles.description:
The Director of Process Engineering & Continuous Improvement is the company's technical authority for how meals are made and the owner of its improvement engine. This hands-on leader combines deep manufacturing process engineering with a disciplined continuous improvement approach to make production operations more consistent, efficient, safe, and cost-effective across Mom's Meals.
 
 
The role will focus primarily on kitchen and production operations, supporting a highly automated manufacturing environment through process design, equipment performance, root cause problem solving, and structured improvement projects. The position will also support fulfillment operations by identifying automation and process opportunities that improve throughput, labor efficiency, accuracy, and customer service.
 
 
The Director partners closely with Production, Fulfillment, Supply Chain, Food Safety and Quality, Maintenance, R&D, IT, and Finance to execute strategic projects and deliver measurable, sustained improvement across the enterprise. This is a player-coach role: the Director is expected to engage directly on the production floor, lead technical problem solving, and develop the engineers and improvement practitioners on the team.
 
 
**This position will travel to our other facilities 25-50% at varying times.**
**Ideally, the selected candidate will work out of one of our Production facilities (Ankeny/Grinnell, IA, Oklahoma City, OK, or North Jackson, OH) but are open to remote for the right skills and experience.**
**Benefits**
Our employees enjoy a generous package of benefits that we are thrilled to provide, and feel is part of what makes us different as an employer. We value our team members, and this is one way we can show it.
 
 
**Benefits Include**

* PTO, holiday pay and holiday of choice
* 401(k) match
* Life insurance
* Short-term disability
* Health, dental and vision insurance
* Maternity/paternity leave
* Health savings account (HSA)
* Flex spending accounts (FSA) – health and dependent

**Position Responsibilities May Include, But Not Limited To**
Process & Technical Engineering
 
 

* Serve as the company's process authority for meal production, owning process design, line layouts, standard work, and process specifications for cooking, chilling, portioning, and packaging
* Lead structured process control plans, risk assessments, and capability studies to reduce variation and improve consistency
* Drive yield, discard, and portion-control improvements through engineering-based solutions
* Partner with Production, Food Safety and Quality, Maintenance and R&D teams to ensure process changes are validated, documented, and sustained on the production floor
* Reduce downtime and defects through root cause analysis and hands-on, engineering-based problem solving
* Evaluate emerging manufacturing technologies and process innovations that improve efficiency, quality, and scalability
* Ensure engineering and process solutions comply with USDA, FDA, food safety, sanitary design, and regulatory requirements

Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence
 
 

* Build and lead a multi-site continuous improvement program, maintaining a prioritized project portfolio with defined savings targets validated with Finance
* Champion Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and structured problem-solving methodologies (such as A3, DMAIC, value stream mapping, changeover reduction, and standard work)
* Drive waste reduction, productivity improvement, and labor optimization initiatives
* Evaluate operational KPIs, including OEE, yield, labor productivity, and discards, and use data analytics to prioritize improvement opportunities
* Coach kitchen and production leaders and engineers in structured problem solving, and ensure improvements are standardized and sustained
* Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement across operations

Kitchen & Production Engineering
 
 

* Lead engineering efforts supporting highly automated meal production operations
* Drive equipment performance, uptime, and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) improvements
* Identify ideal equipment required to produce Mom's Meals to specification at scale, including equipment that should be replaced or decommissioned and equipment that can deliver OEE improvements and a measurable return on investment
* Partner with Production leadership and Commercialization team to identify bottlenecks and improve throughput
* Lead facility expansion projects, line installations, equipment upgrades, and process redesign initiatives

Capital & Automation Projects
 
 

* Develop and manage the engineering capital plan, prioritizing projects by safety, quality, and measurable return
* Lead project prioritization, design, budgeting, vendor selection, implementation, and startup activities
* Ensure projects are completed safely, on time, and within budget
* Manage external engineering firms, contractors, equipment suppliers, and system integrators
* Build a practical, multi-year automation roadmap focused on productivity, yield, and labor efficiency
* Establish project governance, reporting, and post-implementation performance reviews

Maintenance & Reliability Partnership
 
 

* Partner with Maintenance leadership on standards for asset management, equipment lifecycle planning, and preventative, predictive, and reliability-centered maintenance practices
* Use maintenance KPIs, including downtime, PM completion rates, equipment failure rates, and maintenance costs, to prioritize engineering and improvement work

Leadership & Team Development
 
 

* Provide coaching, mentorship, and technical leadership to process engineering, continuous improvement, and engineering personnel
* Develop future engineering leaders, improvement practitioners, and technical subject matter experts
* Promote a culture focused on safety, engagement, accountability, and operational excellence

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related technical field
* 10+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience within manufacturing, food production, and highly automated operations, including leading process engineering or continuous improvement teams
* Hands-on experience applying Lean and Six Sigma tools, with a demonstrated record of delivering quantified, sustained savings and performance gains
* Strong process engineering skills, including process design, root cause analysis, process capability, statistical analysis, and OEE and yield analytics
* Demonstrated success leading capital projects and automation implementations, including equipment installations and line upgrades
* Working knowledge of industrial automation, controls, packaging systems, and manufacturing technologies
* Knowledge of Sanitary Design Principles and Standards for food manufacturing.
* Experience leading teams in regulated manufacturing environments
* Proven ability to influence cross-functional leaders and drive enterprise-wide change

**Preferred Skills And Experience**

* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification
* Food manufacturing, packaged goods, pharmaceutical, and automated distribution experience
* Experience with Industry 4.0 technologies, predictive maintenance, and digital manufacturing tools
* Experience managing and understanding facility utility controls, including HVAC, water, and steam systems
* Professional Engineer (PE) license or advanced technical degree

**Physical Requirements**
**Company Overview**
Mom’s Meals is a home-delivered meal service providing fully prepared, refrigerated meal solutions direct to homes nationwide since 1999. We provide seniors, patients recovering post-discharge and those managing a chronic condition with tailored nutrition solutions to manage their specific needs. If you are passionate about the well-being of others and have a strong sense of community, Mom’s Meals could be the place for you! We are a family operated business looking for fun, compassionate, and friendly people who want to make a difference in the lives of others.
 
 
**EEO**
Mom’s Meals complies with all applicable federal and state non-discrimination laws. Qualified applicants shall receive consideration for employment without regards to race, religion, national origin, ancestry, color, gender, age, disability, or veteran status.

new_roles.description:
**Job Description**
**About the role**
As the Director of Continuous Improvement, you’ll be the senior strategic leader driving operational excellence, transformation, and sustainable performance improvement across the enterprise. You’ll own the development, deployment, and governance of TERREPOWER’s global continuous improvement (CI) strategy — aligning it with business objectives and building a culture of innovation, accountability, and measurable results. It’s a high-impact role for a visionary change agent with deep Lean and Six Sigma expertise who can influence at every level and deliver real impact across diverse regions and functions.
 
 
**What You’ll Do**

* Strategic leadership — Define and execute a global CI strategy aligned with corporate goals, partner with executive leadership to identify high-value transformation opportunities, and establish enterprise-wide CI governance, frameworks, and performance standards.
* Operational excellence — Lead global CI initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, and other methodologies, standardize processes and best practices across regions, and drive measurable improvements in cost, quality, delivery, safety, and customer satisfaction.
* Change management & culture — Champion a culture of continuous improvement and data-driven decision-making, and build organizational capability through training, coaching, and certification programs.
* Performance management — Develop KPIs, dashboards, and reporting to track CI progress and ROI, run regular reviews with regional and functional leaders, and benchmark best practices to maintain competitive advantage.
* Team leadership — Develop regional CI teams and leaders, foster collaboration across geographies and business units, and drive talent development and succession planning.

**What You’ll Bring**
**Must-haves**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business, Operations, or a related field.
* 10+ years in continuous improvement, operational excellence, or transformation leadership, with proven success leading global or multi-site CI programs.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or Master Black Belt certification.
* Strong analytical, strategic-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder-influencing abilities across all levels of an organization.

**Nice-to-haves**

* Master’s degree (MBA or related discipline).
* Experience in sustainable manufacturing, supply chain, and/or complex global operations.
* Expertise in digital transformation, automation, or advanced analytics.
* Track record of delivering significant financial and operational impact.

**What We Offer**

* Compensation — Competitive base salary plus annual performance bonus.
* Health & wellness — Medical, dental, and vision coverage.
* Retirement — 401(k) with company match.
* Time off — Paid time off, holidays, and parental leave.

new_roles.title: Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
**Director of Operations – Beauty & Cosmetics Manufacturing**

**Lead. Innovate. Transform.**

**Location:**
Azusa, CA | On-Site

**Salary Range:**
$130,000 – $160,000 annually, depending on experience (DOE)

**Reports Directly to the CEO**

**Ready to Lead the Next Chapter of Manufacturing Excellence?**

At Westwood Laboratories, we're building the future of our operations, and we're looking for a
**driven, hands-on Director of Operations**
to help lead the transformation.

As an established FDA-registered contract manufacturer specializing in beauty, cosmetics, personal care, and OTC products, we're focused on strengthening operational excellence, embracing technology, and building scalable processes for continued growth.

**We're not looking for someone to simply manage operations. We want someone who can elevate them.**

This is a high-impact leadership opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environment, takes ownership, and knows how to turn challenges into results.

**What You'll Lead**

* **Operational Excellence:**
 Oversee Production, Compounding, Warehouse, and Facilities, driving efficiency, quality, productivity, and cost improvements.
* **Quality & Compliance:**
 Champion a quality-first culture, ensuring manufacturing operations consistently meet cGMP, FDA, safety, and customer requirements. Partner closely with Quality and Regulatory teams to strengthen compliance, process controls, and right-first-time execution.
* **KPIs & Accountability:**
 Establish meaningful performance metrics, dashboards, and systems that drive measurable results.
* **Digital Transformation:**
 Lead the transition from paper-based processes toward automation, improved ERP utilization, and data-driven operations.
* **People Leadership:**
 Develop high-performing teams, strengthen accountability, and create a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.
* **Strategic Execution:**
 Partner directly with the CEO to translate business priorities into action, lead cross-functional projects, and deliver results.
* **Continuous Improvement:**
 Implement Lean manufacturing practices, reduce downtime and waste, and optimize production performance.

**What You Bring**

* **Direct manufacturing experience in beauty, cosmetics, or personal care is essential.**
* 10+ years of progressive manufacturing experience with strong operations leadership.
* Proven success implementing KPIs, improving processes, and driving measurable operational improvements.
* Experience with ERP systems, manufacturing automation, and organizational transformation.
* **Strong experience operating in FDA-regulated, cGMP manufacturing environments**
 , with a demonstrated understanding of quality systems, compliance, documentation, deviation management, CAPA, and process controls.
* Strong knowledge of Lean manufacturing, cGMP, and FDA-regulated operations.
* A self-motivated, solutions-oriented leadership style with strong project management and execution skills.
* A hands-on, solutions-oriented leadership style with the confidence to make decisions, drive accountability, and collaborate directly with executive leadership

**Why Westwood?**

Because you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact.

new_roles.description:
**Job Description**
**Honeywell Aerospace**
is a leading provider of innovative aerospace products and services. Our products and solutions are found on virtually every commercial, defense, and space aircraft in the world. We are committed to delivering cutting-edge technologies that enhance the safety, efficiency, and performance of the aerospace industry. Our aerospace business unit encompasses a wide range of products and services, including aircraft engines, cockpit and cabin electronics, wireless connectivity systems, mechanical components, and more. We are at the forefront of advancements in aviation technology, constantly pushing the boundaries to create healthier air travel, more fuel-efficient aircraft, and safer skies.
 
 
With our high-speed Wi-Fi offerings, we enable seamless connectivity for passengers and crew, enhancing the in-flight experience and enabling real-time data transmission. Our solutions also contribute to more direct and on-time flight arrivals, improving overall travel efficiency. In addition to our core products, we provide value-adding services such as maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) to ensure the continued reliability and performance of aerospace systems. Our facilities and expertise support the Federal government and agencies, further strengthening our position in the aerospace industry.
 
 
At Honeywell Aerospace, we are committed to sustainability and environmental responsibility. We strive to develop technologies that reduce emissions, improve fuel efficiency, and minimize the environmental impact of aviation. With revenues of $17.5 billion in 2025 and approximately 21,000 employees globally, we are a key player in the aerospace industry. Our dedicated team of professionals works tirelessly to introduce state-of-the-art technology solutions that drive efficiency, productivity, and safety in high-growth businesses.
 
 
As an
**Aerospace Operating System Site Leader**
here at Honeywell Aerospace, you will be a critical leader in the development and site-wide deployment for the Aerospace Operating System (AOS), driving the transformation of operational performance across the site or multi sites.
 
 
You will partner closely with Site Leader and AOS Global Operations Leader to establish the AOS roadmap, align strategic priorities, and enable scalable implementation across functions within the site including but not exclusive to planning, materials, sourcing, and quality.
 
 
As the key thought leader and change agent, this individual will coach leaders, drive method development and continuous improvement initiatives, and optimize end-to-end supply chain processes spanning procurement, planning, production, distribution, and logistics to support long-term growth, operational efficiency, and cultural transformation.
 
 
**Responsibilities**
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Coordinates, prioritizes & organizes improvement events and AOS courses to create value for the unit
* Manages or leads relevant, strategic & operational business challenges
* Fosters a continuous improvement mindset with respective methods and tools
* Supports and/or orchestrates the Hoshin Kanri process for the site
* Supports and/or orchestrates productivity generation activities
* Coaches peers & key managers inside the unit on the promotion & use of AOS
* Acts as a thought leader for an Agile & Lean mindset
* Advances AOS through sharing of success stories & recognition of stakeholders
* Orchestrates, coaches & leads AOS community & key enablers
* Drives, motivates & manages AOS qualifications of employees
* Active member of the global, companywide AOS community
* Collaborate with the AOS office to execute the AOS strategy

**Qualifications**
**YOU MUST HAVE**

* 8+ years of practical application of Lean Manufacturing and Operating Systems principles and tools
* 8+ years of project management experience gained through both strategic and tactic change projects
* Business fluent in local language and English
* Experience influencing and communicating effectively with frontline employees, site leadership, and senior executives, including leading cross-functional initiatives and presenting business outcomes to leadership teams.
* Ability to travel to other locations for training or project support (limited)

**WE VALUE**

* A bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Management, Business, Engineering, or a related field.
* A Master of Business Administration is a plus
* Experience in various areas of operations is strongly preferred, i.e. production, planning, procurement, logistics or similar
* Successful track record in leading without formal authority
* Proven experiences in driving results & coaching teams/peers across departments
* Experience in developing and sustaining networks / communities
* Leadership qualities & experience in motivating and developing diverse teams
* 8 Years of Practical experience facilitating improvement events
* Ability to Inspire & lead without authority
* Alignment to Honeywell Aerospace values, behaviors and principles, with experience and focus on customer outcomes, transformation, innovation, end-to-end ownership, and teamwork
* Ability to be an active listener and empathetic
* Experience convincing & pro-active change driver
* Passionate about learning Aerospace OS Core Methods and tools
* Results & quality orientation
* Methodical & structured way of thinking
* High analytical capability

Must be a US Citizen due to contractual agreements
 
 
**Benefits**
Beyond a performance-driven salary, you'll work alongside dedicated experts on technology that's advancing aviation. As a Honeywell Aerospace employee, you're eligible for a comprehensive benefits package that includes:
 
 

* Employer-subsidized medical, dental, vision and life insurance
* Short-term and long-term disability coverage
* 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts and health savings accounts
* Employee assistance program and educational assistance
* Parental leave and 12 paid holidays
* Paid time off for vacation, personal and sick time

Explore your benefits: https://honeywellaerospacebenefits.com/
 
 
**POSTING TIMELINE**
The application period for the job is estimated to be 40 days from the job posting date; however, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.

new_roles.title: Director, Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
**Job Description**
**Company Overview**
Vertex is a global biotechnology company focused on investing in scientific innovation to create transformative medicines for people with serious diseases. Across our organization, we work with urgency, rigor, and collaboration to deliver therapies that improve patient outcomes and create long-term value.
 
 
**General Summary**
The Operational Excellence team serves as the process improvement and performance enablement backbone of CMTO, providing the improvement discipline, management systems, and change capabilities required to run, grow, and optimize Vertex’s commercial manufacturing network.
 
 
The Director, Operational Excellence leads the development and execution of CMTO’s Operational Excellence strategy and improvement portfolio. The role identifies and prioritizes performance improvement opportunities, leads structured problem-solving and transformation initiatives, and ensures improvements are implemented and sustained through effective change management, standard work, performance monitoring, and leadership accountability.
 
 
The Director also leads and develops the Operational Excellence team, building organizational capability, setting priorities, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and accountability. The role partners closely with Business Analytics, Network Performance, Manufacturing Operations, MS&T, Business Operations Leads, Quality, Supply Chain, and Finance to use performance insights to identify improvement priorities and deliver measurable business outcomes.
 
 
**Key Duties And Responsibilities**

* Operational Excellence Strategy & Initiative Execution
* Contribute to setting CMTO's operational excellence strategy, priorities, and success measures, aligned to enterprise and functional priorities
* Identify, prioritize, and drive execution of a portfolio of commercial manufacturing improvement and transformation initiatives — partnering with sites and functions while avoiding ownership of routine operations
* Lead initiatives targeting lead-time reduction, launch optimization, yield, and manufacturing success-rate improvements and COGM reduction through structured problem definition, root-cause analysis, options analysis, and ROI calculation
* Lead Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping, and structured problem-solving initiatives across technical and business processes
* Develop clear business cases, recommendations, and implementation plans for Operational Excellence initiatives, including expected benefits, resource requirements, risks, and measures of success.
* Manage and Lead the Operational Excellence Team
* Establish and communicate a clear vision, mission, and strategic direction for the Operational Excellence team, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and stakeholder expectations
* Partner with senior leadership to define team priorities, continuously reassessing and adjusting focus based on evolving business needs, operational risks, and strategic objectives
* Set clear performance expectations, goals, and development plans for team members; monitor progress, provide timely feedback, and hold the team accountable for results
* Remove organizational barriers and resolve escalated issues that impede team performance or delivery of key initiatives
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration, innovation, and accountability by coaching and mentoring team members in problem-solving, communication, and leadership skills
* Build organizational capability by identifying skill gaps, developing talent, and implementing training and succession plans that strengthen Operational Excellence competencies
* Communicate team objectives, progress, achievements, risks, and resource needs to senior leadership and key stakeholders, ensuring transparency and alignment across organization
* Promote cross-functional collaboration and strong stakeholder relationships to enable successful execution of Operational Excellence initiatives and sustainable business improvements
* Continuous Improvement & Change Execution
* Embed structured problem-solving, continuous improvement, and change execution into CMTO governance and operating rhythms, using performance insights provided by Business Analytics, Network Performance, and functional teams.
* Ensure improvements are implemented and sustained through effective change management, standard work, control plans, performance monitoring, and clear process ownership.
* Identify and deploy digital tools, automation, and process solutions that improve operational performance and the scalability of Operational Excellence practices.
* Community of Practice & Capability Building
* Operate as a community-of-practice leader for manufacturing operational excellence across internal manufacturing and supply chain, driving common standards, methods, and ways of working
* Mentor teams on Lean methods, structured problem-solving, and continuous improvement practices, and benchmark industry best practices to inform innovative approaches

**Knowledge And Skills**

* Strong leadership, communication, collaboration, and team building
* Proven ability to motivate teams and build team unity
* Demonstrated success implementing Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping, FMEA, Hoshin Kanri, and Change Management methodologies in GMP environments
* Proven experience leading improvement initiatives targeting lead-time reduction, launch optimization, yield improvement and COGM/COGs reduction
* Experience using operational data and performance insights to identify, prioritize, and measure improvement opportunities.
* Hands-on proficiency in data analysis, root-cause analysis, process analysis, and structured problem-solving
* Ability to quantify the operational and financial benefits of improvement initiatives and communicate clear recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Experience implementing and sustaining performance management systems, visual management, Standard Work, and Leader Standard Work.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word; experience with process mapping, statistical analysis, and Lean Six Sigma tools preferred.
* Ability to translate complex operational problems into clear improvement priorities, recommendations, and implementation plans.
* Ability to operate effectively in a matrixed environment with strong role clarity, partnering across Network Performance, Business Operations, Manufacturing Operations, MS&T, Finance, and Strategic Sourcing

**Education And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Life Sciences, Business, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred.
* Typically requires 8–12 years of experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, regulated manufacturing, supply chain, MS&T, Operational Excellence, or business transformation environments.
* Minimum 5 years of experience leading Operational Excellence, transformation, continuous improvement, or complex process-improvement initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience leading and developing teams.
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt required

At Vertex, we embrace continuous learning and encourage employees to stay informed on advances in AI, technology, automation, and industry trends. We seek talent who bring an external perspective, demonstrate curiosity and sound judgment, and thoughtfully adopt new capabilities that improve decision-making, drive innovation, increase efficiency, and help deliver better outcomes for patients.
 
 
**Pay Range**
$181,900 - $272,900
 
 
**Disclosure Statement**
The range provided is based on what we believe is a reasonable estimate for the base salary pay range for this job at the time of posting. This role is eligible for an annual bonus and annual equity awards. Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay, in accordance with federal and state requirements. Actual base salary pay will be based on a number of factors, including skills, competencies, experience, and other job-related factors permitted by law.
 
 
At Vertex, our Total Rewards offerings also include inclusive market-leading benefits to meet our employees wherever they are in their career, financial, family and wellbeing journey while providing flexibility and resources to support their growth and aspirations. From medical, dental and vision benefits to generous paid time off (including a week-long company shutdown in the Summer and the Winter), educational assistance programs including student loan repayment, a generous commuting subsidy, matching charitable donations, 401(k) and so much more.
 
 
**Flex Designation**
Hybrid-Eligible Or On-Site Eligible
 
 
**Flex Eligibility Status**
In this Hybrid-Eligible role, you can choose to be designated as:
 
 

* Hybrid: work remotely up to two days per week; or select
* On-Site: work five days per week on-site with ad hoc flexibility.

Note: The Flex status for this position is subject to Vertex’s Policy on Flex @ Vertex Program and may be changed at any time.
 
 
**Company Information**
Vertex is a global biotechnology company that invests in scientific innovation.
 
 
Vertex is committed to equal employment opportunity and non-discrimination for all employees and qualified applicants without regard to a person's race, color, sex, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, marital status, or any characteristic protected under applicable law. Vertex is an E-Verify Employer in the United States. Vertex will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities, in accordance with applicable law.
 
 
Any applicant requiring an accommodation in connection with the hiring process and/or to perform the essential functions of the position for which the applicant has applied should make a request to the recruiter or hiring manager, or contact Talent Acquisition at ApplicationAssistance@vrtx.com

new_roles.title: DIRECTOR OF HEALTHCARE QUALITY
new_roles.description:
**JOB SUMMARY:** Within the framework of the objectives and policies established by the Board of Directors of Franklin Primary Health Center, Inc., organizes and coordinates activities related to Healthcare Quality among all Franklin Primary Health Center’s clinical departments including Primary Care, Oral Health, Behavioral Health, Ryan White program, laboratory, performance improvement, etc. Plans and coordinates performance improvement activities in collaboration with the Deputy Director of Healthcare Quality Chief Medical Officer, Director of Nursing, Deputy Chief Operations Officer, Director of Behavioral Health, and Performance Improvement Manager. Participates in planning and policy formulation, with particular reference to the role, functions, and operations of the Center's clinical quality and performance improvement activities.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Coordinate and monitor clinical quality activities through the initiation of a clinical quality work plan that encompasses all clinical areas. Reports quarterly on the progress of the work plan to Chief Medical Officer. Coordinates an annual evaluation and update of the quality work plan.
* Works as a liaison between Franklin and other entities in matters pertaining to clinical quality and performance.
* Assists the Chief Medical Officer by working with all areas of clinical services to improve efficiency, communication and collaboration.
* Ensures compliance to accreditation standards, other regulatory standards, quality and initiatives.
* Coordinates the peer review process.
* Provides quality indicator analysis for the physician’s quality incentive program.
* Monitors and keeps abreast of any changes or trends in the healthcare quality area.
* Addresses through the appropriate channels any potential risk and safety issues identified through clinical quality activities.
* Publishes and monitors standards of care for the providers and the nursing department.
* Monitors the provision of quality patient care through the Chief Medical Officer and the Director of Nursing with data from Azara and EHR.
* Evaluates all clinical services and consults with Chief Medical Officer and Quality Committee.
* Supervises the Performance Improvement functions of the Performance Improvement Department.
* Develops and implements standards, goals and initiatives for the Performance Improvement department in coordination with the Deputy Director of Healthcare Quality, Performance Improvement Manager and Chief Medical Officer.
* Responsible for developing, administering, and managing the Center’s performance improvement plan.
* Provides educational support to all FPHC departments with regard to performance improvement
* Monitors and ensures Joint Commission, NCQA and OSV standards of compliance on an ongoing basis, maintaining a constant state of readiness for survey
* Reviews all clinical indicators on a regular basis including but not limited to UDS Quality Measures and makes recommendations as needed to ensure the department’s performance improvement activities are effective.
* Review Performance data presented by PI committee and identify opportunities for improvement and presents findings quarterly to Senior Management.
* Actively participates and/or facilitates committees such as: Performance Improvement, Safety and Infection Control.
* Other duties at the discretion of the Chief Medical Officer.

**ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Maintains current Alabama Nursing License and board certification. Remains abreast of current employee health practices and guidelines through continuing education classes, journals and professional organizations.
* Attends continuing education classes/webinars related to infection control practices, monitoring and surveillance of infectious disease processes within the organization.
* Attends seminars and continuing education related to Healthcare Quality trends and initiatives.
* Maintains webinars confidentiality.
* Observes and supports Center policies.
* Is prompt and efficient with minimal absences.

**CUSTOMER SATISFACTION REQUIREMENTS:** Must provide the very best customer satisfaction to staff, visitors, guests, and patients at all time in a professional and courteous manner. Provide assistance in resolving customers’ problems relating to employee services. Coordinates efforts and interfaces with other departments to resolve complaints and patient care deficiencies.

**PERFORMANCE STANDARDS:** Performance will be evaluated by the Chief Medical Officer annually wherein an overall satisfactory rating is considered as a minimum acceptable level of performance.

**HEALTH AND SAFETY REQUIREMENTS:** The health and safety requirements described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

* Must adhere to safety regulations, personnel policies and procedures.
* Safety and Hazard Communication training update is required annually.
* Knowledgeable of OSHA and CLIA requirements to assure compliance.
* Maintain yearly health maintenance by obtaining TB skin testing and completion of the hepatitis series.

**PRIVACY RULE COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS:**

* Adheres to Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA Privacy Rule) policies and procedures.
* Must successfully complete Privacy Rule compliance training annually or as revisions are made to the policies and procedures.
* Must comply with Privacy Rule guidelines by learning to protect FPHC patient’s medical privacy.
* Must comply with Privacy Rule guidelines by appropriately maintaining our patient information in compliance with national standards.
* Must comply with Privacy Rule guidelines by providing appropriate security of FPHC patient records.

**PROTECTED HEALTH INFORMATION (PHI) ACCESS: RESTRICTED-** For purposes of HIPAA Compliance, there are 4 workforce categories, which define the level of access to PHI that is granted to the incumbent. This position is classified as **PRIMARY PROVIDERS** and therefore granted **UNRESTRICED access**- for the purpose of providing patient care; **RESTRICTED** access for other uses and disclosures, to be defined according to the purpose for which use or disclosure is intended. Use and disclosure must be in accordance with applicable privacy policies and procedures.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE: Minimum of Bachelor’s Degree and 5 years’ experience working with Quality Management (QM) in a healthcare setting or 5 or more years’ demonstrated management and supervisory skills in a healthcare setting. Possess strong managerial, administrative, and effective communication skills. Nursing licensed and/or certified professional healthcare quality (CPHQ) in the state of Alabama preferred.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES: Demonstrated clinical competence. Demonstrate appropriate conduct, grooming and sound judgment. Demonstrated ability to work cooperatively and communicate effectively. Good health and consistent attendance. Membership and participation in AL Board of Nursing Association. Possess the ability to delegate duties effectively and efficiently. Ability to read, analyze and interpret clinical data, quality measures, and governmental regulations. Possess ability to write professional reports, letters and procedural manuals. Ability to present information and respond to questions from diverse professional and community groups effectively.

CERTIFICATION, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS: State of Alabama Registered Nurses License; CPR certification; Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality (CPHQ) certification preferred

**PHYSICAL/MENTAL REQUIREMENTS:** Requires working under stressful conditions or working irregular hours. Must be able to express ideas clearly and concisely; and exercise balanced judgment in evaluating situations and making decisions. Possess strong oral and written communication skills. Knowledge of the professional nursing theory and practice to direct, give, and evaluate patient care processes for the department. Knowledge

new_roles.title: Head of Global Quality Strategic Initiatives
new_roles.description:
**Job Description:**

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Head of Global Quality Strategic Initiatives is responsible for defining, leading and executing enterprise-wide initiatives that strengthen TransMedics’ global quality management system (QMS), enhance regulatory compliance, improve product quality and patient safety, and advance operational excellence across the product lifecycle.

Partnering closely with executive leadership and cross-functional teams, this leader translates business priorities into measurable quality outcomes. The role drives complex transformation programs, anticipates emerging quality and regulatory risks, and establishes the processes, governance and metrics needed to support growth while maintaining high standards of safety, effectiveness and compliance.

The successful candidate combines deep medical device quality and regulatory expertise with strategic vision, strong business acumen and exceptional program leadership, with the ability to influence at every level of a global organization.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

This position is responsible for, but not limited to, the following:

* Develop and execute a multi-year global quality roadmap aligned with business priorities, regulatory expectations and patient safety. Identify systemic issues and emerging risks, prioritize transformation initiatives, and integrate quality priorities into business planning, product development and growth.
* Lead a portfolio of cross-functional quality programs with clear scope, milestones, resources, accountability and measurable outcomes. Establish executive steering committees, decision rights and escalation paths; resolve barriers, recommend investment priorities and track business impact and sustained results.
* Improve and harmonize the global QMS in line with FDA QMSR (21 CFR Part 820), ISO 13485, EU MDR and other applicable requirements. Strengthen process ownership, management review and effectiveness monitoring while accommodating regional requirements and local operating needs.
* Oversee improvement programs spanning document and records management, design and manufacturing controls, risk management, supplier quality, nonconformance, corrective and preventive action (CAPA), change control and post-market processes.
* Partner with Regulatory Affairs and site Quality leaders to assess regulatory changes and lead enterprise remediation programs addressing audit findings, regulatory observations and emerging risks. Support FDA inspections and external audits, resolve root causes, and embed sustainable inspection readiness.
* Define enterprise quality KPIs and key risk indicators covering CAPA effectiveness, complaints, nonconformances, audit findings, suppliers and product quality. Build consistent dashboards and executive reporting that improve visibility into risks, trends and program progress.
* Sponsor electronic QMS, quality data integration, advanced analytics and appropriate AI-enabled initiatives within applicable validation, privacy, security and regulatory controls. Promote data integrity, traceability and evidence-based decisions.
* Partner with functional leaders to strengthen product risk management, complaint handling, adverse event reporting, field action assessment and post-market monitoring from development and design transfer through manufacturing and post-market surveillance. Lead analysis of recurring issues and systemic failure modes to improve detection, containment and prevention.
* Apply Lean, Six Sigma and risk-based problem-solving to reduce rework, scrap, variation and the cost of poor quality while protecting compliance and patient safety. Partner with Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain and site leaders to improve process capability and supplier performance, replicate best practices and measure benefits.
* Advise the Chief Regulatory Officer and executive leadership on quality priorities, systemic risks and transformation opportunities; communicate with the Board as appropriate. Influence priorities and resource decisions, mentor quality and program leaders, and lead training and change management that build accountability, transparency and lasting quality ownership.
* Collaborate with IT/Digital, Finance, Human Resources and other internal partners, and engage regulatory authorities, notified and certification bodies, external auditors, strategic suppliers, consultants and industry organizations as needed.
* Success will be measured by on-time transformation milestones; stronger QMS effectiveness and consistency; fewer recurring issues, overdue corrective actions and repeat audit findings; sustained inspection readiness; and measurable improvements in product quality, complaint trends, supplier performance and cost of poor quality.
* Perform other TransMedics tasks and duties as assigned.

**MANAGEMENT RESPONSIBILITIES**

Convene and lead cross-functional teams, establish program governance, and develop and mentor quality and program leaders within the approved mandate, budget and governance structure. Direct-report responsibilities are to be confirmed. Formal authority for regulatory decisions, product disposition, quality approvals and regulatory reporting remains with the accountable functions under company procedures.

**PHYSICAL ATTRIBUTES**

This is an on-site role in Andover or Somerville, MA, with approximately 10–20% travel. Additional essential physical requirements, if applicable, are to be confirmed.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

 

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Quality, Regulatory Affairs or a related technical discipline.
* 15+ years of progressive experience in medical devices, combination products or another highly regulated healthcare industry, including significant leadership experience in Quality, Regulatory Affairs, quality transformation or enterprise program management.
* Proven success leading complex quality improvement, remediation or organizational change programs across business units, manufacturing sites and geographies, translating strategy into executable plans and measurable, sustainable results.
* Strong knowledge of FDA medical device requirements, including QMSR, and working knowledge of ISO 13485, ISO 14971, EU MDR and applicable global medical device frameworks.
* Hands-on experience with CAPA, nonconformances, complaints, design controls, supplier quality, change management, audits, remediation and post-market surveillance; understanding of root cause analysis, process validation, manufacturing controls and QMS effectiveness.
* Familiarity with electronic QMS platforms, quality data analytics and computerized system validation or assurance (CSV/CSA) principles.
* Ability to influence senior executives and stakeholders in a global matrix organization, communicate complex issues clearly, and drive decisions without relying on direct authority.
* Demonstrated strategic thinking, analytical problem-solving, change leadership and talent development, with sound risk-based judgment, integrity and accountability for product quality, patient safety and regulatory compliance.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

 

* Advanced degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Business Administration or a related field.
* Professional certifications in quality (ASQ CQE or CMQ/OE), regulatory affairs (RAC), program management (PMP), Lean Six Sigma or change management.
* Experience with MasterControl.

As part of our long-term growth plans, TransMedics is excited to announce our plan to relocate our headquarters (HQ) to Somerville, MA by 2028. We chose this location because we believe it is a place where innovation will thrive. Our new state-of-the-art headquarters is designed to support collaboration, creativity, and discovery. We believe this will be a place where we can continue to do things few thought possible in organ transplantation to help patients. *Specific timing and role impact may vary.*

TransMedics, Inc. is a commercial-stage medical technology company transforming organ transplant therapy for patients worldwide. Our mission is to help save more patients’ lives by increasing access to viable donor organs for those who are awaiting an organ transplant. To accomplish this mission, we partner closely with transplant stakeholders worldwide and help expand their access to healthy donor organs, while delivering the highest quality technology, service, clinical care and outcomes. 
 
Driven by a passion for improving patient care, we make the impossible possible and keep our employees at the center of everything we do. Together, we strive to enhance the quality of life for transplant recipients and their families, fostering hope and healing in the journey toward better health. 
 
**Maximize your potential at TransMedics, Inc.** 
www.TransMedics.com

TransMedics is committed to equitable and transparent compensation. The expected base salary range for this role is $232,800-$331,350, which represents the company’s current good-faith estimate of compensation for this position. Actual salary will depend on factors such as, but not limited to, candidate experience, qualifications, skills, and the specific work location. This role may also be eligible for bonuses, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package (medical, dental, vision, retirement savings, paid time off, and wellness resources). We comply with all U.S. pay transparency laws and do not request or consider salary history.

**Employee Benefit:**

Medical with Health Reimbursement Account through Blue Cross/Blue Shield of MA

Dental

Vision

Healthcare Flexible Spending Account

Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account

Short Term Disability

Long Term Disability

401K Plan

Pet insurance

Employee Stock Purchase Plan

TransMedics is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, marital status, age, disability or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

new_roles.description:
Overview:

Join the Cedar Crest leadership team as the Director of Quality! Situated on over 30 acres in the beautiful rolling hills of Central Texas, Cedar Crest provides innovative behavioral health and substance abuse treatment for children, adolescents, and adults. Our private campus includes walking trails, picnic areas, outdoor swimming pool, full-size gym, and state-of-the-art exercise equipment; providing opportunities for leisure, therapeutic recreation, and team building skills. Cedar Crest provides a full continuum of care including adolescent residential, inpatient, outpatient, and partial hospitalization/intense outpatient treatments.

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Director of Quality and Accreditation to lead our facility’s efforts in ensuring the highest standards of patient care and safety. This leadership role is responsible for overseeing regulatory compliance, quality assurance programs, and continuous improvement initiatives across all clinical and operational areas. The Director will guide the development and implementation of quality protocols, manage accreditation processes, and lead the Quality Assurance and Process Improvement (QAPI) program. The ideal candidate will be a proactive, strategic thinker with a strong commitment to achieving excellence in care delivery and regulatory readiness.

**PURPOSE STATEMENT:**

The Director of Quality and Accreditation is responsible for ensuring patient safety and superior quality of care as measured by survey readiness, treatment program fidelity, and compliance with state and federal laws and regulations and accreditation standards. As such, the Director is responsible for leading and overseeing all aspects of policy development; comprehensive implementation of Acadia’s prescribed clinical protocols, operational quality oversight standards, and programmatic expectations; critical incident reporting; regulatory engagement, including development and submission of plans of correction; certification achievement and maintenance; oversight of the quality assurance and process improvement (QAPI) program; and on-going regulatory readiness strategies at the facility. Through routine physical presence in patient care areas, data analysis and documentation monitoring, and intentional sharing of deep subject-matter expertise, the Director will ensure a proactive, multidisciplinary focus on quality and excellence within the facility.

Responsibilities:

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Lead and monitor day-to-day regulatory readiness, patient safety, and service excellence across the facility.
* QAPI program oversight and management – follow and develop processes for identification, collection, and analysis of quality performance data.
 + Utilize collected data regarding the outcome of activities for delivering continuously improving services.
 + Conduct annual preparation and evaluation of the facility QAPI Program.
 + Complete process improvement projects and incorporate the results into patient care improvements.
 + Submit quality scorecard data to Acadia corporate office as requested.
 + Coordinate the abstraction of clinical data according to Joint Commission specifications and data entry via vendor database for Inpatient Psychiatric Core Measures (ex. national quality measures such as HBIPS).
 + Identify key aspects of care relevant indicators and evaluation of data using formal and informal feedback from consumers of services and other collateral sources is aggregated and used to improve management strategies and service delivery practices.
 + Lead/coordinate data collection and analysis from all departments within the facility.
 + Prepare and present program data trends and action plans to the monthly Quality Council and quarterly to the Medical Executive Committee and the Governing Board.
* Regulatory preparedness – implement sustainable survey preparation and ongoing monitoring processes, including facility-wide auditing and early-issue identification, to maximize achievement of zero- or standard-level survey outcomes.
 + Facility-wide support – collaborate with other departments to sustainably implement best-practices in regulatory/accreditation compliance as evidenced by measurable results with regard to survey outcomes, patient safety metrics, patient experience results, HBIPS, etc.
 + Develop and maintain proficiency in regulatory planning strategy for all standards for all relevant regulatory and accrediting bodies at the local, state, and federal level.
 + Develop and maintain proficiency in the functionality and auditing within electronic platforms such as electronic patient observations and the electronic medical record, as applicable.
 + Lead Root-Cause Analyses and conduct timely and regular evaluation of serious incidents, complaints, grievances and related investigations to:
 - Identification of events, trends and patterns that may affect client health, safety and or treatment efficacy,
 - Committee evaluation findings and recommendations submitted to agency management for corrective action,
 - Implemented actions, outcomes, trends analyzed over time
 + Develop corrective action plans for the resolution of areas of regulatory vulnerability or those which could compromise patient safety in collaboration with other facility leaders.
 + Ensure proper reporting of violations or potential violations to duly authorized enforcement agencies as appropriate and/or required.
 + Ensure proper reporting of incidents and adverse clinical outcomes to duly authorized enforcement agencies or regulatory agencies as appropriate and/or required.
 + In conjunction with assigned corporate Division Quality Director, initiate and lead communications with regulatory agencies as appropriate.
 + Develop sustainable performance improvement practices through analysis of data and prioritization of efforts to improve survey readiness and consistency of care delivery using expected best-practices.
 + Ensure multidisciplinary ownership of best-practices in self-monitoring, auditing, and process improvement, escalating opportunities for improved engagement to the facility CEO as appropriate.
 + Ensures strategic and operational implementation of regulatory requirements, guidelines, and standards of federal, state, and local licensing agencies, accrediting and certifying organizations.
 + Collaborates with Division and Corporate entities and external parties to ensure strategic quality and patient safety initiatives are fully executed at the facility level. Facilitates effective communication with facility and division leadership regarding key clinical performance improvement activities and initiatives.
 + Serves as a technical advisor, educator and internal consultant to all hospital management, staff, and physicians on the use of performance improvement tools and techniques, analytical techniques, and statistical applications.
 + Ensure facility compliance with policies and applicable standards as required by regulatory/accrediting bodies.
 + Facility leader and subject matter expert on high reliability principles and strategies to achieve zero harm.

* Clinical program excellence – assess fidelity and identify root-causes for gaps/lapses in fidelity to Acadia standards. Support other departments in developing and implementing remediation and improvement plans to achieve fidelity to Acadia’s expected practices, including all elements of treatment program implementation.
* + Develop, review, and educate on internal clinical procedures and appropriate use of outcome evaluation tools and the associated results – including patient experience data and other quality scorecard metrics – to ensure continuous quality improvement and ongoing compliance with federal, state, and third-party regulatory requirements.
 + Translate standards, requirements, and policies into terms or processes meaningful to the facility.
* Leadership – serve as a visible, engaged, and dynamic member of the facility leadership team.
 + Chairs the monthly Quality Council
 + Complete safety rounds, participate in leadership rounding, and submit results/corrective actions to Acadia corporate office.
 + Review incident/safety concerns with the leadership team to identify systemic issues and facilitate the development of corrective actions.
 + Lead and facilitate Root Cause Analyses into all serious and/or sentinel events.
 + Invest in the facility staff through engagement in hiring, development, training, performance management, and communication to ensure effective and efficient operations.
 + Oversees the Culture of Safety Survey and follow-up action planning and sustainment processes.
 + Identification of problems or potential problems to prevent risks to patients and staff. Proposes corrective steps that may include, but are not limited to:
 - Changes in policies/procedures,
 - Staffing and assignment changes,
 - Additional education or training for staff,
 - Addition or deletion of services

**OTHER FUNCTIONS:**

* Perform other functions and tasks as assigned.

Qualifications:

**EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE/SKILL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Human Services or nursing required. Master’s degree in behavioral health/risk discipline, Registered Nurse preferred.
* Two or more years of experience in a Quality, Clinical, or PI role required.
* One or more years of management experience preferred.
* Experience with CARF, DEA, Joint Commission, or CMS surveys, as required by service line(s) supported

**LICENSES/DESIGNATIONS/CERTIFICATIONS:**

* Current licensure appropriate for the degree held required.
* CPR and de-escalation/restraint certification required (training available upon hire and offered by facility).
* First aid may be required based on state or facility.

**ADDITIONAL REGULATORY REQUIREMENTS:**

***While this job description is intended to be*** ***an accurate*** ***reflection of the requirements of the job, management reserves the right to add or remove duties from*** ***par******ticular jobs*** ***when circumstances*** 
***(******e.g.*** ***emergencies, changes in workload, rush jobs or technological developments) dictate.***

We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants for employment regardless of an individual’s characteristics protected by applicable state, federal and local laws.

AHCORP
