new_roles.title: Director of Manufacturing
new_roles.description:
Director of Manufacturing

**POSITION SUMMARY**
====================

Weaver Popcorn is seeking an experienced manufacturing leader to direct the **Malden, Missouri** operation and strengthen safety, quality, service, cost performance, throughput, and associate development. The Director of Manufacturing provides strategic and hands-on leadership for plant operations, maintenance, sanitation, scheduling, grower partnership, and continuous improvement while ensuring reliable execution of annual operating priorities.

This leader will establish clear performance expectations, develop plant leadership and frontline capability, optimize equipment and labor effectiveness, and partner across Quality, Field Operations, Supply Chain, Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, and Continuous Improvement to deliver sustainable operational and financial results.

**HOW WILL YOU HELP US GROW?**
==============================

**Manufacturing & Operational Leadership**
------------------------------------------

* Lead the Malden manufacturing operation with accountability for safety, quality, service, cost, throughput, schedule attainment, sanitation, labor effectiveness, and overall plant performance.
* Establish clear operational standards, performance goals, equipment expectations, and operating cost objectives aligned with the annual plan.
* Drive reliable production output and efficient growth by ensuring the right equipment, staffing, operating systems, and performance measures are in place.
* Lead regular operating reviews with plant leadership to evaluate productivity, downtime, quality, staffing, schedule attainment, and corrective actions.
* Ensure manufacturing systems, procedures, and policies are consistently deployed, understood, and followed across assigned operations.
* Align internal manufacturing capabilities with customer needs, production schedules, raw-material availability, and growth expectations.

**Safety, Quality & Food Manufacturing Compliance**
---------------------------------------------------

* Provide visible leadership for a safe workplace and hold leaders accountable for proactive hazard identification, corrective action, training, and compliance.
* Partner closely with Quality leadership to ensure compliance with food safety and quality requirements, including HACCP, GMPs, sanitation standards, product controls, and applicable regulatory and customer requirements.
* Support disciplined investigation and sustainable corrective action for safety events, quality deviations, operational failures, customer concerns, and recurring performance issues.
* Ensure plant practices support audit readiness, traceability, sanitation effectiveness, and consistent production of safe, conforming product.
* Reinforce the authority and responsibility to stop or correct work when safety, food safety, quality, or regulatory requirements are not being met.

**Continuous Improvement, Reliability & Capital**
-------------------------------------------------

* Deploy Lean manufacturing, Statistical Process Control, and structured problem-solving methods to improve throughput, yield, reliability, labor efficiency, and cost performance.
* Identify operational failures and constraints, establish root causes, implement corrective actions, and verify sustained effectiveness.
* Develop and maintain meaningful manufacturing KPIs and equipment-efficiency measures that support timely, fact-based decisions.
* Partner with Maintenance and plant leaders to improve equipment reliability, preventive maintenance effectiveness, space utilization, and production capacity.
* Jointly establish capital expenditure priorities and lead effective execution of approved capital and process-improvement projects.
* Challenge existing practices, standardize successful improvements, and build continuous-improvement capability throughout the operation.

**Grower, Supply Chain & Cross-Functional Partnership**
-------------------------------------------------------

* Collaborate with Field Operations to support grower relationships, contracted acreage plans, raw-material supply, and growth objectives.
* Partner with Supply Chain and plant scheduling teams to balance customer requirements, inventory, capacity, labor, and raw-material availability.
* Work with Finance and Information Technology to strengthen business processes, operating data, management reporting, budgeting, and decision-support tools.
* Contribute the manufacturing perspective to companywide initiatives led by Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, Quality, and other functional leaders.
* Communicate operational risks, priorities, tradeoffs, and performance clearly to senior leadership and cross-functional partners.

**People Leadership & Talent Development**
------------------------------------------

* Lead, coach, and develop plant leaders and assigned functional leaders; establish clear goals, accountabilities, performance expectations, and development plans.
* Build a culture of excellence, ownership, accountability, engagement, and continuous improvement at every level of the operation.
* Develop internal talent, strengthen succession readiness, and partner with Human Resources to recruit and retain a capable workforce.
* Build associate competency through effective training, qualification, coaching, and skills-development programs.
* Use a visible, participative leadership style that communicates direction, listens for understanding, addresses conflict directly, and earns followership.

**WHAT DO YOU NEED TO HAVE?**
=============================

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, Business, Operations Management, or a related field.
* 15+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, including at least 10 years in a Plant Manager or comparable senior manufacturing leadership role; food or agricultural processing experience strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated success applying Lean manufacturing, Statistical Process Control, root-cause analysis, and structured problem-solving methods to improve throughput, equipment efficiency, labor productivity, yield, and cost performance.
* Experience leading workplace safety, food manufacturing quality systems, sanitation, GMPs, HACCP-based programs, and compliance with applicable regulatory requirements.
* Proven financial acumen, including budgeting, P&L accountability, capital prioritization, and analysis of manufacturing KPIs and cost drivers.
* Demonstrated success developing leaders, strengthening organizational capability, managing change, and building accountability in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, sound judgment, and the ability to influence senior leaders and cross-functional partners.
* Ability to travel regionally approximately 15% and remain available outside normal business hours when operational needs require support.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Leadership experience in popcorn, corn, grain, ingredient, food processing, or a related agricultural manufacturing environment.
* Experience leading capital projects, technical teams, maintenance-reliability programs, and high-engagement employee relations.
* Formal training or certification in Lean, Six Sigma, safety, continuous improvement, or project leadership.
* Experience partnering directly with growers or agricultural supply networks.

**WHERE & WHEN WILL YOU WORK?**
===============================

This role operates across office, agricultural, warehouse, and food manufacturing environments and requires regular presence in production areas. The typical schedule is Monday through Friday; however, the Director of Manufacturing must be available outside normal business hours, including occasional evenings or weekends, when safety, quality, customer, staffing, equipment, or other operational needs require support. Regional travel of approximately 15% is expected, with additional travel based on business needs.

**WHAT DOES SUCCESS LOOK LIKE?**
================================

* Strong, sustained performance in safety, quality, service, cost, throughput, schedule attainment, and customer satisfaction.
* Improved equipment reliability, operating efficiency, labor effectiveness, yield, and cost performance supported by clear KPIs.
* Consistent execution of manufacturing, sanitation, food safety, quality, and operating standards.
* Disciplined problem solving that reduces recurring failures and produces measurable, sustained improvement.
* A capable and accountable plant leadership team with clear goals, stronger bench strength, and active development plans.
* Effective partnership across Quality, Field Operations, Supply Chain, Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, and Continuous Improvement.
* Credible, visible leadership that builds ownership, engagement, and confidence throughout the Malden operation.

**HOW WILL WE HELP YOU GROW?**
==============================

* Competitive compensation.
* Three weeks of paid time off in the first year.
* 401(k) plan with a company match of 100% of employee deferrals up to 10%.
* Health, vision, dental, life, and disability insurance beginning the first day of the month following 30 days of employment.
* Education reimbursement of up to $15,000 per year.

**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY**
================================

Weaver Popcorn is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and associates. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, without regard to any status protected by applicable law.

*The role responsibilities are many, various, and not limited to those written in this document.*

new_roles.title: Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
Description:

**About Us**

Family-owned and operated since 1970, we are an industry-leading gas distributor founded on unparalleled customer service. Our industrial, medical, food, and specialty gas products support a variety of industries that work daily to improve the world we live in, and our ongoing commitment to serve spans the southwestern United States with 16 locations across California and Arizona. Discover the most interesting industry you’ve never heard of!

**Position Overview**

The Plant Manager oversees the daily operations on the plant floor while enhancing production and revenue. You will manage scheduling, supervise daily operating reports, and boost production by providing leadership and developing strategic plans.

**Essential Functions**

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

* Lead, manage, and develop plant employees to ensure they possess the necessary capabilities and culture to maintain effective operations. This includes establishing direction, gaining commitment, delegating responsibilities, and building organizational capabilities
* Ensure all staff members adhere to OSHA general standards related to manufacturing facility safety protocols
* Responsible for maintaining the facility, including understanding and explaining basic mechanical theory to direct reports, coordinating with vendors, and projecting and establishing preventative maintenance programs and schedules while directing the maintenance staff to ensure all equipment is properly maintained and operational
* Workforce Planning/Scheduling
* Ensure our products meet or exceed quality control standards using specified SOP testing methods
* Manage notable projects and improvements as directed
* Create a work environment that ensures the safety and health of employees, the community, and the environment
* Focus on continuously improving the competitiveness of operations
* Recognize customer commitment and drive activities for ongoing quality improvement
* In conjunction with senior group management, establish and oversee activities to meet short- and long-term plant goals
* Improve efficiency and capacity through capital expenditure improvements in processes and procedures and through both formal and informal continuous improvement activities
* Conduct monthly safety meetings as needed
* Other duties as assigned

Requirements:

* 5 years of experience in production management
* Ability to operate or willingness to train for forklift operation
* Production/distribution experience required; industrial gas industry or equivalent experience preferred
* In-depth knowledge of cylinder gases and processes of each
* Knowledge of all regulatory agencies including, but not limited to, FDA, DOT, OSHA, and EPA
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills; ability to communicate effectively with customers, employees, and management
* Ability to lift 50 pounds and stand for extended periods
* Proficient computer skills, including Microsoft applications, TIMS CU

**Supervisory Responsibility**

Manages direct reports

**Physical Demands**

The physical demands described here represent those that an employee must meet to perform the essential functions of this job successfully.

While performing this job, the employee must stand for long periods, talk, hear, and use hands and fingers to operate a computer and telephone, reach, stoop, and kneel. This person must be able to lift, carry, or set down 50+ pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision requirements due to computer work.

**Travel**

No travel is expected for this position

**Position Type and Expected Hours of Work**

This is a full-time, exempt, and on-site position. Typical days and hours of work are Monday through Friday, and range from 6:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Individual and company performance-based quarterly bonuses as outlined in our plan documents
* Annual performance-based merits
* Comprehensive benefits package:
 + Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
 + Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
 + Voluntary accident coverage, hospitalization plans, Employee Assistance Programs (EAP’s), Wellness platform access
 + 401(k) + company match
* 7 company-paid holidays
* 3 weeks of paid time off (PTO) earned on an accrual basis
* Professional development opportunities and ongoing training
* Healthy work/life balance and a collaborative and inclusive company culture

The compensation range reflects WestAir’s good-faith estimate for the base compensation expected at the time of posting. Compensation offered will be determined by the job-related factors, including skills, experience, qualifications, education, and geographic location.

This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. An employee may perform other related duties as negotiated to meet the organization’s ongoing needs.

WestAir Gases and Equipment, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

new_roles.title: Director, Facility Operations
new_roles.description:
**Director, Facility Operations** 
The 3-time WNBA Champions Los Angeles Sparks are seeking an innovative, strategic, and revenue-driven **Director, Facility Operations**. This executive will be responsible for working with both in-house employees and 3rd party vendors, and will oversee the day-to-day upkeep and operation of the Los Angeles Sparks’ Training Facility.

**PRINCIPAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Oversee the operation of building systems and equipment, including mechanical, electrical, plumbing, hydro, and food service equipment and direct the work of personnel associated with the systems and building engineering.
* Serve at the primary point of contact for building maintenance, repairs, and facilities-related service requests across all organizational spaces, including offices and venues.
* Assist in the development and implementation of a computerized work order management system to enable occupants to submit service requests, track progress, and support the prioritization and scheduling of maintenance and repair activities.
* Serve as point of contact for local utilities (ex. Southern California Edison for building power).
* Serve as the primary building point of contact for the Fire Marshal, coordinate and attend required inspections, maintain all necessary fire and life safety records and documentation, and schedule and oversee required annual, quarterly, and other periodic testing of building safety systems in accordance with applicable codes and jurisdictional requirements.
* Build and maintain budgets for annual preventative maintenance costs.
* Develop and maintain appropriate inventory levels of supplies, materials, and repair parts based on facility and venue needs, ensuring materials are readily available to support maintenance and repair activities, and maintain accurate inventory records.
* Develop and oversee annual and preventive maintenance schedules for all facilities and building systems; establish and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) for facility operations, maintenance, and emergency response; and identify, engage, and manage third-party vendors to support venue operations, including establishing clear emergency response protocols and service expectation.
* Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, supply usage, labor, and associated costs to track facility performance, identify maintenance trends, and inform the development of a long-term asset management and replacement program Develop service contract requirements, scope of work, performance standards, and service-level expectations for third-party vendors to ensure facility maintenance and operational needs are clearly defined and consistently met.
* Oversee and direct housekeeping services and cleaning services for back of house spaces, player spaces, and office spaces.
* Demonstrate knowledge of professional sports hardwood court cleaning practices and maintenance requirements to ensure the playing surface meets the standards and operational needs of a professional sports team.
* Oversee and coordinate specialty window cleaning and other specialized cleaning services, ensuring work is performed safely, effectively, and in accordance with facility standards.
* Build and maintain strong working relationships with team personnel to understand facility-related needs and requests, coordinate service delivery, and ensure clear, timely, and consistent communication.
* Working alongside Food Service team and associated personnel, coordinate repairs to equipment essential to food and beverage operations as needed.
* Working alongside team trainers, schedule servicing hydrotherapy equipment as required.
* Oversee and direct the work of landscaping team to ensure trees and plants (indoor and outdoor) are maintained.
* Collect and maintain accurate records to track venue assets, with an ability to identify faulty equipment, or make recommendations based on anticipated lifecycle for asset replacement.
* Track warranties of building assets.
* Conduct frequent physical inspections of building and external grounds to ensure the highest industry standards are met in Maintenance, System Operations, identifying and communicating any potential safety concerns, and areas requiring follow-up attention.
* Other duties, as assigned, related to the upkeep, maintenance and operation of the Sparks’ Training Facility.

**MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS**

* Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in facility maintenance, building systems management, and facilities oversight, including supervisory or managerial responsibilities. Experience in a professional sports or large-scale venue environment is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated knowledge of building systems and facility maintenance, including HVAC systems (air- and water-cooled systems, humidity control, and ventilation), fire and life safety systems, electrical systems, plumbing, and exterior grounds maintenance. Ability to oversee preventive maintenance, troubleshoot facility issues, and coordinate specialized contractors to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient building operations.
* Experience leading maintenance personnel and managing third-party service providers, with the ability to establish maintenance standards, oversee service delivery, and ensure facilities meet the operational requirements of a professional sports organization.
* Understanding of basketball schedules and basic team operations.
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects simultaneously, working efficiently, to meet deadlines, with an excellent eye for detail.
* Strong interpersonal, organizational, computer and communication skills, as well as analytical skills.
* A proven ability to think critically and set priorities.
* Innovative thinker with success in developing and implementing new ideas and programs.
* Ability to anticipate and resolve problems and conflicts.
* Available to respond to emergencies 24/7.
* Ability to maintain a high level of Professionalism in all circumstances.
Ability to work frequent irregular and long hours, weekends, evenings and all full-stadium events through completion and departure of public and team personnel as appropriate. 

**Compensation commensurate with experience; minimum starting salary at $105,000 annually.**

The incumbent is expected to perform other duties necessary for the effective operation of the department and organization.

new_roles.title: Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
**Plant Manager**
=================

**Company:** North Point Technology Consulting 
**Work Location:** Fort Wayne, Indiana, USA 
**Employment Type:** Full-Time / Contract 
**Work Arrangement:** On-Site

### **Job Overview**

North Point Technology Consulting is seeking an experienced Plant Manager to lead a high-volume automotive driveline manufacturing plant in Fort Wayne, Indiana.

This leader owns the full plant P&L and organizes, leads, and manages every functional area of the facility, driving lean manufacturing and a Toyota Production System based operating system while building a motivated, high-performing workforce.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Own the full plant P&L, including strategy, policies, processes, and systems.
* Lead manufacturing and assembly operations, finance (budget, cost control, capital), supply chain and inventory, EHS, labor relations, and engineering and facilities.
* Drive lean manufacturing and continuous improvement in cost, quality, productivity, and operational excellence.
* Lead metrics and reporting, program management, and product launches.
* Build and develop a motivated workforce that meets or exceeds performance standards.
* Communicate effectively at all levels and with customers, suppliers, and the community.
* Influence business unit and executive leadership on strategy and long-range improvement plans.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or 4+ years of applicable experience, with 12+ years of manufacturing experience.
* Experience working in a unionized environment.
* Proven ability to set and execute long-term operational strategy tied to efficiency, cost, and quality.
* Deep understanding of manufacturing systems, lean principles, and continuous improvement.
* Strong budgeting, cost analysis, and financial metrics skills.
* Proven ability to lead, motivate, and develop diverse teams with a focus on safety and accountability.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior plant manager or operations director experience in automotive or heavy manufacturing.

### **About North Point Technology Consulting**

North Point Technology Consulting provides specialized engineering and technology professionals to support manufacturing automation, MES implementations, ERP systems, and industrial technology operations across the United States and internationally.

North Point Technology is **THE BEST** place to work for curious-minded engineers motivated to support our country's most crucial missions! We focus on long term projects, leveraging the latest technology in support of innovative solutions to solve our customer's most difficult problems.

At North Point Technology, EMPLOYEES come first! We value our employees by providing excellent compensation, benefits, and a flexible work-life balance. We strive for a close-knit and open atmosphere where the owners are always directly available to our team members.

**Come join us!** **Apply with North Point Technology today!**

*For positions requiring a federal security clearance, your clearance level must be clearly identified on your resume.*

new_roles.title: Director of Operations - Commercial Laundry
new_roles.description:
**LEAD OPERATIONS. DEVELOP PEOPLE. DRIVE RESULTS.**

Century Linen and Uniform is seeking an experienced, results-driven Director of Operations to lead and oversee operations across five commercial laundry and uniform rental facilities throughout New York State and Massachusetts.

This is a key leadership position responsible for driving operational excellence, improving financial performance, developing strong management teams, and ensuring consistency and accountability across all facilities.

The ideal candidate is a strategic and hands-on leader who understands how to manage a multi-location operation, develop General Managers, improve productivity, control costs, and build a culture of performance and accountability.

**WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR**

**Multi-Plant Leadership**

* Provide overall operational leadership and direction to five commercial laundry facilities.
* Lead, coach, and hold General Managers accountable for facility performance and results.
* Establish consistent operating standards, procedures, and expectations across all locations.
* Conduct regular facility visits to evaluate performance, identify opportunities, and address operational challenges.

**Financial and Operational Performance**

* Oversee operational budgets, expenses, labor costs, overtime, and profitability.
* Partner with Finance to monitor financial results, identify variances, and implement corrective actions.
* Drive cost-control initiatives, productivity improvements, and operational efficiencies.
* Ensure each facility meets established financial and operational objectives.

**Production and Productivity**

* Oversee production performance, workflow, scheduling, labor utilization, and capacity planning.
* Monitor productivity, quality, rewash, linen loss, and production efficiency.
* Identify bottlenecks and implement improvements to maximize throughput and resource utilization.
* Ensure production operations support customer demand and service commitments.

**Customer Service and Service Delivery**

* Ensure consistent service quality, accuracy, and on-time delivery.
* Partner with Sales, Customer Service, and Transportation to resolve operational issues.
* Establish accountability for customer complaints, service failures, shortages, and recurring quality concerns.

**Leadership and Employee Development**

* Recruit, develop, coach, and evaluate General Managers and key operational leaders.
* Establish clear performance expectations, measurable goals, and accountability standards.
* Address performance concerns and leadership gaps promptly.
* Build a culture of ownership, teamwork, communication, and continuous improvement.

**Maintenance, Engineering, and Safety**

* Partner with Engineering and Maintenance leadership to improve equipment reliability and reduce downtime.
* Support preventive maintenance programs, capital projects, and facility improvements.
* Promote a safe working environment and ensure compliance with applicable safety and regulatory requirements.
* Partner with Human Resources and plant leadership on employee relations, workforce planning, and labor matters.

**Transportation and Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Transportation leadership to improve routing, fleet utilization, delivery performance, and operating efficiency.
* Work collaboratively with Finance, Human Resources, Sales, Engineering, Customer Service, and other departments.
* Provide regular operational updates, performance reports, and recommendations to executive leadership.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

The Director of Operations will be accountable for measurable improvements in:

* Plant profitability and performance against budget.
* Labor costs, overtime, and productivity.
* Pounds processed per labor hour and production efficiency.
* Customer service, on-time delivery, and quality.
* Rewash, shortages, and linen loss.
* Equipment reliability and downtime.
* Workplace safety and compliance.
* Staffing, employee retention, and General Manager performance.
* Execution of operational improvement initiatives.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Industrial Management, or a related field preferred. Equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* Minimum of 7–10 years of progressive operations management experience.
* Demonstrated experience overseeing multiple facilities, locations, or business units.
* Experience leading and developing General Managers, Plant Managers, or senior operational leaders.
* Commercial laundry, textile rental, manufacturing, distribution, or other labor-intensive industrial experience strongly preferred.
* Experience managing budgets, analyzing financial results, and improving operational profitability.
* Experience working in a unionized environment and interpreting collective bargaining agreements preferred.

**Leadership Qualities**

* Strong leadership and people-development skills.
* Ability to lead through others rather than micromanage.
* High level of accountability and the ability to hold others accountable.
* Strong financial and analytical abilities.
* Strategic thinking and sound business judgment.
* Effective communication and relationship-building skills.
* Decisive problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to implement change and drive continuous improvement.

**TRAVEL AND TRANSPORTATION REQUIREMENTS**

* This position requires frequent travel, potentially up to 90% of working time, among the company's five facilities throughout New York State and Massachusetts.
* Travel may include overnight stays, early morning departures, evening returns, weekends, and schedule adjustments based on operational needs.
* The employee is responsible for independently arranging reliable transportation to and from all assigned work locations and required reporting locations.
* The employee must be able to report to all assigned locations at the times and schedules required by the position.
* Company-provided bus transportation, if available, is offered as a convenience only and is not guaranteed. Bus service is subject to designated routes, schedules, and availability and may not accommodate the travel requirements or working hours of this position.
* Employees in this position may not rely on company-provided transportation as their sole means of commuting or traveling to required work locations.

This position requires regular presence in both office and industrial laundry environments, including production floors, maintenance areas, and loading docks. The employee must be comfortable working in environments with elevated temperatures, humidity, noise, moving equipment, industrial chemicals, and other conditions commonly found in commercial laundry facilities.

**Maple Heights Behavioral Health Hospital** | **Onsite in Fort Wayne, Indiana**

Join Maple Heights Behavioral Health Hospital, a modern 120-bed behavioral health hospital serving adolescents, adults, and seniors in Fort Wayne, Indiana. Our purpose-built campus provides a full continuum of behavioral healthcare services, including inpatient treatment, partial hospitalization (PHP), and intensive outpatient programming (IOP), all delivered in a safe, therapeutic, and patient-centered environment.

As the Director of Facility Operations, you will oversee the physical plant, facilities maintenance, safety, security, environmental services, and regulatory compliance across our approximately 80,000-square-foot hospital campus. This leadership role is critical to ensuring a safe, efficient, and welcoming environment for patients, visitors, and staff while supporting the hospital's mission of delivering exceptional behavioral healthcare.

**PURPOSE STATEMENT:**

Responsible for the overall maintenance of the buildings, grounds, fixtures, and equipment of the facility. Areas of responsibility may include two or more of the following areas/departments: safety, security, maintenance, facilities, materials management, and housekeeping.

Responsibilities:

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Oversee general building maintenance including plumbing, carpentry, painting, roofing, minor repairs, and electrical work.
* Ensure preventative maintenance is completed on all equipment.
* Ensure the facility is in a sanitary, attractive, safe, orderly condition and in compliance with all regulatory standards and accreditation requirements.
* Ensure the facility maintains compliance with all regulatory standards (i.e., NFPA, OSHA, etc.) and accreditation requirements (i.e., CMS, TJC, etc).
* Provide staff management including hiring, development, training, performance management, and communication to ensure effective and efficient department operation.
* Ensure proper operations and maintenance of water systems, emergency electrical systems, sewage systems, primary electrical systems, telephone systems, fire alarm systems, and heating and cooling systems.
* Develop facility maintenance plans, timetables for completion ,and recommendations for maintenance projects.
* Serve as project manager for small-scale, short-duration projects.
* Respond to facility fire and disaster situations immediately and assist per emergency plans.
* Coordinate outside service vendors/contractors and maintenance staff to complete projects as assigned/necessary.

**OTHER FUNCTIONS:**

* Perform other functions and tasks as assigned.

 
Qualifications:

**EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE/SKILL REQUIREMENTS**

* High School Diploma required.

Bachelor’s degree or higher level of education in Business or technical field preferred.

* Five or more years’ of Healthcare experience involving construction/maintenance preferred.
* Ten or more years’ construction/maintenance/Healthcare supervisory experience preferred.

**LICENSES/DESIGNATIONS/CERTIFICATIONS:**

* Valid state driver's license, where required in a facility.
* CPR and de-escalation/restraint certification required (training available upon hire and offered by facility).
* First aid may be required based on state or facility.
* Valid Certified Healthcare Facility Manager (CHFM) will be preffered.

**ADDITIONAL REGULATORY REQUIREMENTS:**

While this job description is intended to be an accurate reflection of the requirements of the job, management reserves the right to add or remove duties from particular jobs when circumstances (e.g. emergencies, changes in workload, rush jobs or technological developments) dictate.

new_roles.title: Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
AFC Industries is a dynamic organization dedicated to providing supply chain management solutions for fasteners and assembly components to original equipment manufacturers, assembly plants, and other users of these products.

We support a diverse industry base of manufacturers across a broad range of industries. Our experienced team has a proven track record of helping manufacturers and assemblers reduce cost, improve quality, and increase efficiency.

We are A Company Culture Devoted to Innovation & Improvement

AFC provides localized expertise to customers in particular industries and geographies. We don't have a traditional hierarchical management structure where everyone simply "reports up." Instead, our company is made up of on-the-ground experts operating in an entrepreneurial fashion with the backing and support of an enterprise-grade organization.

Sharing cultural values breeds consistency and quality throughout our organization. Collectively, we are committed to a simple management approach, which influences our company culture and our management style.

**Reports to:** Vice President of Operations

**Position Summary**

AFC North America is seeking a seasoned Director of Operations to lead our large regional distribution centers, which supply a network of localized service centers and the customers they support. This leader will execute the operational strategy for the DCs, drive discipline of the operational fundamentals, and build a culture of safety, quality, and continuous improvement. Although the service hubs operate under separate leadership, this role is accountable for ensuring the DCs deliver the service levels the hubs need to support their customers. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of running high-volume distribution operations, using data to make decisions, and partnering across the organization to deliver measurable results.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Operational Leadership and DC Performance**

* Provide strategic and day-to-day leadership for the distribution centers, ensuring reliable, efficient, and cost-effective flow of product to the service hub network.
* Establish and reinforce operational fundamentals (standard work, process discipline, accountability, and leader standard work) across all DC operations.
* Treat the service hubs as internal customers: align DC service levels, cutoff times, and replenishment performance to hub and end-customer requirements.
* Involvement of operational integration of acquired distribution facilities, bringing them onto common standards, systems, and KPIs.

**Labor Planning and Workforce Management**

* Own labor forecasting and capacity planning using volume forecasts, productivity standards, and seasonal trends to right-size staffing across shifts and sites.
* Develop engineered labor standards and productivity models that improve labor utilization and control overtime and temporary labor spend.
* Build leadership bench strength through coaching, succession planning, and development of DC managers and supervisors.

**Performance Metrics and Financial Accountability**

* Define, implement, and manage a balanced KPI framework covering safety, quality, service, productivity, and cost (e.g., OSHA recordables, order accuracy, on-time and complete shipments to service hubs, units per labor hour, cost per unit).
* Lead operational reviews with clear scorecards, root cause analysis, and corrective action plans.
* Own the DC operations budget, partner with Finance on forecasting and variance analysis, and identify opportunities to reduce cost-to-serve.

**Efficiency and Continuous Improvement**

* Champion Lean, Six Sigma, and related methodologies to eliminate waste, improve throughput, and optimize space, layout, and material flow.
* Lead major operational initiatives, including DC expansions, consolidations, network redesigns, and new program implementations.

**Safety and Quality**

* Set the standard for a zero-harm safety culture; ensure compliance with OSHA, DOT, and company policies across DC and fleet operations.
* Facility maintenance: provide guidance regarding facility repairs and maintenance according to lease terms.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner closely with service hub leadership to define service expectations, share performance data, and resolve issues that affect downstream customers.
* Work with Sales, Customer Service, Procurement, Inventory Planning, Finance, HR, and IT to align DC capabilities with business priorities.
* Serve as the operational voice in strategic planning, translating business goals into executable DC operating plans.

**Qualifications**

* 15+ years of progressive operations leadership in distribution, warehousing, or logistics, including significant experience at the director or senior manager level.
* Demonstrated success leading large, high-volume distribution centers that supply a multi-site or hub-and-spoke network.
* Strong expertise in labor forecasting, capacity planning, and productivity management.
* Proven ability to build and manage KPI frameworks and deliver measurable improvements in safety, quality, service, and cost.
* Hands-on experience applying Lean, Six Sigma, TOC, or Toyota Production System principles.
* Strong financial acumen, including budgeting.
* Proficiency with WMS, labor management systems, and data and reporting tools.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, and change management skills, with the ability to influence across all levels of the organization.
* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations Management, Business, Engineering, or a related field; MBA preferred.
* Ability to travel as required between DC locations.

**Benefits:**

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

*We are an AA/EEO/Veterans/Disabled employer.*

new_roles.description:
To thrive as a Plant Quality Manager, you are a strategic quality leader who is passionate about driving continuous improvement, developing high performing teams, and ensuring world class product and process quality. You will lead plant quality systems, champion quality initiatives, and partner with cross functional teams to build a culture of excellence, accountability, and operational success. We are looking for someone who combines strong technical expertise with exceptional leadership skills to help elevate quality performance across the organization!

In this role, you will oversee plant quality programs, analyze key quality metrics, identify improvement opportunities, and lead quality focused initiatives that support business objectives. You will collaborate closely with Operations, Engineering, Purchasing, R&D, and Corporate Quality teams to resolve quality challenges, strengthen processes, and drive sustainable results. We value leaders who inspire teams, foster professional development, and proactively create solutions that enhance quality, efficiency, and customer satisfaction. Together, we strive for continuous improvement, and we believe quality is everyone's responsibility.

**Here’s what we’re looking for:**

 

* High School Diploma required; Bachelor's degree preferred in Quality, Engineering, Management, or a related technical/scientific field.
* 5+ years of progressive experience in quality management, quality engineering, or manufacturing quality leadership, with a proven track record of leading plant-level quality systems, driving continuous improvement initiatives, and successfully managing cross-functional quality programs in a manufacturing environment.
* Experience in batch chemical manufacturing and managing Quality Control (QC) laboratory operations, with a strong understanding of quality testing processes, laboratory compliance, and manufacturing quality standards.
* Experience using statistical analysis and problem-solving tools to drive continuous improvement and operational excellence.
* Demonstrated leadership ability with experience coaching, developing, and managing high-performing teams.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to build effective partnerships across multiple functions.
* Experience managing budgets, resources, and quality performance metrics in a manufacturing environment.
* ASQ Certified Quality Manager (CQM) and/or Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) certification preferred.

**Here’s what we offer you:**

 

* Accrue 15 paid days of vacation time off the first year plus sick days.
* Competitive salary + performance-based incentives.
* 401(k) retirement plan with 4% match. Annual retirement profit sharing payments.
* Competitive health plans for individuals and families.

Do you thrive in an environment where meaningful work happens every day? Do you want to make a difference in the lives of older adults?

 

**Mercy Retirement & Care Center** has been at the forefront of senior care for more than 150 years. Situated on our lush campus in Oakland, we provide assisted living, memory care, skilled nursing and rehabilitation services to meet a variety of healthcare needs. We provide exceptional, person-centered care that enhances the quality of life for our residents.

 

Our **Culture of Excellence** is built on a foundation of respect, integrity, and a commitment to the well-being of both our residents and our team members. We foster a collaborative and supportive environment where innovation and compassion drive everything we do.

This position is responsible for the supervision and administration of security services, maintenance operations, and ground management, in addition to overseeing capital improvements. Ensures a secure and welcoming atmosphere for residents, staff, volunteers, and visitors, this position provides management, technical expertise, life safety reviews, and quality assurance initiatives to guarantee customer satisfaction and adherence to regulatory standards related to the physical plant maintenance and appearance as well as a dedication to maintaining our World Class **Culture of Excellence.**

 

**Our Plant Ops Director:**

* Oversees preventative maintenance of systems, buildings, and grounds. Manage contracts with external experts and contractors, as necessary.
* Manages capital projects, which includes handling project bids, selecting and overseeing contractors, and managing purchases and expenditures within the allocated budgets. Ensure that project status reports and related documentation are submitted promptly.
* Supervises maintenance operations, including an organized system for tracking work orders. Promotes the efficient use of resources, with a focus on energy conservation.
* Conducts quality assurance inspections as needed to uphold high service standards. Engages in various Quality Improvement programs and committees, either personally or by designating appropriate facility personnel.
* Actively participates in and supports the Work Safety committee.
* Performs safety reviews of the campus; ensures compliance with regulations concerning buildings, systems, and disaster response protocols.
* Oversee security services for the community.
* Understands the essential role of security, establishes necessary protocols and procedures, and secures personnel to ensure the safety of both residents and team members.
* Develops job descriptions; recruits-hire, trains, schedules, supervises, and advises personnel in relevant departments. Assesses performance, suggests promotions and salary adjustments, and implements progressive disciplinary measures for Plant team members.
* Acts as an integral member of the management team.
* Performs other duties as assigned.
 

 

**What you need to succeed:**

* High School Diploma required; with some college coursework preferred. Contractor’s license is preferred but is not a requirement.
* Minimum of 6 years’ related experience in facilities management, construction, engineering, property management and maintenance, at least 3 years in health care or retirement community environment.
* An advanced understanding of building codes, life safety regulations, and Cal-OSHA standards is required, along with journeyman-level expertise in HVAC/boiler systems, electrical, plumbing, and mechanical equipment.
* Excellent verbal and written communications skills in the English language.
* A valid driver's license is required, along with strong leadership and supervisory skills.
* Familiarity with safety policies and procedures is also essential.
* Committed to delivering high-quality and professional interactions with residents, volunteers, and staff members.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly in Office 365, including Microsoft Word, Excel, and email software, is expected.
* Capable of demonstrating adaptability, informed decisions under pressure, and effectively prioritizing tasks and projects.
* Completion of a background check and drug screening. Pre employment screenings may also include a physical, TB test, and fingerprinting per state/local guidelines.
 

 

**Physical Requirements:**

* May involve lifting, pushing, pulling, up to 75lbs, and transporting equipment, and candidates may encounter challenging environmental conditions, such as dirt, noise, heights, and confined spaces, necessitating caution for safety.
* To ensure the health and safety of both our team members and residents, Elder Care Alliance may mandate that team members receive vaccinations, engage in daily screenings, undergo surveillance testing, and utilize face coverings along with other personal protective equipment (PPE) in accordance with regulatory guidelines to mitigate the transmission of infectious diseases.
* Essential abilities for the safe execution of duties include good vision and hearing; full mobility on steps and ladders; adequate dexterity and mobility in both arms (or mechanical alternatives) to operate hand and power tools, gauges, and valves safely.
* Physical requirements can be accommodated with mechanical aids/devices.

new_roles.title: Sr. Director, Process Engineering
new_roles.description:
R3 Lithium operates North America's first commercial scale lithium carbonate recovery facility, located in Covington, Georgia. Using a lithium-first extraction process, the company recovers, refines, and returns lithium carbonate from recycled black mass into the battery supply chain for energy storage systems, defense applications, and electric vehicles. Founded in 2026 and privately held, R3 Lithium is headquartered at 9176 Industrial Drive NE, Covington, Georgia. For more information, visit www.r3lithium.com

R3 Lithium is seeking a highly experienced **Lead Discipline Process Engineer** to provide technical leadership for process design, process optimization, and operational excellence across lithium processing and manufacturing operations. This position serves as the subject matter expert for process engineering and is responsible for leading process design activities, supporting project execution, troubleshooting operational challenges, and driving continuous improvement initiatives that enhance safety, reliability, quality, and production performance.

The successful candidate will play a key leadership role in the development, commissioning, and optimization of lithium processing facilities while collaborating with multidisciplinary engineering, operations, maintenance, and project teams.

**Required Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, Process Engineering, or related engineering discipline required.
* Master's degree preferred.

**Experience**

* Minimum **15+ years of progressively responsible process engineering experience** in lithium, chemical processing, mining, hydrometallurgical, battery materials, refining, or industrial manufacturing environments.
* Demonstrated experience leading process engineering activities for large capital projects and operating facilities.
* Experience supporting facility commissioning, start-up, troubleshooting, and process optimization.
* Strong understanding of process simulation, process control, mass and energy balances, and industrial process design.
* Proven leadership experience mentoring engineers and leading multidisciplinary technical teams.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Process Engineering Leadership**

* Serve as the technical lead and discipline authority for all process engineering activities.
* Develop and oversee process engineering standards, specifications, and best practices.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to process engineers and project teams.
* Review and approve engineering deliverables to ensure technical accuracy and compliance with design requirements.

**Process Design & Project Execution**

* Lead process design efforts including:
* + Process Flow Diagrams (PFDs)
 + Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs)
 + Heat and Material Balances
 + Equipment Sizing and Specification
 + Process Control Philosophies
 + Process Hazard Analyses (PHA/HAZOP)
* Support feasibility studies, front-end engineering design (FEED), detailed engineering, commissioning, and startup activities.
* Participate in technology evaluations, vendor selection, and equipment procurement activities.
* Support capital project planning, budgeting, scheduling, and execution.

**Process Optimization & Operational Excellence**

* Identify and implement opportunities to improve production efficiency, recovery rates, throughput, product quality, and operating costs.
* Lead root cause investigations and corrective action programs for process-related issues.
* Utilize process data analytics to drive continuous improvement and operational excellence initiatives.
* Develop performance metrics and monitor process key performance indicators (KPIs).

**Safety, Environmental & Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure process designs and operating practices comply with applicable safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements.
* Lead participation in HAZOP studies, Management of Change (MOC), and risk assessments.
* Promote a strong safety culture and operational discipline throughout the organization.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with lithium extraction, lithium conversion, lithium salts production, hydrometallurgical processing, or battery materials manufacturing.
* Experience with Aspen HYSYS, Aspen Plus, MATLAB, or other process modeling software.
* Professional Engineer (PE) license preferred.
* Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification preferred.
* Experience supporting greenfield facility development and startup activities.

**Core Competencies**

* Process Design & Engineering
* Hydrometallurgical Processing
* Chemical Plant Operations
* Process Simulation & Modeling
* Capital Project Execution
* Process Safety Management (PSM)
* Root Cause Analysis
* Commissioning & Startup
* Continuous Improvement
* Team Leadership & Mentorship
* Technical Risk Assessment
* Cross-Functional Collaboration

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Plant Throughput & Capacity Utilization
* Process Recovery Rates
* Yield Improvement
* Operating Cost Reduction
* Process Reliability & Uptime
* Safety Performance Metrics
* Environmental Compliance
* Successful Capital Project Delivery
* Process Improvement Savings
* Engineering Quality and Execution

new_roles.title: Vice President of Continuous Improvement & Lean
new_roles.description:
Eaton’s Electrical Sector America’s business is curretly hiring for a VP of Continuous Improvement & Lean. This role can be based at Eaton’s Cleveland or Pittsburgh office. Relocation within hiring country is offered. 50 percent travel is anticipated.

Reporting directly to the SVP of Operations, Electrical Sector – Americas (ESA), the VP of CI & Lean is the senior executive accountable for the vision, strategy, and results of the Eaton Continuous Improvement System (ECIS) across the $16B ESA business, spanning 60 manufacturing sites and 14 divisions. This role sets the multi-year Lean transformation agenda, builds continuous improvement into the sector's strategic and annual profit plans, and holds the business accountable for measurable improvement in safety, quality, delivery, cost, and growth.

The VP leads and develops the ESA CI team, defines the sector-wide operating model, standards, and governance the team deploys, and serves as a strategic advisor to the ESA leadership team. Rather than leading deployment within a division, this role directs CI resources to the highest-value opportunities, owns the sector's CI talent pipeline, and shapes a Lean leadership culture at the executive level. The VP also represents ESA in enterprise CI forums, partnering with Corporate CI & Quality to align standards and scale best practices across Eaton.

**Job Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

* Defines the multi-year ESA Lean and continuous improvement vision, strategy, and roadmap, and integrates it into the sector's strategic plan and annual profit plan.
* Owns the ECIS operating model for ESA: sets the standards, maturity expectations, and governance that the CI team deploys across divisions, functions, and sites.
* Leads, coaches, and develops the ESA CI team; sets objectives, allocates CI resources, and holds the team accountable for results.
* Chairs the Divisional CI Council across all ESA divisions and leads sector-level performance reviews, establishing the operating cadence that links CI results to business performance.
* Accountable for the ESA cost-out and productivity commitments delivered through CI; builds the sector project pipeline and validates financial impact.
* Serves as strategic advisor to the SVP of Operations and the ESA leadership team, prioritizing the transformation initiatives with the greatest business value.
* Sponsors large-scale, cross-divisional transformations (e.g., footprint changes, acquisition integrations, and Lean in office and transactional processes).
* Builds the sector CI talent strategy: capability standards, certification pathways (e.g., ASCEND X, PME), succession planning, and rotation of high-potential leaders through CI roles.
* Coaches ESA executives on Lean leadership behaviors and role-models a culture of accountability and continuous improvement from the top.
* Sets sector maturity targets and owns the EBSA and OpA assessment strategy; reviews results with leadership and directs closure of systemic gaps.
* Represents ESA in enterprise CI forums; partners with Corporate CI & Quality to shape Eaton-wide standards and scale proven practices across sectors.
* Manages the ESA CI function budget and champions digital and data analytics tools that accelerate improvement.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

Required Qualifications: 

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical discipline from an accredited institution.
* Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in Continuous Improvement, Quality, or Operations
* Minimum 5 years leading leaders (managers or directors) at a multi-site, division, or business-unit level
* Proven track record leading Lean transformations that delivered measurable financial results, preferably in a multi-division manufacturing environment
* Professional experience in a global matrixed organization
* Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position. This means that Eaton will not support any CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F-1 to H-1B, H-1B cap registration, O-1, E-3, TN status, I-485 job portability, etc

Preferred Qualifications: 

* Master's degree or MBA preferred

Position Success Criteria: 

* Expert-level command of Lean and Six Sigma; Master Black Belt or Black Belt certification required
* Experience designing, governing, and maturing a business operating system and maturity model at scale
* Strong business and financial acumen: builds cost-out and productivity plans, quantifies impact, and ties CI results to the P&L
* Experience designing CI talent, certification, and capability programs across a large, multi-site organization
* Applies Lean to both manufacturing and office/transactional processes
* Executive presence; a trusted advisor who influences, challenges, and aligns senior executives
* Proven ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing teams of senior CI leaders
* Strategic thinker who turns vision into multi-year roadmaps and leads change at scale

new_roles.title: Director of Engineering, Global Manufacturing Engineering & NPI
new_roles.description:
The Director of Engineering leads Manufacturing Engineering, Process Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Test Engineering, Test Automation, NPI Engineering, and Customer TPM teams for a global data center rack manufacturing business. This role is responsible for engineering execution at the New Jersey manufacturing campus and for establishing global engineering standards, processes, and best practices across all manufacturing locations.

The Director drives manufacturing readiness, automation, operational excellence, quality, productivity, and successful new product introductions while partnering closely with customers and Platform Engineering. Platform Engineering retains ownership of product design, architecture, DFM approval, and Level 3 technical solutioning.

 

**Key Responsibilities**

**Manufacturing Engineering Leadership**

* Lead Manufacturing Engineering, Test Engineering, Test Automation, NPI Engineering, Industrial Engineering, and Customer TPM organizations.
* Establish and deploy global engineering standards, SOPs, governance, and best practices.
* Develop engineering talent, succession plans, and organizational capability.

**Manufacturing Excellence**

* Own engineering performance for the New Jersey campus and drive global engineering consistency.
* Optimize manufacturing flows, capacity, labor efficiency, throughput, and cycle time.
* Deliver improvements in FPY, RTPY, DPPM, OEE, cost, quality, and delivery performance.
* Drive KPI management systems and operational review rigor.

**Automation & Test Strategy**

* Define and execute factory automation and smart manufacturing roadmaps.
* Lead deployment of robotics, vision systems, automated assembly, digital manufacturing, and Industry 4.0 solutions.
* Own manufacturing test strategy, test automation, diagnostics, traceability, and test system scalability.

**New Product Introduction (NPI)**

* Own manufacturing readiness throughout all NPI phase gates.
* Ensure readiness of processes, tooling, automation, test systems, capacity, and staffing.
* Lead pilot builds, manufacturing validation, launch readiness reviews, and production ramps.
* Identify and mitigate manufacturing risks to schedule, quality, and scalability.

**Customer & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Lead customer-facing TPM teams and serve as executive engineering interface for strategic customers.
* Partner with Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Customers, and Platform Engineering to achieve successful product launches.
* Align manufacturing capabilities with customer requirements and growth plans.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Drive Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Root Cause Analysis, CAPA, and SPC methodologies.
* Lead cost reduction, productivity, yield improvement, and waste elimination initiatives.
Build a culture of accountability, standardization, and continuous improvement. 

 

**Ownership & Interfaces**

**This Role Owns**

* Manufacturing Engineering
* Process Engineering
* Industrial Engineering
* Test Engineering
* Test Automation
* Manufacturing readiness
* Factory readiness
* SOPs and engineering standards
* FPY, RTPY, DPPM, productivity, throughput, and operational KPIs
* Manufacturing validation and production ramp execution
Customer TPM organization 

 

**Partner Organizations**

**Platform Engineering**

* Product architecture and design
* Product specifications and BOM ownership
* DFM/DFA approval
* Product validation and qualification
* Design changes and reliability engineering
* Level 3 debugging, root cause analysis, and technical solution development

**Customers**

* Product requirements
* Acceptance criteria
* Product roadmap priorities
* Qualification and approval requirements

**Key Metrics**

* First Pass Yield (FPY)
* Rolled Throughput Yield (RTPY)
* DPPM
* Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ)
* On-Time Delivery (OTD)
* Productivity and labor efficiency
* Manufacturing cycle time
* Automation ROI
* NPI launch success
* Customer satisfaction
Global standards adoption 

 

**Qualifications**

* BS in Engineering required; MS/MBA preferred.
* 15+ years of manufacturing engineering leadership experience.
* Experience leading Manufacturing Engineering, Test Engineering, Automation, and NPI organizations.
* Proven success in high-volume electronics, server, rack integration, or data center manufacturing environments.
* Strong customer-facing leadership skills.
* Demonstrated track record improving FPY, RTPY, quality, productivity, and operational performance.
Lean Six Sigma and global manufacturing experience preferred. 

 

**Ideal Candidate**

A strategic and hands-on engineering leader capable of building a world-class global manufacturing engineering organization that delivers scalable NPI execution, advanced automation, operational excellence, and industry-leading quality for hyperscale and enterprise data center infrastructure products.

**About ZT Systems**
--------------------

At ZT Systems, a Sanmina Company, you’ll get to do work you are proud of alongside smart, passionate people. Every day, there are opportunities to collaborate with the best in the industry to design, build, and deliver impactful solutions to world-class customers. Along the way, you will gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced environment that’s challenging, rewarding, and career-defining.

A culture built around our values we work hard and think fast. We view challenges as opportunities—to do better, push harder, and be faster than we were the day before. When we fail, we learn from it and move on together. And when we succeed, we use the momentum to go even further. We create value with everything we do, building the foundation of today—and transforming the future of tomorrow.

Join ZT Systems and help us build technology infrastructure that connects the world.

**What We Offer** 
At ZT Systems, a Sanmina Company, we believe that investing in our people is key to our continued growth and innovation. When you join our team, you’ll gain access to a comprehensive and inclusive benefits package designed to support your well-being, financial security, and professional development—both now and in the future.

**Compensation & Financial Security**

* Competitive base salary

* Performance-based annual bonus eligibility

* 401(k) retirement savings plan

* Tuition reimbursement for eligible education programs

**Health & Wellness**

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with access to leading providers

-Mental health resources and employee wellness support programs-

* Company-paid life and disability insurance

**Time Away & Work-Life Balance**

* Paid time off (PTO) and company-paid holidays

* Parental leave and family care support programs

**Growth & Purpose**

* Structured training programs and on-the-job learning opportunities

* Matching gifts and volunteer programs to support causes you care about

These benefits are available to eligible employees and are designed to grow with you as your career evolves. Full benefits and eligibility varies by work location.

ZT Group Int’l. is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. ZT Systems provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Please be aware that certain positions may require the applicant to either 1) be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or 2) be eligible to obtain an export control license or license exception from the Bureau of Industry and Science & U.S. Department of Commerce. All offers of employment will be conditional subject to the foregoing.

new_roles.title: Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering
new_roles.description:
Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering

White Bear Lake, MN

**About Heraeus**

Making displays foldable? Help hearts beat with micro-particles? Work on solutions involving precious metals? As a family-owned global technology group we help our customers to always being one step ahead.

 

**About Heraeus Medevio**

Heraeus Medevio combines medical technology expertise with collaborative partnerships. Together with medical device manufacturers, we develop and implement solutions for defined applications. As part of the Heraeus Group, we support the professional development of our employees and offer opportunities for career development, depending on the role, location and operational conditions.

To reach our vision of improving 100 million lives every year, we foster a culture of curiosity that thrives on challenge, continuous learning, growth, and the opportunity to try new things. With sites in the United States, European Union, and Asia, and over 2,200 employees worldwide, together, we will meet tomorrow's challenges today.

 
**Position Summary**
 
The Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering leads the strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of advanced manufacturing technology across the Americas manufacturing network, including automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing. This role owns the design, development, validation, implementation, and maintenance of automated manufacturing equipment, assembly systems, robotics, vision inspection technologies, digital manufacturing solutions, and additive manufacturing processes and equipment that support the production of medical devices. The Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering role builds and leads a team of engineering professionals across these disciplines, sets technical direction and standards, and partners closely with Manufacturing, Operations, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, R&D, and Supply Chain to advance productivity, quality, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence across multiple sites.
 
**This is an onsite position at the White Bear Lake, MN location with travel to other global manufacturing sites.**
 
**What You’ll Do Every Day:**
 

* Develop and execute the advanced manufacturing engineering roadmap (including automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing) aligned with business objectives.
* Establish long-term technology strategies to support manufacturing capacity expansion, cost reduction, and product quality improvement across the manufacturing network.
* Identify emerging technologies and evaluate opportunities for implementation, including robotics, AI-enabled inspection systems, Industry 4.0/digital manufacturing applications, advanced controls, and additive manufacturing processes and equipment.
* Lead capital equipment planning and investment strategy across automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing initiatives.
* Collaborate with Manufacturing, Operations, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, R&D, Supply Chain, and external technology partners to enhance productivity, quality, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence.
* Direct a team responsible for automation engineering, controls engineering, robotics, machine vision, electrical engineering, digital manufacturing/manufacturing systems integration, and additive manufacturing.
* Build and mentor high-performing engineering teams through coaching, performance management, and talent development, while establishing engineering standards, best practices, and design methodologies across advanced manufacturing disciplines.
* Carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with company policies and applicable laws, including selection, training and development, assigning work, and performance management of employees.
* Manage complex, multidisciplinary engineering projects from concept through implementation, delivering on time and within budget while meeting technical and quality requirements, and communicate progress and issues clearly to leadership to support project and site objectives.
* Manage external automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing integrators, contractors, and equipment suppliers.
* Develop and control departmental operating and capital budgets; establish project schedules, resource plans, and cost controls.
* Other duties may be assigned as required.

 
**What We’re Looking For:**
 

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Automation, or Industrial Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field required; Master’s degree in Engineering, MBA, or related discipline preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in automated manufacturing environments; experience in digital manufacturing and/or additive manufacturing strongly preferred.
* Minimum of 5 years of leadership experience managing engineering teams.
* Experience within medical device, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or other highly regulated manufacturing industries.
* Proven success leading large-scale automation, digital manufacturing, and/or additive manufacturing projects and capital equipment installations.
* Experience with equipment validation and regulatory compliance in FDA-regulated environments.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams across multiple sites and drive continuous improvement and digitalization initiatives.
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, project management, and organizational skills.
* Ability and willingness to travel across the Americas manufacturing network (White Bear Lake, MN; Costa Rica; Puerto Rico), approximately 25-50% of the time.

 
*Medevio is committed to providing competitive total compensation and benefits packages. The expected hiring range for this position is between $160,000 and $190,000 based upon a full-time schedule. This is a good faith estimate on the applicable range. Base salaries are determined by taking a variety of factors in account, including, but not limited to, candidate qualifications, geographic locations, market conditions and internal equity. This position is bonus eligible, with a target bonus of 20%. Our total compensation package includes eligibility for comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan with company match, education reimbursement, paid parental leave and paid time off.*
