new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Operations - Quality
new_roles.description:
**About the role:**
===================

This is a hands-on role with both strategic and executional scope. You will build and lead quality assurance and quality control standards across Operations, set the sampling, validation, and escalation practices the organization runs on, and partner closely with the Senior Manager, Operations - Payer Ops, the Human-in-the-Loop Operations leader, Product, and Engineering. You will report to the Head of Operations and help define the company's AI/Human QA strategy as Adonis scales.

**What you'll do:**
===================

**Own the Quality Program across Operations**
---------------------------------------------

* Define and own QA/QC standards, sampling methodologies, audit practices, and validation processes across AI agent outputs, human-executed work, and vendor-delivered operations.
* Develop & present quarterly plans and operating metrics; communicate progress and trade-offs; surface risks early + Work closely with the Head of Operations on strategic projects
* Lead quality assurance for payer workflows and agent outcomes, including new payer activations on the voice channel.
* Lead the development and implementation of a near-real-time QA Dashboard to provide visibility into quality, identify performance gaps, and track improvement over time.
* Partner with the operations team and external vendors to ensure work consistently meets Adonis's accuracy, operational, and compliance standards.
* Partner closely with the operations team to align on quality standards, remediation priorities, and operational performance.
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, vendors, and cross-functional stakeholders to address quality gaps, improve workflows, and support strategic initiatives.
* Serve as the quality subject matter expert across Operations, ensuring quality considerations are incorporated into new workflows, product launches, and operational changes.

**Turn quality findings into operational and product improvements**
-------------------------------------------------------------------

* Translate and present quality trends and findings into actionable recommendations for Product, Engineering, and Operations, driving improvements from identification through implementation and validation.
* Leverage AI, automation, and internal tooling to increase the efficiency, accuracy, and scalability of QA/QC processes.
* Establish quality thresholds and escalation criteria for uncertain, complex, or high-impact outcomes.

**Build and lead a high-performing quality function**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Build and scale the Quality function, establishing clear goals, ownership, processes, and performance metrics.
* Lead, coach, and develop onshore and offshore team members, as the function grows.
* Develop and maintain SOPs, playbooks, training materials, and quality guidelines to support operational consistency and continuous improvement.

**Who you are:**
================

* 6+ years of experience
* Experience in healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM) is required, with practical understanding of payer, claims, or related revenue-cycle workflows.
* Experience building or leading quality assurance, quality control, or quality programs in a technology-enabled operations environment.
* Experience coaching a team and creating clarity across multiple workstreams.
* Experience defining operating standards, evaluating results, investigating failures, and ensuring corrective actions are effective.
* Strong cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with Product, Engineering, customer-facing teams, and operational partners.
* Comfort moving between strategic planning and hands-on operational detail in a fast-changing environment.
* An AI-forward mindset and practical experience applying AI, automation, or intelligent tooling to improve quality and operational performance, with sound judgment about when human review is needed.

The base salary range for this position is $140,000 to $180,000. Base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to base salary, we also offer competitive equity and benefits packages.

**About Adonis**
================

Adonis is the leading AI orchestration platform for healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM), purpose-built for healthcare organizations seeking to transform their revenue operations. Traditional RCM processes often struggle with inefficiencies, costing providers up to 15% or more of their potential revenue. Through advanced automation, data science, and AI Agents, Adonis helps revenue teams detect vulnerabilities, optimize workflows, and deploy precise solutions that drive reliable and scalable financial outcomes.

Adonis is headquartered in New York City and has raised over $95M in funding, including a recent $40M Series C round led by Quadrille Capital with continued support from existing investors such as General Catalyst and Bling Capital. This funding supports our mission to restore sanity to RCM and equip provider groups and health systems with AI-driven revenue cycle operations at scale.

**Compensation Philosophy**
===========================

Actual base pay will depend on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Adonis determines compensation based on each candidate’s experience and qualifications relative to peers, and most new hires fall near the middle of the range. In addition to base salary, you’ll receive meaningful equity and great benefits.

**Perks at Adonis**
===================

* Competitive equity packages
* Employer-paid medical insurance
* Employer-paid dental insurance
* Employer-paid vision insurance
* Employer-funded HSA
* Parental leave
* Commuter benefits
* Office lunches every day
* Office snacks
* Generous PTO
* Located in 3 World Trade Center with easy access to all trains and the PATH, and amazing views of the city

Adonis is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture that celebrates authenticity to win as one. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, citizenship or immigration status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

At Adonis, we fully comply with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). We are dedicated to embracing challenges and creating an accessible, inclusive workplace for all individuals.

Compensation Range: $140K - $180K

new_roles.description:
**We believe that great healthcare is an essential safeguard of human dignity.**

At Laborie, we know the work we do matters – it’s what fuels our motivation and contributes to our success. If you’re ready to make a positive impact in the lives of patients across the globe, we’d like to meet you.

We support and empower our employees to grow their careers in an environment that encourages a sense of belonging and a connection to doing good. We’re not afraid to roll up our sleeves to make our goals a reality and work together to solve for our customers. We reward and recognize our employees based on our values of **Aspire to Greatness, Respect All, Own It, Working Together, Persist with Passion.**

**Who We’re Looking For:**

To ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and the Laborie Medical Quality Systems in the development, manufacturing, and marketing of Laborie Medical products. The position supports corporate wide process improvement initiatives relating to Quality and Regulatory.

**About the Role:**

* Develop and direct quality strategies, objectives, policies and procedures for assigned sites and Quality Management Systems.
* Directly responsible for the CAPA, Internal Audit, Complaint Handling and Training Systems for assigned sites and Quality Management Systems, including results against Quality Objectives related to these areas.
* Provide team leadership, development, and talent management activities including coaching, resource forecasting, hiring, performance management, training, and budgeting for the Quality Assurance and Quality Engineering functions to meet the company's objectives.
* Maintain quality standards set forth in the Laborie Medical Quality Manual(s) and those of its subsidiaries.
* Influence management and staff to encourage continuous improvement of quality and compliance.
* Proactively identify/resolve compliance risks.
* Fulfill the duties of back-up Management Representative.
* Play prominent role in acquisition due diligence and integration efforts.
* Prioritize and manage continuous improvement activities for Laborie
* Provide technical recommendations based on trend analysis to eliminate future problems and execute changes as necessary.
* Maintain compliance to all applicable regulations for the marketing of medical devices.
* Manage the CAPA process for all the company QMS’s.
* Lead auditee and serves as escort during inspections and audits performed by external regulatory bodies and internal auditors.
* Execute miscellaneous tasks, as assigned.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* BS or BA in Business Administration/Computer Sciences/Engineering or related degree
* Experience in a leadership position with direct supervision of Quality/Regulatory professionals
* Minimum 8 years’ experience working in a medically regulated industry in a Quality or Regulatory position.
* Experience with ISO13485, MDSAP, MDR, CFR820
* Experience with Project Management, Problem Solving, Six Sigma, Lean Management Systems, Root Cause Analysis, and other standard Quality tools
* Strong project management skills and attention to detail
* Excellent communication skills, cross department collaboration and leadership skills

**Why Laborie:**

Our Mission every day is to operate as a world-class specialist medical company making and advancing technologies that preserve and restore human dignity. We do that today by helping people with pelvic and gastrointestinal conditions live normal lives, and by helping mothers and babies have safe deliveries.

* Paid time off and paid volunteer time
* Medical, Dental, Vision and Flexible Spending Account
* Health Savings Account with Company Funded Contributions
* 401k Retirement Plan with Company Match
* Parental Leave and Adoption Services
* Health and Wellness Programs and Events

We are interested in a qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we will not be sponsoring work visas for this position, at this time.

*Laborie* *provides equal employment opportunities and non-discrimination for all employees and qualified applicants without regard to a person’s race, color, gender, age, religion, national origin, ancestry, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, or any characteristic protected under applicable law. Laborie is committed to providing access and reasonable accommodation in our services, activities, education, and employment for individuals with disabilities.*

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance

Active and existing security clearance required after day 1

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Collins Aerospace is a leader in technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that help redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With a comprehensive portfolio and deep technical expertise, we help customers meet the demands of the global market. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

**Raytheon Company, Managed by Collins Aerospace**

We are seeking a dedicated professional to join our team as a Senior Manager, Program Quality Leader. This onsite role, based in El Segundo, CA will support Positioning, Navigation and Timing (PNT) Avionics within Mission Systems. In this role, you will lead efforts and develop teams to effectively implement Quality & Mission Assurance (QMA) requirements across all program phases. You will serve as the primary Quality interface for customers, suppliers, and programs.

**What You Will Do**:

* Develop and lead a team of Program Quality Leads (PQLs) and Customer Quality Engineers (CQEs) to support program execution and deliverables.
* Engage with internal and external stakeholders to establish effective relationships and influence decision-making across multiple levels within a cross-functional environment at multiple sites.
* Ensure quality requirements are integrated into program estimates and proposals and oversee their consistent application.
* Lead and oversee the implementation of Quality & Mission Assurance (QMA) requirements across all phases of assigned programs.
* Serve as the primary QMA interface for customers, suppliers, and internal program teams, ensuring alignment with customer requirements and expectations.
* Drive strategic improvements to enhance quality processes, reduce defects, and improve overall program performance.
* Oversee the development and application of quality metrics to identify root causes and implement long-term corrective actions.
* Ensure compliance with industry and regulatory quality standards, including ISO 9001, AS9100, and AS9102.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including program management, operations, and engineering, to ensure process capability, product conformance, and on-time delivery.
* Manage customer interface activities, including interactions with Acquisitioned Customers and Defense Contract Management Agency (DCMA).
* Support manufacturing processes by interpreting drawings, work instructions, and Bills of Materials (BOMs).
* Promote continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency, reduce costs, and improve customer satisfaction.
* Must be willing and able to travel up to 10% of the time.

**Qualifications You Must Have**:

* Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree and minimum 10 years of relevant experience, or an Advanced degree and minimum 7 years of relevant experience.
* Experience reviewing customer proposals and part orders for compliance risk to quality requirements, and establishing cost estimates for quality support.
* Experience leading teams in program management, quality management, operations management, or an engineering capacity.
* Experience as the direct interface to external customers.
* Experience with manufacturing processes, including quality systems and industry technical standards (ISO 9001 or AS9100), as well as interpreting drawings, work instructions, and Bills of Materials (BOMs).

**Qualifications We Prefer**

* Direct experience working with Defense Contract Management Agency (DCMA).
* Certification in Customer Oriented Results and Excellence (CORE) or similar.
* American Society for Quality (ASQ) certification.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
* Experience leading initiatives that result in reduced operating costs, improved quality, and enhanced customer satisfaction.
* Experience with SAP (or similar ERP systems) and with Power Apps (or similar tools).

**What We Offer Benefits**

This position may offer relocation.

Some of our competitive benefits packages include:

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Three weeks of vacation for newly hired employees
* Generous 401(k) plan that includes employer matching funds and separate employer retirement contribution, including a Lifetime Income Strategy option
* Tuition reimbursement program
* Student Loan Repayment Program
* Life insurance and disability coverage
* Optional coverages you can buy pet insurance, home and auto insurance, additional life and accident insurance, critical illness insurance, group legal, ID theft protection
* Birth, adoption, parental leave benefits
* Ovia Health, fertility, and family planning
* Adoption Assistance
* Autism Benefit
* Employee Assistance Plan, including up to 10 free counseling sessions
* Healthy You Incentives, wellness rewards program
* Doctor on Demand, virtual doctor visits
* Bright Horizons, child and elder care services
* Teladoc Medical Experts, second opinion program
* And more!

**Learn More & Apply Now!**

Do you want to be a part of something bigger? A team whose impact stretches across the world, and even beyond? At Collins Aerospace, our Mission Systems team helps civilian, military and government customers complete their most complex missions — whatever and wherever they may be. Our customers depend on us for intelligent and secure communications, missionized systems for specialized aircraft and spacecraft and collaborative space solutions. By joining our team, you’ll have your own critical part to play in ensuring our customers succeed today while anticipating their needs for tomorrow. Are you up for the challenge? Join our mission today.

The next chapter of our future as an aerospace company is here, and we are excited about what this means for our employees and customers! Get onboard the Collins Aerospace Operations team and play a part in managing our innovative products from inception to delivery. The Operations team continues to grow and aims to strengthen the connection of Manufacturing Operations, Supply Chain and Environment, Health & Safety (EH&S) across Collins Aerospace. In this dynamic environment, you will have the opportunity to network across our businesses and functions, all while improving the productivity, quality and efficiency of our operations worldwide.

* Please ensure the role type (defined below) is appropriate for your needs before applying to this role.
* **Onsite:** Employees who are working in Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.

At Collins, the paths we pave together lead to limitless possibilities. And the bonds we form – with our customers and with each other - propel us all higher, again and again.

 

Apply now and be part of the team that’s redefining aerospace, every day.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Quality Assurance - GxP (GCP)
new_roles.description:
PTC Therapeutics is a global commercial biopharmaceutical company. For over 25 years our team has been deeply committed to a unified purpose: Extending life’s moments for children and adults living with a rare disease.

At PTC, we cultivate an inclusive culture where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds to join our team**,** fostering a strong sense of belonging.

Visit our website to learn more about our company and culture! 
Site: www.ptcbio.com

**Job Description Summary:**
----------------------------

The Senior Manager, Quality Assurance - GxP (GCP) is responsible for managing GxP Quality Assurance (QA) functions with an emphasis on Good Clinical Practice (GCP) compliance for development products. This involves engaging and collaborating with cross-functional internal and external teams to evaluate processes, procedures, and activities for adherence to relevant industry standards, regulatory guidelines, and company Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) as appropriate.
 
 
The incumbent will support and/or conduct internal and external GCP audits of investigator sites, vendors, clinical study reports, investigator brochures, and submission documents, etc.
 
 
She/He will assist in inspection readiness activities. 
 
She/He may manage direct reports. 
 
The incumbent works cross-functionally with internal departments and external resources on GxP QA related issues.
 
The Senior Manager, Quality Assurance – GxP (GCP)supports adherence to relevant regulatory requirements and company Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) as appropriate.

**Job Description:**
--------------------

*Responsibilities:*

* Partners with Clinical Development/Operations and actively participates in clinical study teams to ensure GCP compliance. Assists in identifying and communicating clinical trial-related risks and opportunities for process improvement. Reviews study-related documents and plans.
* Performs internal and external audits as assigned to ensure compliance with GXP regulations and guidelines.
* Communicates audit results to internal stakeholders and writes audit report.
* Assesses audit responses and ensures closure of corrective action preventative actions (CAPAs).
* Leads backroom activities during regulatory authority inspections and assists with GxP inspection readiness activities.
* Supports Quality Management System (QMS) including, but not be limited to, the following activities:
* QA review/approval of deviations, CAPAs and change controls.
* Drafts, reviews, and approves SOPs.
* May manage, coach, and mentor direct reports.
Performs other tasks and assignments as needed and specified by management. 

 

*Qualifications:*

Bachelor’s degree in a scientific discipline and a minimum of 7 years of relevant experience in Quality Assurance or related role in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or related environment.

* Detailed knowledge and understanding of GCP regulations.
* Demonstrated experience leading and/or conducting QA audits.
* Demonstrated experience developing and executing risk-based audit plans.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and foster positive, collaborative relationships with internal staff as well as with external, third-party vendors.
* Demonstrated leadership ability and experience managing, coaching, and mentoring direct reports.
* Experience supporting regulatory agency inspections.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively, as required, in a fast-paced, matrixed, team environment consisting of internal and external team members.
* Analytical thinker with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to adapt to changing priorities and deadlines.
* Excellent planning, organization, and time management skills including the ability to support and prioritize multiple projects.

*Special knowledge or skills and/or licenses or certificates preferred.*

* Experience writing and reviewing SOPs.
* Clinical lab experience.

* Registered GxP Quality Assurance Certifications.
* Experience supporting regulatory agency (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA) inspections.
* Knowledge and experience in Good Laboratory Practice (GLP), Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP), and/or Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GVP) regulations.

*Travel requirements: Up to 30% (Domestic and International)*

*Expected Base Salary Range: $141,900 -$175,000. The base salary offered will be contingent on assessment of candidate education level, background, and experience relative to the requirements of the position they are being considered for, as well as review of internal equity.*

*In addition to base salary, PTC employees are also eligible for short- and long-term incentives. All eligible employees may also enroll in PTC’s medical, dental, vision, and retirement savings plans*

**EEO Statement:**

**PTC Therapeutics is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all individuals, regardless of race, color, national origin, gender, age, physical characteristics, social origin, disability, religion, family status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, disability, veteran status or any unlawful criterion under applicable law. We are committed to treating all applicants fairly and avoiding discrimination.**

new_roles.title: Sr. Director, Infrastructure and Operations
new_roles.description:
**J****ob Title:** Sr. Director, Infrastructure and Operations

**Group:** Information Technology

**Location:** Hybrid

**Reports To**: Chief Information Officer

ASME is seeking a **Sr. Director, Infrastructure and Operations** to join our IT group. The Sr. Director will lead the strategy, architecture, engineering, and operations of ASME's infrastructure, telecommunications, networks, help desk, and related security capabilities.

This role will ensure secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-effective technology services while advancing DevOps practices, business continuity, disaster recovery, and responsible implementation of artificial intelligence across ASME's technology stack.

The position partners closely with Architecture and Applications, Security, the Project Management Office, and business leaders to support current operations and future enterprise needs.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the strategy, architecture, engineering, and day-to-day operations of ASME infrastructure, cloud, network, telecommunications, endpoint, help desk, and production platforms.
* Lead major infrastructure initiatives, establish policies and standards, strengthen cross-functional and vendor partnerships, and coach and develop a high-performing, customer-focused Technology team.
* Design and implement secure, compliant, reliable, scalable, and cost-effective infrastructure systems that integrate effectively with current applications and meet enterprise requirements.
* Determine current and future infrastructure needs, develop capital and expense budgets, and oversee vendors, service-level agreements, and key performance indicators.
* Build and continuously improve DevOps practices, methodologies, and tools that support continuous integration and continuous delivery.
* Direct business continuity, disaster recovery, institutional risk management, infrastructure documentation, and compliance with applicable security and data requirements, including PCI-DSS.
* Identify and implement emerging AI capabilities for Infrastructure and Operations, including AIOps, AI-enabled platform engineering, AI agents, and automation platforms, with appropriate governance, monitoring, security, lifecycle management, and risk controls.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in information technology or a related field, or equivalent additional experience; master's degree is a plus.
* Minimum of 8 years of relevant technical and leadership experience in infrastructure and operations.
* Extensive experience designing, implementing, and managing infrastructure, cloud, network, telecommunications, endpoint, virtualization, storage, recovery, and support environments, including Microsoft Azure.
* Experience with endpoint management and asset lifecycle solutions such as Microsoft Intune, PDQ, or Jamf, and with secure network architecture and protocols such as SASE; Cato experience is highly preferred.
* Demonstrated leadership experience in security, crisis management, business continuity, disaster recovery, risk management, and technology compliance.
* Experience applying project management frameworks to large-scale technology initiatives and communicating complex technical topics clearly to senior and executive leaders.
* Experience with emerging AI technologies, including Microsoft Copilot and private large language models, and the ability to build strong internal and external relationships.
* Proven experience leading, coaching, and developing high-performing technical teams.
* Demonstrated ability to establish clear standards, strengthen accountability, and build a customer-focused culture of operational excellence.
* Demonstrated success leading organizational change and operational improvement initiatives.

**Work Arrangement**

This role is eligible for a hybrid work arrangement and will be based in either our New York or New Jersey office locations, subject to ASME's hybrid-work policies and business requirements. Periodic business travel will be required, including but not limited to ASME Offices which are currently located in NYC, NJ, DC, TX.

**Compensation and Benefits**

The New York Metro annual base salary range for this position is $210,000–$225,000 per year. The actual compensation offered will be determined based on factors including qualifications, experience, skills, geographic location, and internal equity.

This position will also be eligible to participate in ASME's annual incentive bonus program, subject to the applicable plan terms and eligibility requirements.

Additionally, ASME offers eligible employees a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, prescription drug, dental, and vision coverage; health savings and flexible spending account options; life and disability insurance; a 401(k) retirement plan; paid vacation and safe and sick leave; paid holidays; parental leave; employee assistance and wellness programs; and professional-development opportunities. Eligibility and benefit levels vary based on employment status and the terms of the applicable plans. For additional information, please visit ASME's Benefits page.

**About ASME**

ASME helps the global engineering community develop solutions to real-world challenges. Founded in 1880 as The American Society of Mechanical Engineers, ASME is a nonprofit professional organization that enables collaboration, knowledge sharing, and skill development across all engineering disciplines, while promoting the vital role of the engineer in society. ASME codes and standards, publications, conferences, continuing education, and professional development programs provide a foundation for advancing technical knowledge and a safer world. From college students and early-career engineers to project managers, corporate executives, researchers, and academic leaders, ASME's members are as diverse as the engineering community itself.

ASME is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. At ASME, we nurture an inclusive environment, and we encourage, support, and celebrate diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, gender identity & expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, citizenship status, disability, or protected veteran, military status, or any other basis protected by law.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity policy pertains to every aspect of an individual’s relationship with the organization, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, compensation, benefits, training and development, promotion, programs, and all other terms and conditions of employment.

Only those candidates selected for further consideration will be contacted.

new_roles.title: Director, FP&A - Enterprise Operations
new_roles.description:
Company Overview:

**Why Choose Us?**
------------------

Novolex is a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging that supports multiple industries including foodservice, restaurant delivery and carryout, food processing, grocery and retail, and industrial sectors. Novolex manufacturing and sourcing expertise spans a diverse range of substrates including resin, paper, molded fiber, aluminum and more. We provide customers a broad array of stock and customized solutions with 120 product categories, 250 brands and over 39,000 SKUs.

**Our Sustainability Commitment**
---------------------------------

The Novolex sustainability vision is built upon three pillars: our products, our operations and our people. Each is critically important to our growth and future as a business. These pillars form the foundation of our company-wide commitment to sustainability, helping us achieve our ambitious goals through our wide-ranging initiatives.

Job Description:

The Director of Financial Planning & Analysis is a key leadership role responsible for financial planning, forecasting, reporting and analysis used to identify risks and opportunities across the business. The successful candidate will build strategic partnerships across business units and functional teams that will lead to improved processes and transparency around key operating metrics. This is a key member of the Enterprise Operations function, who will support senior leaders, including COO and Operations staff, to drive organizational transformation and ensure company financial objectives are met

**How You’ll Perform the Role**

 

* Oversee and coordinate monthly finance processes, resulting in added visibility and a clear understanding of business trends and overall financial outlook
* Oversee and directly guide annual Enterprise Operations budgeting process
* Responsible for management reporting, ensuring desired level of accuracy and timeliness is met
* Lead Capital Expenditure process, driving strong financial governance, and ensure effectiveness of capital deployment in generating favorable business outcomes
* Develop and implement tools and/or processes to establish forecasting, budgeting, reporting within function.
* Identify appropriate KPIs and reporting across the different levels of the organization to measure productivity, capital expenditure, and other operational metrics
* Conduct ad-hoc analyses with the ability to clearly summarize and present findings to executive leadership team members
* Partner across Operations, Engineering, Accounting and all necessary functions to drive business results and assure connectivity
* Connect with BU CFOs, Operations VPs, and Operations Finance to assure efficiencies and align processes

**What We Need From You**

 

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related Business field
* 10+ years of experience
* Experience leading teams both directly, indirectly, and leading projects cross-functionally

* Excellent business partnership skills with a record of collaborating across functions and levels within an organization to accomplish team goals
* Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills.
* Strategic thinking, ability to simplify the complex, make/drive decisions, and adapt to changing environment

* Proven analytical and financial skills, demonstrated strong economic thinking
* Clearly understand integrated financial systems and the Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Access, Word, PowerPoint)
* Travel approximately 10% or less

#LI-Hybrid

Company Benefits:

**What You'll Get From Us**
---------------------------

### **Benefits**

With safety as our top priority and a commitment to employee well-being an important focus, we offer comprehensive and competitive benefits that include medical, dental and vision insurance as well as a variety of other well-being resources focused on mental, physical and financial health. Specific benefits and well-being programs may vary depending on where you work.

### **Community Engagement**

At Novolex, giving back to the local communities that support us is important. Our Focused Giving Program prioritizes support for organizations whose missions promote sustainability initiatives or address food and hunger needs. We also encourage facility level support of activities in the communities where our employees live and work.

### **Training and Development**

We offer constant opportunities for advancement. From skills development to advanced education programs, training and development programs and courses are available through MyLearning. Programs include company and industry training curricula, support for formal education through the Tuition Reimbursement Program (Non-Union), and a Learning Management System that supports and enhances employee skills at all levels of the organization.

Novolex is committed to providing equal employment opportunity in all employment practices, including but not limited to selection, hiring, promotion, transfer, and compensation to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to age, race, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, handicap or disability, genetics, citizenship status, service member or veteran status, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law. Any individual who, because of his or her disability, needs an accommodation in connection with an aspect of the Company's application process should contact myHRservices@novolex.com.

new_roles.title: Director, Program Operations
new_roles.description:
In this role, the Director of Program Operations leads a team of Operations Program Managers (OPM) and Material Program Managers (MPM) responsible for the operational elements of program execution within Mercury's PCC Manufacturing Center of Excellence. This role serves as a conduit between the line of business and operational teams, ensuring seamless coordination across engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, and growth functions.

You will be responsible for developing and executing operational program plans for critical programs, overall ownership of operational program performance, and internal communication of customer requirements affecting operational execution.

The Director of Program Operations will support proposals by providing accurate basis of cost estimates, focusing on supply chain material costs in addition to manufacturing labor costs. This work will be performed in conjunction with factory operations, supply chain, and engineering functions. Candidates must have excellent written and oral communications skills to influence across multiple functions and communicate effectively with external partners.

This role is on site at one of the following Mercury facilities: **Phoenix AZ**

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of OPMs and MPMs accountable for operational aspects of program life cycle from proposal, development, production, sustainment, & delivery.
* Serve as the primary liaison between the line of business and operations, communicating customer requirements that affect manufacturing and supply chain execution.
* Responsible for meeting the financial objectives of the business unit, including the management of Estimate at Completion (EACs) specific to operations labor and material content.
* Oversee supply chain and manufacturing milestones to ensure compliance with contract baseline.
* Monitor program risks and opportunities, including obsolescence management, reporting, and improvement actions.
* Support and present operations metrics and data through program reviews (both internal and external) to Mercury and customer leadership.
* Champion efforts to meet readiness requirements throughout an NPI stage-gate process.
* Change leader, helping to drive Mercury's strategy, structure, and values.
* Strategic thinking coupled with ROI / business case development.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree.
* Typically requires 10+ years prior relevant experience in functional areas of Supply Chain, Operations (including Production Control), Program Management, or technical Project Management.
* Strong financial acumen with experience providing input into and reviewing EACs, along with development of business cases.
* Experience in review and understanding of Statements of Work (SOW) and project requirements (technical and commercial).
* Strong analytical skills, problem‑solving capabilities, and attention to detail.
* Experience developing and mentoring high‑performing teams.
* The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* A self-starter, capable of achieving organizational and program objectives, and able to interface with all levels of internal management and external stakeholders.
* Ability to succeed in fast paced, developmental environment.
* Excellent time management skills and the ability to assign the appropriate priorities to the many tasks that need to be performed.
* Knowledge of US Government acquisition laws and regulations (FAR).
* Proficiency in ERP/MRP business systems.
* Knowledge of Mercury-type products with surface mount technology.
* Excellent communication skills (written, verbal, and presentation), leadership abilities, and the ability to work in an IPT environment.

new_roles.description:
Flex is the diversified manufacturing partner of choice that helps market-leading brands design, build and deliver innovative products that improve the world.A career at Flex offers the opportunity to make a difference and invest in your growth in a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment. If you are excited about a role but don't meet every bullet point, we encourage you to apply and join us to create the extraordinary.

**Job Summary**
---------------





**General Purpose** **:**

Responsible for leading and developing a team of process engineers and technicians responsible for SMT manufacturing processes and continuous improvement. Provides technical and organizational leadership to establish and improve manufacturing process capabilities, increase capacity and throughput, reduce cost, improve quality and reliability, and support successful introduction of new products. Partners closely with Operations, Quality, Product Engineering, NPI, Supply Chain, Maintenance, and other functional teams to ensure manufacturing processes meet customer, quality, delivery, cost, and capacity requirements.

**Principal Accountabilities** **:**

* Lead, coach, develop, and manage a team of process engineers and technicians supporting SMT manufacturing, including board printing, SPI, pick and place, reflow, AOI, X-ray, and other back-end operations, excluding Box Assembly.

* Establish clear goals, priorities, performance expectations, and development plans for engineering team members. Provide regular coaching, feedback, performance management, and career development.

* Establish, maintain, and continuously improve process capabilities to achieve required levels of quality, reliability, throughput, capacity, and cost.

* Develop and maintain process documentation, including work instructions, PFMEA, Control Plans, process specifications, and other applicable manufacturing documentation.

* Lead engineering efforts to identify and eliminate process variation, defects, scrap, rework, downtime, and other sources of manufacturing inefficiency.

* Use data-driven problem-solving and appropriate engineering methodologies, including statistical analysis, SPC, DOE, root-cause analysis, and structured corrective action, to resolve complex manufacturing issues.

* Develop and maintain appropriate engineering and manufacturing performance metrics.

OEE, scrap, and yield to name a few

* Promote a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, collaboration, problem solving, and ownership within the engineering organization.

* Identify opportunities to improve engineering processes, tools, standards, and best practices and share lessons learned across the organization.

* Ensure engineering activities comply with applicable safety, environmental, quality-system, regulatory, customer, and company requirements.

* Build effective relationships with internal and external customers, suppliers, equipment manufacturers, and other technical partners as required.

* Communicate engineering priorities, project status, risks, resource requirements, and recommendations effectively to site and senior leadership.

* Implement appropriate HR strategies and actions to recruit, retain, develop, and motivate a qualified and high-performing engineering workforce.

**JOB REQUIREMENTS**

**EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE:**

Requires a bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent experience and training. A Master's or MBA degree is a plus but not required.

Typically requires **9 years** of engineering experience, including experience leading or supervising engineering personnel. Experience in high-volume electronics manufacturing and SMT processes is strongly preferred.

 

**KNOWLEDGE / SKILLS / ABILITIES:**

* Demonstrated functional, technical, and people-management skills, with the ability to lead engineers and technicians in a manufacturing environment.

* Strong knowledge of SMT manufacturing processes, including solder paste printing, SPI, pick and place, reflow, AOI, X-ray, and related manufacturing processes.

* Demonstrated understanding of process capability, statistical process control, root-cause analysis, DOE, PFMEA, Control Plans, and structured continuous improvement methodologies.

* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence decisions across Engineering, Operations, Quality, NPI, Product Engineering, Supply Chain, Maintenance, and other functions.

* Ability to establish priorities, allocate resources, manage competing projects, and make sound engineering and business decisions.

* Demonstrated ability to use manufacturing and engineering data to identify problems, establish facts, determine root causes, and drive measurable improvements.

* Strong understanding of manufacturing economics, including cost reduction, capacity, throughput, capital investment, and return on investment.

* Demonstrated ability to develop, coach, and retain engineering talent and build a high-performing team.

* Strong interpersonal, communication, presentation, and organizational skills.

* Ability to communicate complex technical information effectively to engineers, technicians, operations personnel, customers, and senior management.

* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret complex technical, engineering, financial, and business documents.

* Ability to respond effectively to sensitive inquiries and complaints and resolve complex issues using sound judgment and appropriate communication.

* Ability to make effective and persuasive presentations regarding technical recommendations, business cases, project status, and complex engineering issues.

* Ability to work with mathematical concepts including probability, statistical inference, process capability, and statistical analysis and apply them to practical manufacturing situations.

* Ability to define problems, collect and analyze data, establish facts, draw valid conclusions, and develop practical solutions.

* Demonstrated proficiency with common engineering and business software, including word processing, spreadsheets, presentations, data analysis, and other applicable manufacturing/engineering systems.

* Working knowledge of applicable employment laws, company policies, and HR practices.

AA01

LB34

 
 

**What you'll receive for the great work you provide:**

* Full range of medical, dental, and vision plans
* Life Insurance
* Short-term and Long-term Disability
* Matching 401(k) Contributions
* Vacation and Paid Sick Time
* Tuition Reimbursement

new_roles.description:
**Hyve Company Overview**
-------------------------

Hyve Solutions transforms complex engineering challenges into production reality for technology innovators building AI, cloud, and connected infrastructure. As a US-based manufacturing partner, the company rapidly delivers fast, agile execution through dep technical partnerships and co-innovation, and supply chain clarity. Hyve’s integrated ODM, CM, and SI capabilities eliminate vendor complexity while accelerating time-to-market with single-partner accountability from design through scale. The company co-innovates with deep engineering expertise, treating customer success as its own while building tomorrow's digital infrastructure.

 
 

Hyve Solutions is seeking a highly technical, hands-on Manufacturing Engineering Manager to lead engineering operations within our fast-paced, high-volume PCBA manufacturing environment. This position is responsible for driving manufacturing process development, equipment performance, automation, and continuous improvement while ensuring the successful transition of new products from introduction (NPI) into stable, scalable mass production. The ideal candidate combines strong SMT/PCBA technical expertise with proven leadership capabilities, a passion for solving complex manufacturing challenges, and a proactive, floor-oriented approach to engineering. We are looking for a leader who takes ownership of manufacturing performance, develops strong engineering teams, and drives practical, sustainable solutions that improve quality, throughput, efficiency, and operational scalability.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead, develop, and manage the Manufacturing Engineering team, establishing clear priorities, technical accountability, and performance expectations
* Own manufacturing process development, optimization, and technical support across SMT, automated assembly, soldering, inspection, and related PCBA manufacturing operations
* Lead the transition of new products from NPI into high-volume production, ensuring manufacturing readiness, process capability, equipment qualification, and sustainable production performance
* Partner with NPI, Product Engineering, Test Engineering, Quality, and Operations to identify manufacturability risks, resolve technical challenges, and establish robust production processes
* Drive equipment programming, process parameter optimization, machine capability improvements, and automation initiatives to maximize manufacturing efficiency and reliability
* Provide hands-on technical leadership in troubleshooting complex equipment failures, process defects, yield losses, and recurring production issues
* Establish and improve manufacturing process controls, validation methods, and standardized engineering practices to ensure consistent product quality and repeatability
* Lead root cause investigations and corrective actions for manufacturing-related defects, equipment issues, and process instability
* Evaluate and implement new manufacturing technologies, equipment, tooling, and automation solutions to improve production capability and support business growth
* Support manufacturing capacity expansion, equipment installation, production line integration, and facility transitions while minimizing operational disruptions
* Analyze manufacturing performance metrics, including yield, cycle time, throughput, downtime, and process capability, to identify improvement opportunities and drive measurable results
* Collaborate with Operations, Quality, Maintenance, and Materials teams to establish manufacturing priorities, resolve production constraints, and improve overall operational performance
* Develop and maintain manufacturing engineering standards, process documentation, work instructions, and change control processes to support consistent execution
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on defect reduction, equipment utilization, labor efficiency, cost reduction, and manufacturing scalability
* Develop engineering talent through technical mentorship, structured problem-solving, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement of team capabilities

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent experience may be considered
* Minimum of 7 years of progressive manufacturing engineering experience, including 3 years in an engineering leadership or management role, preferred
* Preferred hands-on experience in SMT and PCBA manufacturing processes, including pick and place equipment, solder paste printing, reflow soldering, AOI, AXI, selective soldering, and related manufacturing processes
* Demonstrated success transitioning products from NPI through production qualification, ramp-up, and sustained high-volume manufacturing
* Experience with industrial automation, equipment integration, machine programming, and manufacturing process controls
* Proven ability to lead technical teams, establish accountability, develop engineering talent, and manage competing priorities in a dynamic manufacturing environment
* Strong understanding of manufacturing process validation, root cause analysis, defect reduction, yield improvement, and equipment reliability
* Familiarity with IPC standards, DFM/DFT principles, PFMEA, SPC, and structured problem-solving methodologies
* Familiarity with ISO9001 and ISO14001

**What’s in it for you**
------------------------

Benefit Insurance

* Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* Health Savings Account (HSA)
* Mental Health Care
* 401K with match
* Paid Holidays, Vacation & Sick Days
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Perks at Work
* LEAP Program
* MyFlexPay

***We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.***

new_roles.description:
Description:

**Job Title:** Director of Campus Operations

**Department:** Facilities

**Reports To:** Executive Director of Administration

**Direct Reports:** Assistant Director of Campus Operations

**FLSA Status:** Exempt

**Prepared By:** Human Resources

**Prepared Date:** November 11, 2026

**OUR MISSION**

The mission of Eastern Star Church is to form followers of Jesus to love God, love people, and live to serve. Guided by our vision of Growing People to Love Like Jesus, we are committed to creating environments that support worship, discipleship, community engagement, and service.

**YOUR ROLE IN OUR MISSION**

Under the direction of the Executive Director of Administration, the **Director of Campus Operations** provides strategic leadership, oversight, and accountability for campus operations and facilities across Eastern Star Church and its affiliated organizations, including JEWEL Human Services.

This role is responsible for establishing operational standards, ensuring effective stewardship of facilities and resources, and leading the development and performance of the operations team. Through direct supervision of the Assistant Director of Operations and other assigned leaders, the Director ensures that campus operations are safe, efficient, consistent, and aligned with organizational priorities.

The Director serves as a key partner in advancing the ministry’s mission and strategic plan by ensuring that our facilities and physical environments support worship, discipleship, community outreach, and an exceptional experience for all who enter. The position emphasizes strategic planning, leadership development, financial accountability, and continuous improvement while delegating day-to-day operational execution to the Assistant Director of Operations.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Provide strategic leadership, direction, and oversight for campus operations and facilities across Eastern Star Church and its affiliated properties, under the direction of the Executive Director of Administration.
* Establish operational standards and performance expectations to ensure all facilities are safe, functional, well-maintained, and reflective of a culture of excellence and stewardship, holding the Assistant Director of Operations accountable for daily implementation.
* Develop and recommend long-term facilities strategies, including capital improvements, renovations, and expansion planning, in alignment with organizational priorities and the direction of the Executive Director of Administration.
* Provide leadership and oversight for facilities-related capital projects, ensuring appropriate planning, budgeting, resource allocation, and accountability for successful completion within approved timelines and budgets.
* Lead, coach, and develop the Assistant Director of Operations and other assigned direct reports, establishing clear expectations, delegated responsibilities, performance measures, and opportunities for professional growth.
* Establish and maintain consistent operational policies, facility standards, and accountability measures across all campuses and affiliated properties, ensuring effective implementation through the Assistant Director of Operations.
* Partner with executive leadership, Campus Pastors, ministry leaders, and production and creative teams to align campus operations, facility resources, and operational priorities with worship services, programs, events, and organizational needs.
* Provide strategic oversight of vendor relationships, contracts, and service providers, ensuring quality, compliance, cost-effectiveness, and accountability, while delegating routine vendor coordination and service management to the Assistant Director of Operations.
* Develop, manage, and monitor facilities and operations budgets in partnership with Finance and the Executive Director of Administration, ensuring responsible stewardship of resources, financial accountability, and timely identification of budget variances.
* Establish and oversee safety, security, emergency preparedness, and risk management standards, ensuring regulatory compliance and holding operational leadership accountable for implementing and maintaining required procedures.
* Lead the development and continuous improvement of operational systems, processes, technology, and workflows that strengthen efficiency, consistency, communication, and accountability across all campus operations.
* Establish campus experience and operational readiness standards to ensure facilities consistently provide safe, welcoming, functional, and well-prepared environments that support ministry effectiveness and reflect the mission of Eastern Star Church.
* Establish and monitor departmental performance goals and key performance indicators, evaluating operational effectiveness, preventive maintenance performance, campus readiness, service delivery, and resource utilization.
* Provide regular operational reports to the Executive Director of Administration, including departmental performance, budget status, capital project progress, operational risks, and recommendations for continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with the Executive Director of Administration to establish departmental priorities, evaluate organizational needs, recommend resource allocations, and support the implementation of organizational strategic initiatives.
* Carry out all responsibilities with excellence, integrity, trust, professionalism, and the utmost confidentiality.

Perform other duties as assigned

Requirements:

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Demonstrated alignment with the mission, vision, and values of the ministry.
* Proven ability to lead large-scale operations and facilities across multiple sites.
* Strong leadership presence with the ability to influence across departments.
* Active member of Eastern Star Church within three months of starting in the role
* Attend at least one weekly Sunday service.
* Active in a Ministry within three months of starting in the role.
* Complete FFI 101 series or is currently enrolled in class.
* Consistent giver as an opportunity to show God Owns It All by giving back to Him the first of what He gives to us.
* Please refer to the Eastern Star Church Discipleship Policy for additional details.

**EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of leadership experience in operations, facilities, or multi-site management
* Experience leading large-scale projects, capital improvements, renovations, multi-site operations and vendor relationships.
* Strong financial and budget management experience.
* A combination of relevant experience and demonstrated leadership may be considered in place of formal education requirements.

**CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS**

* Relevant facilities, operations, or project management certifications (preferred but not required).

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORKING CONDITIONS**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met to perform the essential functions of this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* This role requires regular travel between multiple campus and organizational locations.
* Must be available to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as required for church services, events, emergencies, and operational needs.
* Work is performed in a combination of office, campus, event, and facilities environments.
* Must be able to stand, walk, climb stairs, inspect facilities, and move throughout campus locations for extended periods of time.
* Must be able to effectively communicate in meetings, public settings, and operational environments.
* Must be able to occasionally lift and transport materials or equipment up to 25 pounds.
* Requires the ability to manage multiple priorities and respond effectively in fast-paced and high-demand environments

new_roles.title: Director, Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
* Team:Industrial Operations & Product Supply
* Location:Saratoga Springs
* Req ID:R53235
* Contract:Full time
* Work Pattern:Onsite

**The role**
------------

**Build our future together:**

At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. We’re hiring an Associate Director/Director of Operational Excellence for our highly automated bulk/ drug substance manufacturing plant, supporting 20–30 tech transfers a year alongside commercial delivery responsibility. GMP production will run concurrently with construction and CQV for 3–5 years. This role requires both building and operating.

 
 

This site operates on a foundation of strategy, execution, and discipline. Every function at the site owns a pyramid of metrics derived from annual goal planning that connects the site’s strategic goals to the factory floor, with performance measured back up to leadership to monitor, track, and mitigate against contingencies quantified using SMART goals in days and dollars.

 
 

The Associate Director/Director of Operational Excellence runs our site MDI (managing for daily improvements) OpEx, continuous improvement programs, and all site PMO operations owning the site project register and deciding how work is staffed and prioritized across the project portfolio while coordinating cross-functional projects. They build the operating rhythm that turns discrete functions into one aligned site team as the site scales to six suites, and owns the site’s strategy, execution, and culture discipline planning. Lead executive-level investigations and special initiatives as project/program lead, absorbing crisis response so operational leaders can stay focused on daily management.

 
 

**When & where:**

* Location: Saratoga Springs, New York, United States

* Work model: Monday-Friday, 8am-4:30pm
 

 

**Discover your role:**

* Run site MDI including ownership of the Tier 6 site critical issue forum, ensuring cross-functional blockers are surfaced and resolved quickly

* Establish and sustain the site's cadence of daily, weekly, and monthly forums so issues are raised and resolved at the right level

* Lead OpEx and continuous improvement programs, building and prioritizing a CI project pipeline and delivering realized savings

* Lead all site PMO activities, owning the site project register and deciding how work is staffed and prioritized across the project portfolio, coordinating cross-functional projects and site initiatives and driving on-time delivery

* Own site strategy, execution, and rigor planning for culture translating strategic priorities into a disciplined, trackable execution plan across the site

* Own MDI and all standard work initiatives site-wide, ensuring consistent methodology and application across every function and suite

* Own site-wide implementation of lean principles building and driving the phased adoption roadmap across leadership, suites, and functions, from initial leadership alignment through daily floor-level practice

* Own site business analytics building and maintaining the reporting, dashboards, and KPI infrastructure that drive MDI, CI prioritization, and Site Leadership Team decision-making

* Co-lead the monthly finance/business review with finance operations, reconciling cost and capital needs against the site's financial plan

* Coach leaders and teams in Lean and problem-solving methods and build an OpEx culture across the site

* Embed MDI and OpEx practices as suites come online so new suites start up with the site's operating standards

* Partner with manufacturing, quality, technical services, technical operations, supply chain, and Finance as a member of the site leadership team

* Embed the digital and connected plant model in site MDI, using real-time data and digital tools for daily management and escalation

* Own the site's multi-year operational efficiency roadmap, driving leaner operations and delivering year-over-year efficiency gains

* Build, coach, and retain a high-performing OpEx team; establish high standards for performance management and accountability; perform other duties as required

* Own a gross margin improvement program and goal for this function, contributing to the site's overall margin performance

* Ensure this function's metrics flow up and down through the MDI structure, connecting into the site's S&OP, AOP, and long-range planning cycles

* Own these function's OpEx and CapEx budget and roadmap

* Serve as the primary party responsible for this function's alignment with the Global Center of Excellence (COE), connecting site execution back to the business-level function
 

 

**This role requires:**

* B.S in engineering, life sciences, business or related technical field
* MBA & PMP certification preferred

* + Associate Director: 10+ years of operational excellence, continuous improvement, or manufacturing operations or biopharmaceuticals including 5+ years of progressive leadership

* + Director: 12+ years in operational excellence, continuous improvement, or manufacturing operations or biopharmaceuticals including 7+ years of progressive leadership

* + Level will be determined based on experience

* Previous people leadership/supervisory experience

new_roles.title: Director of Warehouse Operations
new_roles.description:
**Director of Warehouse Operations**

**Your Leadership. Our Foundation.**

At **Cash Depot**, you’re not just joining a company, you’re becoming part of a family.

As a nationwide leader in ATM management and financial transaction processing, we’ve built our reputation on innovation, exceptional customer service, and strong partnerships. As we continue expanding our footprint and evolving our solutions, we’re seeking a strategic, hands-on operations leader to oversee the teams that keep our ATM equipment and components ready to support our customers.

When you join Cash Depot, you’re stepping into an organization where your ideas matter, your leadership is valued, and your impact is visible across the business. This is an opportunity to lead four teams, improve how our operations run, and build a high-performing warehouse organization focused on efficiency, quality, and long-term success.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation package
* **Profit Sharing Bonus Program**
* **Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits**
* **Company-paid Life Insurance**
* **Company-paid Short-Term Disability (STD)**
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid time off and holidays
* Monday through Friday daytime schedule
* Leadership visibility with a direct reporting line to the COO
* Opportunity to shape how our operations grow and improve
* Stable, growing organization with nationwide operations

**Position Summary**

The **Director of Warehouse Operations** provides strategic leadership, direction, and oversight for Cash Depot’s Inventory and Warehousing, ATM Parts Repair, ATM Set-Up and Refurbishment, and Purchasing departments.

Reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer, the Director is accountable for operational efficiency, inventory accuracy, cost management, quality control, productivity, and the timely availability of ATM equipment and components to support company operations and customer commitments.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Operational Leadership & Cost Management**

* Manage departmental budgets and identify opportunities to reduce operating costs.
* Improve productivity and eliminate inefficiencies across warehouse, repair, refurbishment, and purchasing functions.
* Analyze operational data to identify bottlenecks and opportunities for improvement.
* Increase throughput, quality, and profitability across all areas of responsibility.

**Inventory, Repair & Equipment Readiness**

* Improve inventory accuracy, availability, and inventory turns.
* Improve repair turnaround times and reduce replacement costs.
* Ensure ATM equipment is set up, refurbished, and deployment-ready on schedule.
* Maintain quality standards that support company operations and customer commitments.

**Purchasing & Vendor Management**

* Improve vendor pricing, procurement efficiency, and cost controls.
* Ensure timely availability of ATM equipment, parts, and components.
* Build productive vendor relationships that support quality and reliability.

**Team Development & Accountability**

* Lead, develop, and hold accountable four department leaders: the Warehouse Manager, Purchasing Manager, Parts Repair Lead, and Setup/Refurb Lead.
* Set clear performance standards and expectations across all four departments.
* Build and foster high-performing teams aligned with Cash Depot’s culture and values.
* Operate within corporate policy guidelines and business practices.

**Requirements**

* 3–5 years of operations management experience preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze data and identify operational bottlenecks or opportunities.
* Deep understanding of service delivery principles and customer satisfaction.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite or other relevant systems.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Strong ability to lead and inspire teams.
* Excellent communication skills to collaborate with teams, customers, and leadership.
* Results-oriented with a demonstrated sense of urgency.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.
* Ability to adapt to change in the workplace or in assigned duties.
* Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

**Why Cash Depot?**

This is an opportunity to join a growing national organization in a highly visible leadership role. As Director of Warehouse Operations, you’ll lead the teams that keep Cash Depot’s ATM equipment moving, shape how our operations run, and directly influence the service we deliver to customers across the country.

**Join Cash Depot and lead the operations that power our next chapter of growth.**

new_roles.title: Director, Strategy & Operations
new_roles.description:
**The Problem**

Severe mental illness affects over 15 million adults in the United States. Schizophrenia. Schizoaffective disorder. Bipolar I. Treatment-resistant depression. These are the conditions the rest of healthcare has systematically failed to build for.

What makes this problem different from most of healthcare is that the tools to solve it do not exist. The clinical protocols, the measurement science, the precision medicine, the technology to deliver coordinated longitudinal outpatient care for this population. None of it has been built. This is a frontier problem, and it requires frontier science and care delivery to solve.

We are developing all of it. The care, the science, the technology.

**Who We Are**

Amae Health is a Series B, venture-backed Public Benefit Corporation delivering specialty outpatient care for people with severe mental illness through high-acuity, in-person clinics nationwide.

Our integrated model brings psychiatry, therapy, primary care, dietitians, and community support together under one roof. Leading health systems—including **New York-Presbyterian, Cedars-Sinai, Mass General Brigham, Novant Health, and CommonSpirit**—collaborate with us to expand this level of care.

Alongside care delivery, we are building the science and technology the field has long lacked—proprietary clinical protocols, novel measurement, and an AI-driven data platform designed for severe mental illness.

The impact: fewer hospitalizations, greater stability, and more people living meaningful lives in their communities.

**The Team**

We are clinicians, operators, technologists, and scientists who chose Amae because the problem is hard and the stakes are real. We are not interested in incremental improvements to a broken system—we are redefining it.

Every function—finance, product, people, growth, technology—exists to serve one goal: better outcomes for the people we care for.

**The Role**

Amae Health is seeking a strategic and execution-oriented **Director of Growth & Operations** to lead market expansion and operational performance across our care delivery ecosystem. This leader will sit at the intersection of market growth, community partnerships, and operational excellence. This role is based in SF Bay Area, in-person 5 days/week in Cow Hollow.

**What You'll Work On**

* Lead cross-functional initiatives that improve day-to-day care delivery: new market launches, care model design, referral conversion, and operational scalability
* Build and implement market playbooks, workflows, and performance frameworks that enable consistent execution across locations
* Use data and frontline feedback to identify bottlenecks, then build and drive improvement initiatives with clear owners and measurable outcomes
* Lead cross-functional workstreams across clinical, ops, and product; manage alignment, communication, and rollout
* Build the systems and SOPs that turn one-off solutions into scalable standards

**What You'll Bring**

* 7+ years of experience in strategy, operations, or growth roles at a venture-backed startup, consulting firm, or healthcare company
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence clinical and executive stakeholders
* Experience in commercially-oriented work: market expansion, partnership operations, or growth initiatives
* Strong analytical and operational mindset with ability to translate strategy into execution
* Startup experience strongly preferred—you've navigated ambiguity and figured things out without a playbook
* Collaborative and high-EQ; you know how to move cross-functional teams without formal authority
* Interest in healthcare or behavioral health; you care about the mission
* Based in SF Bay Area; able to work in-person 5 days/week in Cow Hollow

**What We're Building**

Most healthcare companies ask you to optimize an existing system. We're building one that has never existed.

* A national care model designed for the highest-acuity patients in behavioral health.
* Precision medicine for severe mental illness, using multimodal clinical, behavioral, and social data to personalize treatment.
* A clinical operating system that integrates longitudinal data, real-time patient signals, and purpose-built tools into a single decision layer.
* New science and measurement frameworks to define what real outcomes look like in SMI.
* A health-system partnership model proving coordinated SMI care can work at scale.

**Compensation & Benefits**

Amae Health is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. **Base salary range for this role is $165,000–$200,000 per year**, adjusted to market cost; the compensation package may include equity. Total compensation includes comprehensive medical/dental/vision, unlimited PTO, parental leave, and programs built around employee well-being. We'll share specifics during the interview process.

*Amae Health is building the care platform, the precision medicine, and the frontier science that severe mental illness has never had. If you want to be part of creating something this hard and this important, something that has never been done, we'd like to talk.*

**What We Value**

* **We center care in all we do.** Empathy is not a brand value. It's how we make clinical decisions, build products, and treat each other.
* **We challenge convention.** The existing system is the problem. We question it, we test alternatives, and we move with urgency when something works.
* **We take the work seriously, not ourselves.** High standards and humanity are not in tension. We hold a hard bar for quality while leaving room for humor and levity.
* **Your job isn't done until the job is done.** We close gaps, we follow through, and we don't hide behind titles or org charts.
* **We win together and fail together.** We own outcomes as a team. We learn fast. We don't do blame.
* **We hustle with humility.** Speed matters. So does integrity. We assume best intent and stay grounded in the mission.
