existing_roles.title: Plant Manager
existing_roles.description:
**Compensation Range:**

$122,800 - $204,600

**Plant Manager**

Department: Operations / Manufacturing

Reports To: Director of Operations

Direct Reports: Production Managers, Facilities Manager, and other assigned manufacturing leadership

Scope: Three manufacturing buildings / multi-product HVAC manufacturing operation

**Position**

The Plant Manager is responsible for the overall leadership, performance, and day-to-day execution of manufacturing operations across three buildings within a large HVAC manufacturing facility. This position provides hands-on leadership to ensure the plant safely produces high-quality products on schedule, at the required volume and cost, while developing a strong culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

The Plant Manager is responsible for coordinating production activities across multiple manufacturing processes and buildings, including assembly, sheet metal fabrication, welding, piping/refrigeration, testing, material flow, and final product completion.

The successful candidate will establish clear operating standards, drive cross-functional accountability, develop manufacturing leadership, remove operational constraints, and ensure the plant has the people, processes, equipment, and infrastructure required to support current production and future growth.

This position is expected to be highly visible on the manufacturing floor and serves as the primary operational leader responsible for translating business objectives into daily execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Plant Leadership & Operational Execution**

* Provide overall leadership and direction for manufacturing operations across all three buildings.
* Establish daily, weekly, and monthly operating priorities aligned with business requirements.
* Ensure production plans are executed safely, efficiently, and according to customer commitments.
* Maintain strong communication and coordination between buildings and manufacturing departments.
* Establish clear ownership and accountability for production performance.
* Lead daily plant operating reviews and ensure corrective actions are completed.
* Identify and remove constraints affecting throughput, capacity, quality, or delivery.
* Maintain appropriate production capacity, staffing, equipment, and infrastructure to support business growth.
* Ensure standardized processes are consistently followed across all buildings.
* Maintain a strong management presence on the manufacturing floor.

**2. Production Management**

* Lead Production Managers and ensure effective management of production personnel.
* Establish production priorities based on customer demand, capacity, material availability, and schedule requirements.
* Ensure production schedules are achieved while balancing labor, equipment, materials, and testing capacity.
* Monitor production flow from fabrication through final assembly and testing.
* Develop and maintain effective production metrics and visual management systems.
* Identify bottlenecks and implement corrective actions to improve throughput.
* Ensure appropriate escalation processes are in place when production performance is at risk.
* Coordinate production activities between the three buildings to maximize overall plant capacity.

**3. Safety, Environmental & Compliance**

* Establish safety as the facility’s highest operational priority.
* Partner with EHS leadership to maintain a strong safety culture across all three buildings.
* Ensure compliance with OSHA, environmental regulations, company requirements, and applicable industry standards.
* Drive accountability for safe work practices at all levels of the organization.
* Ensure timely investigation and corrective action following incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions.
* Support programs designed to reduce injuries, ergonomic risks, environmental impacts, and workplace hazards.
* Ensure employees receive appropriate safety training and understand their responsibilities.

**4. Quality**

* Partner with Quality leadership to ensure products meet customer, engineering, and company requirements.
* Establish accountability for first-time quality and defect prevention.
* Drive reduction of scrap, rework, warranty issues, and production defects.
* Ensure quality issues are rapidly escalated and contained.
* Support root-cause analysis and corrective-action processes.
* Promote quality at the source rather than relying on downstream inspection.
* Maintain compliance with the plant's quality management system and ISO requirements.

**5. Lean Manufacturing & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead the implementation and sustainability of Lean Manufacturing Principles throughout all three buildings.
* Establish a culture of continuous improvement and employee involvement.
* Drive 5S, visual management, standardized work, problem solving, waste elimination, and flow improvements.
* Support Value Stream Mapping and improvement of end-to-end product flow.
* Establish measurable improvement targets for productivity, quality, delivery, inventory, and cost.
* Partner with Lean/Manufacturing Engineering leadership to prioritize improvement projects based on business impact.
* Ensure Lean improvements are sustained through management systems and standard work.
* Develop frontline leaders capable of independently identifying and solving operational problems.

**6. People Leadership & Organizational Development**

* Develop a high-performing manufacturing leadership team.
* Establish clear expectations, accountability, and performance standards.
* Coach and develop Production Managers, Supervisors, and other manufacturing leaders.
* Identify organizational capability gaps and work with Human Resources to develop staffing and development plans.
* Support workforce planning and hiring activities necessary to meet production requirements.
* Establish effective onboarding and training processes for new employees.
* Develop succession plans for key manufacturing positions.
* Promote employee engagement, teamwork, ownership, and accountability.
* Address performance issues promptly and consistently.

**7. Capacity & Business Growth**

* Develop manufacturing capacity plans to support current and future customer demand.
* Partner with Operations, Engineering, Finance, Materials, and other functions to identify capacity requirements.
* Evaluate labor, equipment, floor space, testing, utilities, and infrastructure requirements.
* Support capital planning and justification for new equipment and facility improvements.
* Ensure new production areas and buildings are effectively integrated into the overall manufacturing system.
* Develop ramp-up plans for new products, programs, and production transfers.
* Ensure the plant can scale production without compromising safety, quality, or delivery performance.

**8. Cross-Functional Leadership**

Work closely with:

* Director of Operations
* Production
* Materials
* Production Planning
* Logistics
* Quality
* EHS
* Lean / Manufacturing Engineering
* Facilities
* Maintenance
* Engineering
* Finance
* Human Resources
* Supply Chain
* Sales / Customer teams

Ensure cross-functional issues are identified early, assigned to the appropriate owner, and driven to resolution.

**9. Facilities, Equipment & Infrastructure**

* Partner with Facilities and Maintenance leadership to ensure buildings, utilities, production equipment, cranes, test infrastructure, and other critical assets support production requirements.
* Establish preventive and predictive maintenance expectations.
* Ensure critical production equipment has appropriate contingency plans.
* Support capital equipment selection, installation, commissioning, and production launch.
* Ensure facility expansion projects are integrated into manufacturing operations with minimal disruption to production.

**10. Performance Management & Accountability**

Establish and maintain a plant operating system based on measurable performance.

Key performance indicators should include:

Safety

* Recordable incident rate
* Lost-time incidents
* Near misses
* Safety observations
* Corrective-action closure

Quality

* First-pass yield
* Scrap
* Rework
* Customer defects
* Warranty / quality escapes

Delivery

* On-time delivery
* Schedule attainment
* Production attainment
* Manufacturing lead time
* Test-bay utilization / throughput

Productivity

* Labor productivity
* Units per labor hour
* OEE where applicable
* Direct labor efficiency
* Throughput

Cost

* Manufacturing cost
* Labor variance
* Scrap cost
* Overtime
* Cost of poor quality

Lean

* 5S performance
* Kaizen completion
* Standard work compliance
* Improvement savings
* Value-stream performance

The Plant Manager will ensure performance is reviewed routinely and that corrective actions have clearly identified owners and due dates.

**Leadership Expectations**

The Plant Manager is expected to:

* Lead from the floor rather than from the office.
* Establish a culture of accountability without creating a culture of blame.
* Make decisions based on facts and data.
* Escalate issues early rather than allowing problems to become emergencies.
* Develop leaders instead of personally solving every problem.
* Maintain a strong focus on safety and quality while driving production.
* Create alignment between the three buildings rather than allowing them to operate as independent plants.
* Establish consistent standards and expectations across the operation.
* Communicate clearly with employees, leadership, and cross-functional partners.
* Demonstrate urgency while maintaining disciplined problem solving.
* Build an organization capable of supporting significant business growth.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing, Engineering, Operations, Business, Supply Chain, or related field preferred.
* 7+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience.
* 3+ years of plant or multi-department manufacturing management experience.
* Experience managing large manufacturing organizations, multiple production areas, and facilities.
* Experience in HVAC, refrigeration, industrial equipment, sheet metal, welding, assembly, or related manufacturing strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience managing significant production growth or plant expansion.
* Strong understanding of Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Demonstrated experience managing safety, quality, delivery, and cost performance.
* Strong financial and business acumen.
* Experience developing and leading supervisors and managers.
* Strong communication and organizational skills.
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth manufacturing environment.

**2. Full P&L Ownership & Financial Performance**

* Own the financial performance of the region, including revenue, EBITDA, labor, chemicals, materials, maintenance, and capital expenditures.
* Drive profitable growth through disciplined financial management, cost optimization, and operational accountability.
* Establish clear financial expectations and performance metrics throughout the organization.
* Develop accurate forecasts, budgets, and action plans to improve business performance.
* Communicate financial results, opportunities, challenges, and corrective actions to executive leadership.

**3. Wastewater Expertise & Operational Excellence**

* Provide strategic and technical leadership across a portfolio of industrial wastewater treatment operations.
* Leverage your deep wastewater knowledge to improve treatment performance, process stability, compliance, and operating efficiency.
* Establish consistent operating standards, SOPs, preventive maintenance programs, and performance metrics across all locations.
* Drive standardization and best-practice implementation while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce costs.
* Lead troubleshooting and problem-solving efforts on complex wastewater treatment challenges.
* Champion continuous improvement, root cause analysis, process optimization, and operational discipline.

**4. Customer Leadership & Retention**

* Own the overall customer experience and build long-term, trusted relationships with key customer stakeholders.
* Maintain a strong customer retention rate through proactive engagement, exceptional service delivery, and measurable results.
* Lead strategic customer business reviews and identify opportunities to deliver additional value.
* Partner with Key Account Managers to ensure customer expectations are consistently met and exceeded.
* Position Solution Group as a strategic wastewater partner, not simply a service provider.

**5. Safety, Compliance & Operational Discipline**

* Establish a culture where safety, environmental compliance, and operational excellence are non-negotiable.
* Partner with HSE leadership to drive safety performance, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure all locations maintain strong environmental compliance, documentation, training, and preventative safety practices.
* Champion 5S, workplace organization, and consistent execution of operational standards.
* Lead with visibility, accountability, and a commitment to ensuring every employee goes home safely.

**6. Build, Develop & Inspire High-Performing Teams**

* Recruit, develop, and retain exceptional operational leaders and wastewater professionals.
* Lead and coach Key Account Managers, Regional Managers, and Site Managers.
* Establish clear expectations, performance goals, and accountability throughout the region.
* Develop succession plans and create opportunities for employees to grow into greater leadership responsibilities.
* Build a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous learning, and results.
* Lead by example and inspire teams to take pride in their work, their customers, and their performance.

**7. Enterprise Leadership & Collaboration**

* Work closely with other General Managers and corporate leadership to share best practices and drive company-wide success.
* Collaborate with Technical Services, Business Development, Sales, HR, Finance, and HSE to strengthen capabilities and execute strategic initiatives.
* Contribute to the long-term growth, scalability, and success of Solution Group.

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We are looking for a strong, confident, entrepreneurial leader who brings together deep technical wastewater expertise, proven operational leadership, and a genuine passion for building a business.

**You are someone who:**

* Knows wastewater treatment. You understand industrial wastewater processes, treatment systems, troubleshooting, chemistry, compliance, and the operational challenges our customers face.
* Thinks like a business owner. You understand P&L performance, revenue growth, cost control, and what it takes to build a profitable operation.
* Is commercially driven. You naturally identify opportunities, build relationships, grow accounts, and turn customer challenges into business opportunities.
* Leads with confidence. You know how to build trust, set expectations, develop people, and hold teams accountable.
* Is operationally disciplined. You believe in KPIs, standardization, preventative maintenance, continuous improvement, and measurable results.
* Is entrepreneurial. You are energized by growth, change, new opportunities, and the ability to make a meaningful impact.
* Is a problem solver. You are comfortable navigating complex operational challenges and making decisions in a fast-paced environment.
* Is collaborative. You understand that regional success contributes to company-wide success.

**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS**

* 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in industrial wastewater treatment, environmental services, industrial services, utilities, or related operational environments.
* Demonstrated expertise in industrial wastewater treatment operations, including treatment processes, troubleshooting, environmental compliance, and emerging technologies.
* Proven experience leading multi-site or regional operations with direct leadership responsibility for multiple levels of management.
* Previous full P&L ownership with demonstrated success improving profitability and financial performance.
* A track record of growing revenue, expanding customer relationships, and developing new business opportunities.
* Experience building and implementing operational standards, KPIs, SOPs, audit programs, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Strong financial and commercial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, cost management, and accountability.
* Experience with Lean, TPM, 5S, or other continuous improvement methodologies.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, customer relationship, and change management skills.
* Ability and willingness to travel 50% or more throughout the Eastern US Region.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, Business, Operations, or a related discipline.
* State-issued wastewater operator license (Class A, B, C, or D, as applicable).
* Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement certifications.
* Experience with mergers, acquisitions, and business integration.

**WHY SOLUTION GROUP?**

At Solution Group, you won't simply inherit a job description and maintain the status quo. You will have the opportunity to influence the direction of a growing business, develop exceptional teams, strengthen customer partnerships, and make a measurable impact on our future.

We offer:

* **Executive-Level Compensation:** $140,000–$200,000 base salary, plus eligibility for an annual performance bonus.
* **Meaningful Leadership:** Full regional ownership and the opportunity to directly influence business performance and strategy.
* **Entrepreneurial Opportunity:** The ability to identify opportunities, drive growth, and help shape the future of the organization.
* **Strong Team Environment:** Work alongside experienced wastewater professionals and collaborative corporate leadership.
* **Competitive Benefits:** Health, dental, vision, 401k, Paid Time Off.
* **Professional Development:** Continued technical training and opportunities for career advancement.
* **Travel Reimbursement:** Mileage reimbursement for business travel.

**THE BOTTOM LINE**

**We are looking for a wastewater expert who is ready to lead a business, not just manage operations.**

If you have the technical depth to understand complex wastewater challenges, the business acumen to drive profitable growth, and the leadership ability to build exceptional teams, we want to hear from you.

**Come build something great with Solution Group.**

protected_roles.description:
**Overview**
Resonetics is a global leader in advanced engineering, prototyping, product development, and micro manufacturing, driving innovation in the medical device industry. With rapid expansion across all our locations, we continue to push the boundaries of technology while fostering a dynamic, employee-centered culture. Our commitment to excellence and continuous improvement makes Resonetics an exciting place for professionals passionate about shaping the future of micro-manufacturing and being part of something bigger
  
  
The Quality Director plays a pivotal role in leading and strengthening operational quality and quality compliance within a large-scale contract manufacturing facility. Responsible for both Product Quality and Quality Management System (QMS) compliance, this leader ensures quality operations within the manufacturing environment consistently meet customer, regulatory, and business expectations.
  
  
This individual combines strategic vision with hands-on operational quality leadership, ensuring Resonetics delivers world-class quality in a fast-paced, highly regulated medical device manufacturing environment. The role demands proven experience within manufacturing operations, deep expertise in ISO 13485 and 21 CFR Part 820, mastery of advanced quality assurance techniques, and the ability to align and elevate quality performance across multiple value streams.
  
  
Join Resonetics and be part of a team that’s redefining medical device manufacturing. If you’re passionate about innovation and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Operational Quality Leadership**

* Own and lead all aspects of manufacturing quality performance, ensuring operational processes deliver consistent, compliant, and high-yield outcomes.
* Partner closely with Operations leadership to embed quality into daily production activities and drive problem-solving directly on the manufacturing floor.
* Implement and oversee statistical process control (SPC), process capability, and other data-driven tools to ensure process stability and continuous improvement.
* Monitor and manage critical quality metrics, taking immediate action to address gaps and prevent recurrence of issues.
* Oversee validation strategies (IQ/OQ/PQ) for manufacturing processes and equipment, ensuring robustness and compliance.
* Provide quality leadership in New Product Introduction (NPI), ensuring robust process validation, risk management, and seamless transition from development into full-scale manufacturing.

**Quality Systems & Compliance**

* Ensure the ISO-certified QMS is operationally effective within manufacturing sites and continuously improved to support business growth.
* Maintain full compliance with ISO 13485, 21 CFR Part 820, and other relevant standards through proactive system management and audit readiness.

**Continuous Improvement & Problem Solving**

* Lead root cause investigations and corrective actions for complex production challenges.
* Drive Lean and Six Sigma initiatives that enhance manufacturing efficiency while strengthening compliance and product quality.
* Share best practices across sites to ensure standardization and scalability of quality improvements.

**Customer & Supplier Interface**

* Serve as the primary quality leader for high-visibility customers, ensuring confidence in Resonetics’ ability to deliver consistently high-quality products.
* Lead the supplier quality program, ensuring raw materials and outsourced processes meet stringent requirements to support operational excellence.

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Build and mentor a strong quality team embedded within the manufacturing organization.
* Provide training in advanced quality tools (Gage R&R, SPC, pFMEA, Risk Analysis, Validation, Root Cause Analysis, CAPA) to elevate operational capability.
* Foster a culture of quality culture and ownership on the production floor, engaging all levels of the workforce.

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum 7 years’ experience in a Medical Device Quality Management role.
* Lean and/or Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt
* Demonstrated background in an ISO 13485 and 21 CFR 820 quality management system.
* Strong communication skills (verbal and writing)
* BS degree in a management or engineering discipline
* Experience hosting FDA inspections and ISO audits

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience in a technical, regulated environment.
* Experience with finished medical device assembly and oversight of sterilization
* Experience with Quality Management Software (eQMS) and ERP systems
* Certified Quality Auditor

**Physical Demands**

* Light office work, approximately 25%+ travel

**Compensation**
The compensation for this role is competitive and will be based on experience and qualifications. The anticipated range is $144,000.00 - $222,000.00.
  
  
For temp, temp-to-hire, and regular full-time positions, our company policy is that we are unable to provide visa sponsorship. Candidates must already be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for sponsorship now or in the future.

**Obsessed by Science. Entrepreneurial by Nature. United by Purpose.**
Diasorin is a global leader in immunodiagnostic and molecular diagnostic solutions, advancing science to improve patient outcomes worldwide. For more than 50 years, we have combined scientific rigor with an entrepreneurial mindset, operating with a strong commitment to innovation, accountability, and results to deliver trusted diagnostic solutions.
  
  
As the Diagnostics Specialist, Diasorin continuously invests in research, technology, and people. Guided by our values of operational excellence, customer focus, and teamwork, we empower teams to think boldly, act decisively, and transform ideas into meaningful impact across one of the industry’s broadest specialty diagnostic portfolios.
  
  
When you join Diasorin, you are not just filling a role. You are helping build what comes next.
  
  
**Why Join Diasorin**

* Build What Matters Take ownership, challenge the status quo, and contribute directly to solutions that improve patient care worldwide.
* Innovate with Agility at a Global Scale Work in an entrepreneurial environment that enables speed, collaboration, and global impact.
* Grow in a People-Centered Culture Thrive in a culture that values accountability, inclusion, and continuous development.

**Job Scope:**
The Director, Quality Assurance for Austin will lead, establish, implement and maintain quality assurance systems and activities ensuring compliance with domestic and international quality system standards and regulations for commercial medical devices designed, produced and marketed by Luminex. Partner with Manufacturing, Design/Development, Systems Engineering, Quality Control and others across functions to deliver the highest quality instruments, and reagents. This position is responsible for the oversight, control and release of instruments and reagents, quality organizational management, budget preparation, personnel management, organizational goals and metrics, and Executive Level presentations. The Director, Quality Assurance for Austin is a leader and a mentor.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities And Duties**

* Ensures that the Austin site demonstrates regulatory compliance per GLP/GCP/cGMP/GXP, ISO, and other applicable regulations.
* Support instrument new product development and manufacturing changes, provides guidance to the core teams and participate in the process.
* Leader in process optimization by Identifying and analyzing opportunities for continual improvements in product/service quality, customer satisfaction, and company profitability.
* Leads the strategy and improvements for the manufacturing and service depot of Instruments for our customers and partners in compliance with regulations and standards.
* Participates and manage activities for external audits such as ISO, FDA or other regulatory bodies for the Austin site. Acts in Audits - as co-host, SME or escort
* Responds to alleged QMS violations of regulations, policies, procedures as the result of both external and external audits by evaluating and recommending the initiation of investigative activities, immediate corrections and risk analysis processes. Coordinates responses to external audits and manages corrective actions to close.
* Interacts with various internal and external groups to facilitate the completion of internal audits, handling of non-conformances, performing Risk Assessments, CAPA, investigation and support, manufacturing validation as well as Design Transfer.
* QMS improvements and enhancements and is a leading member of the Quality Management Team. Works across the corporation to align and define quality approach for molecular diagnostic products.
* Partners with Site Leadership and Field Quality to conduct, manage, and evaluate investigations related to customer complaints, nonconformances, audits, corrective/preventive action concerns, deviations, recalls, and potential injuries
* Appropriately escalate Quality issues to the Vice President Quality Assurance Molecular Division
* Provide leadership in the application of Quality Tools such as Risk Management, Root Cause Investigations, Designs of Experiments, Capability Studies, in the establishment and investigation of process and products failures and implement lasting solutions of such failures.
* May act as IVDR Person Responsible for Regulatory Compliance (PRRC) for Luminex sites to ensure: the conformity of the devices is appropriately checked before a device is released, the post-market surveillance and reporting obligations are fulfilled and all requirements established between Luminex and Authorized representative are met.
* May act as Management Representative for the site. In this capacity, ensure that product meets label claims and customer satisfaction, any quality or regulatory issue is elevated to the President and/or Vice President Quality Assurance Compliance North America and oversee and drive continuous improvement.
* Develops and releases Change Plans and actions to support the changing needs and requirements of the organization as the result of strategic changes in business direction
* Provide other Quality related technical training as necessary
* Directs activities of employees or through managers who exercise full supervision for daily operations. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws.
* Maintains talent through recruiting and development opportunities. Continually develops internal candidates through succession planning and career development.
* Responsible for enforcing all EHS policies in their span of control
* Be part of any the new key and strategic projects and due diligence process if required
* Ensure all site-level activities and related documentation are aligned with corporate procedures and conducted in accordance with DiaSorin’s established Corporate and Quality Assurance governance requirements.

**Education, Experience And Qualifications**

* Minimum Bachelor degree in a science or engineering discipline with 8+ years of relevant experience/training
* 10+ Years of Experience in Quality Assurance or Regulatory Affairs activities in a cGMP Medical Device or Pharmaceutical environment
* 5+ years of Demonstrated knowledge of current industry quality practices under ISO 13485, ISO 14971, CFR 820 and CFR 806 and international regulations preferred
* 2+ years of Management experience in a complex quality assurance/quality systems field
* 2+ years of Ability to provide leadership to others in the organization through influence, innovative practices and coaching skills to foster a corporate culture of responsiveness, compliance awareness, self-regulation, quality system ownership, challenge of status quo, and continuous improvement in order to achieve the highest level of compliance.
* 5+ years of Excellent problem solving methodology, using industry accepted concepts and tools to solve complex problems in creative and effective ways as they apply to compliance issues.
* 5+ years of Hands-on ability to sort through technical complexities and work in a flexible changing environment.
* 5+ years of Possesses a strong scientific and technical background, sufficient to establish creditability with senior management as well as the manufacturing and product development teams.
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills
* Thorough knowledge of standards and regulations (cGMP, ISO 13485)
* Highly organized with proven time management and prioritization skills
* Ability to work independently and with minimal supervision
* High degree of problem solving, attention to detail, and analytical skills.
* Experience working independently in a fast-paced environment with rapidly changing priorities
* Ability to handle the pressure of meeting tight deadlines

**What We Offer**
Diasorin offers a competitive rewards package focused on your overall well-being. We are proud to offer a comprehensive plan of health benefits, retirement and financial wellbeing, time off programs, wellbeing support and perks. Benefits may vary by role, country, region, union status, and other employment status factors. You may also be eligible to participate in an annual incentive program. An incentive award, if any, depends on various factors, including, individual and organizational performance.
  
  
Diasorin is committed to building a workplace where people feel empowered to contribute ideas, take ownership, and grow their careers. We believe diverse perspectives strengthen innovation and help us deliver meaningful impact for patients and customers worldwide.
  
  
Diasorin is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
  
  
This posting and recruitment process are subject to applicable local laws and regulations in the country where the position is located. Additional employment disclosures, candidate rights, and employment conditions may apply based on local jurisdiction.
  
  
Individuals hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work and may be subject to a background check and drug screening where permitted by law. Diasorin is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities during the application process. If assistance is required, please contact hr@diasorin.com.
  
  
Recruitment Fraud Notice
  
  
Diasorin never requests payment, financial information, or personal banking details from candidates at any stage of the recruitment process. Official communications from Diasorin recruiters will only come from a verified
**@diasorin.com**
email address. If you have questions about the legitimacy of a recruitment communication, please contact hr@diasorin.com for verification.

protected_roles.description:
As the
**Director of Quality**
, you will lead the quality strategy and continuous improvement efforts across all Bison manufacturing sites. You will be responsible for ensuring that the products meet or exceed customer expectations, industry standards, and regulatory requirements while driving overall quality performance and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to establish and maintain effective quality systems, drive process improvements, and ensure compliance with industry certifications.
  
  
This position can be based at either our
**Whitsett, NC**
or
**Reynosa, MX**
facility.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
  
  

* Leadership & Strategy

+ Develop and execute a strategic quality plan in alignment with business unit goals.
+ Lead, mentor, and develop a team of quality professionals across two locations, ensuring consistency in processes and objectives.
+ Champion a culture of quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.

* Quality Management Systems (QMS)

+ Oversee the implementation, maintenance, and improvement of the QAD Elements QMS and other relevant Quality Management Systems at both locations. Ensure compliance with customer, regulatory, and industry-specific quality standards (e.g., FDA, ISO, AS9100, etc.).
+ Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of quality management systems and propose enhancements to improve overall performance.

* Process & Product Quality

+ Collaborate with sales, operations, engineering, and supply chain teams to identify drive resolution of quality issues, ensuring process and product integrity.
+ Support root cause analysis and drive corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) for internal and external quality issues.
+ Oversee first article inspections, process capability studies, and validation/qualification activities to ensure robust manufacturing processes.

* Continuous Improvement

+ Lead Lean Six Sigma or other continuous improvement initiatives aimed at reducing defects, enhancing efficiency, and improving overall quality.
+ Implement data-driven decision-making tools (e.g., SPC, FMEA, Control Plans) to monitor and improve process capabilities.
+ Facilitate cross-functional value stream mapping sessions and quality workshops to drive process improvements.

* Customer & Supplier Relations

+ Serve as the main point of contact for customer quality issues, audits, and feedback, ensuring timely and effective resolution.
+ Oversee supplier quality management, including audits, performance monitoring, and supplier development initiatives.

* Metrics & Reporting

+ Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) related to quality performance, including scrap/rework, defect rates, customer complaints, and audit findings.
+ Regularly report quality performance metrics to senior leadership, highlighting trends and recommending corrective actions.

* Regulatory Compliance & Audits

+ Lead internal and external audits, ensuring the sites comply with relevant standards and certifications.
+ Ensure the manufacturing facilities are audit-ready at all times and coordinate responses to audit findings.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality Management, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in quality management within a manufacturing environment, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.
* Demonstrated experience with quality management systems (ISO 9001, AS9100, FDA, or equivalent) and continuous improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma).
* Demonstrated ability and willingness to use AI tools to improve productivity, decision-making, work quality, and to reduce costs. The successful candidate must be able to identify appropriate AI use cases and critically evaluate AI-generated outputs.
* Proven track record of driving quality improvements across multi-site operations.
* Ability to travel as needed to the BU manufacturing sites (up to 30%)
* Strong leadership and team-building skills.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to communicate effectively with all levels of the organization.
* Proficiency in quality tools such as SPC, FMEA, 8D, and Root Cause Analysis.

**Compensation**
Employee Type: Salaried
  
  
Currency: USD
  
  
Salary Minimum: 135,000
  
  
Salary Maximum: 185,000
  
  
Incentive: Yes
  
  
Disclaimer: Where a specific pay range is noted, it is a good faith estimate at the time of this posting. The actual salary offered will be based on experience, skills, qualifications, market / business considerations, and geographic location.
  
  
For more information on AMETEK's competitive benefits, please click here.

****Job Description:****
**Are you ready to steer quality operations for a global leader in vertical flight?**
Airbus Helicopters is seeking a visionary, results-oriented
**Site Quality Director**
to lead our site-level Quality Management System (QMS) and daily operational integrity. Reporting directly to the VP of Quality, you will serve as the operational anchor for aviation safety, manufacturing excellence, and regulatory compliance across FAA, EASA, TCCA, and AS9100 standards.
  
  
In this high-visibility leadership role, you will direct a team of quality professionals across logistics, assembly, component repair, and final conformity. We are looking for a strategic change-maker who can embed a "First Time Right" mindset, harmonize site practices with global Airbus standards, and bridge the gap between engineering, regulatory bodies, and frontline operations.
  
  
**Your working environment:**
On the eastern border of Mississippi you’ll find Columbus, home to our Helicopter manufacturing and assembly lines and Center of Excellence for the entire North America region. It’s here that we produce the UH-72A Lakota Helicopters for the U.S. Army in addition to the H-125 aircraft for civil and commercial customers.
  
  
**How we care for you:**

* Financial Rewards: Competitive base salary, incentive compensation which may include profit sharing schemes, retirement savings plan and the ability to participate in an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (“ESOP”)
* Work/Life Balance: Paid time off including personal time, holidays and a generous paid parental leave program.
* Health & Welfare: Comprehensive insurance coverage including medical (traditional and high-deductible health plans), prescription, dental, vision, life, disability, Employee Assistance Plan (“EAP”) and other supplemental benefit coverages.
* Individual Development: Upskilling and development opportunities through our global Leadership University, including unlimited access to 10,000+ e-learning courses focusing on ways to develop your employability, certifications, career path as well as the opportunity to participate in accelerated development programmes and both national and international mobility.

**Your Challenges:**

* Sustain Regulatory & Quality Certifications: Maintain, uphold, and expand site compliance for FAA, EASA, and TCCA repair station and production certificates, certified personnel, and AS9100 QMS credentials.
* Drive Executive QMS Governance: Administer the site Quality Management System, collaborating directly with the Executive Committee to embed strategic quality objectives into the business planning cycle.
* Standardize Operational Inspections: Supervise and enforce rigorous inspection standards across supply chain, logistics, receiving, in-process assembly, quality gates, and final aircraft conformity for components, aerostructures, and rotorcraft.
* Mitigate Quality Escapes & Risk: Identify and eliminate operational and airworthiness risks to safeguard customer flight safety, business continuity, delivery schedules, and operating costs.
* Lead and Develop Personnel: Directly manage, mentor, and evaluate a team of 3-5 exempt supervisors/engineers and 10-25 non-exempt inspectors, directing career progression, staffing, and technical competence.
* Establish & Track SQCDP KPIs: Implement robust enterprise metrics tracking Safety, Quality, Cost, Delivery, and People (SQCDP) to systematically capture non-conformances, process capability, and customer complaints.
* Manage Financials & Quality Budget: Direct departmental budgeting, manage financial forecasts, analyze cost variances, and allocate capital for advanced measurement tools, calibration, and ergonomic work environments.
* Execute Root Cause & Corrective Action (RCCA): Drive practical problem solving (PPS), Plan-Do-Check-Act (PDCA), and structured RCCA workflows to resolve manufacturing anomalies and prevent recurrence.
* Harmonize Global Airbus Standards: Coordinate with international Airbus Helicopters facilities to standardize quality procedures, digital architectures, and enterprise systems (including SAP, MES, and non-conformance portals).
* Champion Safety and "First Time Right" Culture: Spearhead a proactive, psychological safety culture anchored by "First Time Right" execution and a robust "Speak Up / Listen Up" mindset across all shifts and departments.
* Direct Internal & External Audits: Lead preparation, execution, and reporting for internal, regulatory (FAA/EASA/TCCA), and customer audits, ensuring all corrective action milestones are closed transparently.
* Collaborate on Design & New Product Introduction (NPI): Partner with design engineering and certification teams to support new product development, configuration integrity, obsolescence management, and manufacturing build cycles.
* Reduce Cost of Non-Quality (CoNQ): Lead enterprise continuous improvement, Lean, and Kaizen initiatives to eliminate scrap, minimize rework, reduce the Cost of Non-Quality, and improve delivery reliability.
* Optimize Workload & Production Flow: Coordinate with operations and program management to balance inspection staffing and shift priorities against critical flightline and customer delivery schedules.
* Oversee Technical Training & Qualifications: Build and finance comprehensive onboarding and recurrent training programs covering aviation safety, specialized processes (NDI, composites, dynamic components), and regulatory requirements.

**Your Boarding Pass:**

* Must possess a Bachelor’s Degree in Aerospace/Aviation/Industrial Engineer/Engineering related field or equivalent experience (4 years)
* Have ten (10) + years of Aerospace/Aviation Industry, Military or Quality experience and three (3) + years in a Leadership role, Civilian and/or Military
* Able to support functions in multiple areas such as repair station, manufacturing, composites, electrical/avionics Backshop, warehousing/logistics, dynamic component repair, blades and tail boom
* Knowledge of Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) Regulations 14 CFR Parts 21, 43 and 145 in addition the related sections for Transport Canada and EASA
* Knowledge of AS9100 Quality Requirements and Systems
* Knowledge of aircraft design, maintenance, and manufacturing processes and build cycles
* Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word and Access), Onbase, Orion eTechPub, Adobe Acrobat , SAP, Smartsheet, G Suite. OCE/ARAS/Bflow T.I.P.I.

**Preferred Education/Skills:**

* Master’s Degree as described above
* 12 years of Aerospace/Aviation Industry, Military or Quality experience and 3 years in a Leadership role Civilian and/or Military
* A&P License
* ASQ or CMQ certified

**Travel Required:**

* 15% Domestic and International

**Citizenship:**

* Must be a US Person under ITAR definition (U.S. Citizen, green card holder or person covered under our existing ITAR license)

**Physical Requirements:**

* Onsite or remote: 100% in Columbus, MS unless traveling
* Vision: able to see and read computer screens and other electronic equipment with screens, able to read documents, reports and engineering drawings daily. Must have correctable near and far vision if applicable.
* Hearing: able to hear to participate in conversations in person and via teleconference or phone and to hear sounds on the production floor including safety warnings or alarms. Daily
* Speaking: able to speak in conversations and meetings, deliver information and participate in communications. Daily
* Equipment Operation (personal computer, telephone, copies, fax machine, and related office equipment and using electronic identification card to enter building floors and internal doors): able to operate most office and personal electronic equipment and some tools including production tools .
* Carrying: able to carry documents, tools, drawings, electronic equipment up to 30lbs/14kgs. Daily
* Lifting: able to lift documents, tools, drawings, electronic equipment up to 30lbs/14kgs. Daily
* Pushing / Pulling: able to push and pull small office furniture and some equipment and tools. Daily
* Sitting: able to sit for long periods of time in meetings, working on the computer. Several times a week
* Squatting / Kneeling: able to squat or kneel to retrieve or replace items stored on low shelving. Daily
* Standing: able to stand for discussions in offices or on the production floor. Daily
* Travel: able to travel independently and at short notice. 15% or less yearly
* Walking (include routine walking such as to a shared printer to retrieve documents): able to walk through office and production areas including uneven surfaces. Daily
* Personal Protective Equipment required: Required PPE includes, but is not limited to, Safety Shoes, Safety Glasses, Hearing Protection, Respirators/Masks, and/or Protective Gloves as required by site and/or customer site
* Administrative position only PPE required: Steel-toed shoes are required for all shop floor visits, appropriate hearing/eye protection may also be required when visiting the shop floor.

protected_roles.description:
At CompoSecure, we are redefining the future of payment card technology. As a global leader in premium metal payment cards and fintech solutions, we combine innovation with craftsmanship to deliver exceptional products for the world's leading financial institutions.
  
  
We're looking for talented individuals who share our passion for excellence and innovation.
  
  
**Position Overview**
This role provides senior leadership and ownership of the functions that safeguard product integrity and the operating environment: Quality, Compliance (Quality Control, Quality Assurance, Safety and regulatory conformance), Security, and Facilities. The position is accountable for ensuring that products consistently meet quality specifications, that operations remain fully compliant with regulatory and safety standards, that the site and its products are secure, and that facilities are maintained to support a reliable 24/7 manufacturing environment. The role establishes clear metrics and ownership across these areas and reports performance to senior leadership.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Quality: Establish and maintain quality control protocols for raw materials, components, and finished products. Design inspection and testing processes and provide guidance on maintaining consistent quality from the beginning of production through final release. Lead Quality Assurance and Quality Control teams, monitor quality metrics, and drive corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to eliminate root causes of defects. Ensure conformance to customer, product, and industry specifications.
* Compliance: Ensure full compliance of operations with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and applicable safety standards in accordance with New Jersey law. Own audits, certifications, and documentation, and serve as the primary liaison with regulatory bodies, auditors, and customers on compliance matters. Identify potential risks and pitfalls (e.g., equipment failures or other disruptions) and develop strategies to mitigate these issues through process improvement, alternative suppliers of materials, or altered equipment.
* Security: Oversee physical and product security programs consistent with the company's trust and authentication mission. Establish and enforce protocols to protect raw materials, work-in-process, finished goods, and sensitive assets throughout the facility and supply chain. Ensure operations meet payment-industry and customer security requirements, and manage security personnel and access controls across all shifts.
* Accountability: Own the key performance indicators and reporting for quality, compliance, security, and facilities. Establish clear ownership, metrics, and dashboards, report performance to senior management, and foster a culture of accountability across the organization. Manage a team of approximately 35 people across 7 shifts supporting QA, Safety & Security.
* Facilities: Oversee facility operations, maintenance, and environmental health and safety of the buildings, grounds, and utilities. Ensure facilities are maintained to support a reliable 24/7 manufacturing environment, manage facility vendors and contractors, and lead facility-related capital projects, space planning, and safe-workplace initiatives.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Quality, Operations Management, or a related field.
* A minimum of 10–15 years (or more) of relevant experience in quality, compliance, and/or operations leadership in a high-volume manufacturing environment (Pharmaceutical, Semiconductor, Automotive, or secure/payment products) , with at least 5-10 years experience in managing teams across multiple shift in a 24/7 environment :
* Deep knowledge of quality management systems (ISO 9001, IATF 16949 for automotive, AS9100 for aerospace, etc.)
* Six Sigma / Lean methodologies (typically Black Belt or Master Black Belt level)
* Root cause analysis and CAPA (corrective and preventive action) processes
* Statistical process control (SPC) and data-driven decision making
* Supplier quality management and audit experience
* Very strong analytical skill set, including familiarity with quality and reliability tools (e.g., FMEA, SPC, Kaizen).
* Regulatory fluency:
* OSHA, EPA, ISO 14001 (environmental), ISO 45001 (occupational health & safety)
* Industrial hygiene and risk assessment methodologies
* Environmental compliance (emissions, waste management, hazmat handling)
* Process safety management
* Incident investigation and workers' compensation/claims oversight
* Demonstrated experience working with cross-functional teams required.
* Demonstrated experience in third party audits ( ISO , PCI, ....)
* Occasional travel to suppliers and partners.

**Preferred Skills And Qualifications**

* Quality certifications such as Black belt Six Sigma
* GHG Management
* Familiarity with ERP tools
* Experience in a secure payment, or otherwise highly regulated manufacturing environment.

**About CompoSecure**
CompoSecure, a GPGI business (NYSE: GPGI), is the leading manufacturer of Premium Metal Payment Cards and also offers best-in-class Authentication and Digital Asset solutions. The Company's offerings combine elegance, simplicity, and security to deliver exceptional experiences and peace of mind, enabling trust for millions of people around the globe. For more information, please visit
**www.CompoSecure.com**
and
**www.GetArculus.com**
.
  
  
We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and work-life balance, including medical, prescription, dental, and vision coverage; FSA/HSA options; company-paid life and disability insurance; 401(k) with company match; paid time off (PTO) and holidays; annual bonus opportunities; an employee assistance program (EAP); and opportunities for career growth and advancement.
  
  
*Additional details will be provided during the hiring process.*
CompoSecure is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, or national origin. We are also an equal opportunity employer of individuals with disabilities and protected veterans.

protected_roles.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY:**

  

The Global Head of Quality provides strategic leadership and oversight of ProSciento's global Quality department, establishing the strategy, direction, governance, and priorities for the function. This role will oversee the Quality Management System (QMS) and ensures the organization maintains the highest standards of quality, regulatory compliance, and inspection readiness.

  

This role is accountable for establishing and advancing the company's quality strategy, Quality by Design and governance framework, and quality culture while ensuring compliance with applicable GxP regulations, FDA requirements, ISO standards, and other country specific, regional, and international regulatory requirements. The Global Head of Quality partners closely with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to drive continuous improvement, operational excellence, risk management, and organizational effectiveness while supporting ProSciento's strategic growth. Performs duties in accordance with ProSciento's values, policies, and procedures. Approximately 20% domestic and international travel is expected, with additional travel required based on business needs.

  

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

  

  
* Provides strategic leadership for ProSciento’s Quality department, establishing the vision, priorities, and organizational structure to support the company’s operations and business objectives.
  
* Accountable for the design, implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring compliance with all applicable regulations including GCP, GLP, GMP (GxP), FDA, ISO, data privacy requirements, and other local, national, and international requirements.
  
* Responsible to oversee the quality of Global CRO studies and local site CRU trials as well as hands on experience implementing and maintaining a strategic Quality by Design framework for both business units.
  
* Responsible for the definition, development, implementation, monitoring and continuous improvement of quality systems, processes, and Key Quality indicators (KQIs) to drive operational excellence and regulatory compliance.
  

  

  
* Oversees the Quality Event Management program, including deviations, CAPAs, change control, investigations, risk assessments, and process improvement initiatives. Chairs or delegates the CAPA Board and ensures timely resolution of quality issues.
  
* Directs internal, external, sponsor, vendor, and regulatory inspection readiness activities, including audit planning, execution, response management, and corrective action oversight.
  
* Partners with Vendor Management to oversee supplier qualification, vendor audits, performance monitoring, and quality risk mitigation.
  
* Leads Executive Quality Management Reviews, ensuring quality trends, compliance risks, audit outcomes, CAPAs, and quality metrics are routinely communicated to Executive Leadership with appropriate recommendations and mitigation strategies.
  
* Oversee the development, maintenance, and governance of Quality Management System documentation, including quality policies, SOPs, work instructions, controlled documents, training programs, equipment records, and electronic document management systems.
  
* Partners with Information Technology and business leaders to ensure computerized systems, electronic records, and applicable equipment are appropriately qualified, verified, or validated in accordance with regulatory requirements and industry best practices.
  
* Establishes and promotes a culture of quality throughout the organization by providing strategic guidance, regulatory interpretation, and quality leadership across all functional departments.
  
* Maintains current knowledge of evolving global regulatory requirements, industry standards, and best practices, ensuring organizational policies and procedures remain compliant and effective.
  
* Builds, develops, and leads a high-performing Quality organization by fostering employee development, succession planning, collaboration, accountability, and a culture aligned with ProSciento's core values.
  
* Serves as the senior quality representative for regulatory agencies, sponsors, auditors, and executive leadership on matters relating to quality systems, compliance, and inspection readiness.
  

  

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**

  

  
* Provides leadership and oversight for the Quality organization, including workforce planning, organizational design, recruitment, employee development, performance management, succession planning, coaching, and employee engagement.
  
* Establishes departmental objectives, allocates resources, and ensures the Quality organization effectively supports ProSciento's strategic and operational priorities.
  

  

**QUALIFICATIONS & EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS:**

  

**Qualifications:**

  

To perform this job successfully an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  

  
* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences or a related field required; advanced degree preferred.
  
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Systems, or Regulatory Compliance within the CRO or clinical research industry, including at least 5 years in senior quality leadership roles with responsibility for organizational quality strategy and personnel management with a minimum of 3 years of Global experience.
  
* Equivalent combinations of education, training, and relevant experience will be considered.
  

  

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND COMPETENCIES REQUIREMENTS:**

  

**Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities:**

  

  
* Extensive knowledge of Quality Management Systems and quality governance, with demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and continuously improving quality systems within clinical research and regulated environments.
  
* Comprehensive knowledge of applicable global regulatory requirements and industry standards, including FDA regulations, ICH Guidelines, GCP, GLP, GMP (GxP), ISO 9001, data integrity, and applicable privacy requirements. Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and continuously improving Quality Management Systems (QMS) supporting GCP, GLP, GMP (GxP) environments and clinical research operations.
  
* Demonstrated experience leading regulatory inspections, sponsor and internal audits, supplier qualification programs, CAPA governance, inspection readiness, and enterprise quality risk management.
  
* Demonstrated ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing quality organizations, while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  
* Proven strategic leadership, organizational planning, and change management skills, with the ability to partner with executive leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to establish quality strategies and organizational priorities.
  
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and risk assessment capabilities.
  
* Strong communication and executive presentation skills with the ability to influence stakeholders across all organizational levels.
  
* Experience leading regulatory inspections, sponsor interactions, and quality governance forums.
  
* Ability to balance strategic leadership with operational execution in a dynamic, fast-paced organization.
  
* Proficiency with electronic Quality Management Systems (eQMS), document management systems, quality metrics, and computerized system validation principles.
  

  

**Language Skills:**

  

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to interpret complex regulations, prepare executive reports, develop policies and procedures, and effectively communicate with regulatory agencies, sponsors, auditors, executive leadership, and employees.

  

**Reasoning Skills:**

  

Ability to analyze complex regulatory and operational issues, exercise sound judgment, assess organizational risk, and develop practical, compliant solutions in a dynamic business environment.

  

**Computer Skills:**

  

Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and experience with electronic Quality Management Systems (eQMS), document management systems, learning management systems, audit management tools, and computerized system validation principles. Ability to quickly learn new software applications.

  

**CONDITIONS OF EMPLOYMENT**

  

Verification of educational requirements, employment history, professional references, and certifications/training and U.S. work authorization.

  

**WORKING CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL EFFORT**

  

  
* Work is primarily performed in a professional office environment and may be conducted onsite, remotely, or in a hybrid work arrangement based on business needs and management approval.
  
* Occasional domestic and international travel may be required to support audits, regulatory inspections, client meetings, and business operations.
  

  

The above job description does not imply these outlined duties are the only duties performed by this employee. The incumbent is expected to perform other related duties necessary for the effective operation of the department and company.

  

ProSciento reserves the right to change or alter any of the above duties and responsibilities according to the operational needs of the department and company.

  

ProSciento is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

**Job Summary**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
The Director of Manufacturing Operations provides hands-on operational leadership for the Delaware manufacturing site. The role is accountable for safe, reliable, and cost-effective execution of the production plan; disciplined planning and scheduling; WIP flow; productivity and yield improvement; operational quality; maintenance and facilities coordination; and development of a high-performing Operations organization. The Director works across the business to translate customer and strategic requirements into executable operating plans and measurable results.
  
  
The Director is expected to build strong working relationships with Engineering, Quality, EHS, Purchasing, Finance, Supply Chain, Human Resources, Sales, and Product Management and lead through influence where responsibilities cross functional boundaries.
  
  
**Primary Duties & Responsibilities**
Operational Leadership
  
  

* Lead daily manufacturing execution across the Delaware site, maintaining a visible and hands-on presence with employees and leaders at all levels.
* Direct and develop the Production Manager, Planner/Scheduler, Maintenance Manager, and Special Projects Manager. The Production Manager leads three Shift Supervisors.
* Set clear operating expectations, establish performance routines, remove barriers, and hold leaders accountable for results and behaviors.
* Maintain focus on the highest-value priorities while resisting a crisis-driven operating model.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Quality, EHS, Purchasing, Finance, Supply Chain, Human Resources, Sales, and Product Management to resolve issues and execute site priorities.

Planning Scheduling and Flow
  
  

* Establish and maintain a reliable planning and scheduling process aligned with customer commitments, available capacity, material availability, staffing, and equipment constraints.
* Improve visibility and control of WIP, production flow, supermarkets, constraints, and recovery plans through the Planner/Scheduler and operating reviews.
* Use data to identify bottlenecks, improve throughput, reduce lead time, and support fact-based decisions on priorities and resources.
* Partner with Purchasing and Supply Chain to ensure material availability supports the production plan without creating unnecessary inventory or disruption.

Quality Safety and Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Own operational quality performance by building quality into processes, reinforcing standards, and ensuring timely containment and effective corrective action.
* Partner with Quality to maintain applicable certifications and management systems, prepare for audits, and strengthen process discipline and change control.
* Lead a culture in which employees identify problems, escalate concerns early, follow standard work, and take ownership of the process and outcome.
* Lead Lean and continuous-improvement activity that produces measurable gains in productivity, yield, quality, cost, delivery, and flow.
* Partner with EHS to establish safe work practices, address hazards, reinforce accountability, and achieve strong site safety performance.

People Labor and Culture
  
  

* Build a high-performing Operations team through selection, onboarding, coaching, development, recognition, and fair, consistent performance management.
* Develop and coach supervisors and other leaders to manage through facts, engage employees, and sustain improvements across shifts.
* Maintain a constructive day-to-day relationship with the Teamsters workforce and support Human Resources in contract administration, grievances, and future negotiations.
* Promote the company values of Integrity, Collaboration, Accountability, Respect, and Enthusiasm through personal example and consistent leadership.

Financial Capital and Customer Support
  
  

* Manage Operations performance and cost control within the budget established by the GM, using data to identify savings opportunities and improve labor, material, equipment, and operating effectiveness.
* Develop the initial site capital plan and business cases for automation and other investments. Drive approved projects to completion on schedule and within budget.
* Support Sales as the primary operational partner for customer escalations, visits, delivery discussions, and technical or manufacturing topics. Sales remains the primary customer interface.
* Provide concise, timely, and fact-based operating updates to the Sr. Director of Global Operations and leadership team.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering required; Mechanical or Chemical Engineering preferred.
* At least 10 years of progressively responsible experience in manufacturing or operations leadership.
* Required: demonstrated Lean leadership and continuous-improvement results in productivity, yield, quality, cost, delivery, or flow.
* Required: experience establishing or improving production planning, scheduling, WIP control, and shop-floor flow.
* Preferred: experience managing a unionized workforce.
* Preferred: experience in advanced materials, ceramics, semiconductor components, precision fabrication, or other complex industrial manufacturing.
* Preferred: experience implementing or significantly improving an ERP or manufacturing execution system.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through others, develop teams, resolve problems, and sustain accountability in a changing environment.

**Skills**

* Hands-on, visible, and self-motivated leadership style with a strong sense of urgency and ownership.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and fact-based decision-making skills.
* Ability to establish priorities, execute with discipline, and convert strategy into practical operating routines.
* Ability to influence across functions and the organization and work effectively with technical, commercial, and corporate partners.
* Strong written, verbal, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
* Ability to work effectively with employees and leaders across shifts and levels of the organization.
* Due to ITAR compliance, this position requires candidates to be a U.S. Citizen, Permanent Resident Alien, or Protected Individual per 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

**Working Conditions**
Regular work in a manufacturing environment is expected, including time on the production floor. The position requires the ability to sit, stand, bend, squat, and walk throughout the facility and to occasionally lift, push, or pull up to 10 pounds. Up to 20% domestic and international travel may be required as business needs dictate.
  
  
**Safety Requirements**
All employees are required to follow the site EHS procedures and Coherent Corp. Corporate EHS standards.
  
  
**Quality And Environmental Responsibilities**
Depending on location, this position may be responsible for the execution and maintenance of the ISO 9000, 9001, 14001 and/or other applicable standards that may apply to the relevant roles and responsibilities within the Quality Management System and Environmental Management System.
  
  
**Culture Commitment**
Ensure adherence to company’s values (ICARE) in all aspects of your position at Coherent Corp.:

Panther is building the leading skin-powered treatment delivery and data platform for health and longevity. Panther’s AI-based platform accelerates partners’ product development and personalizes treatment, resulting in compelling consumer and provider experiences. Panther is targeting economically attractive markets of increasing clinical and regulatory difficulty, starting with its PIQUE™ branded Skincare products in mid-2027, and rapidly progressing to Medical Aesthetics and Therapeutics thereafter. Panther’s platform, significant IP portfolio and staged regulatory strategy provide a defensible moat. Panther is led by a team of successful entrepreneurs and operators and is advised by leading scientific experts.

Panther Life Sciences is building a new category of consumer-centric health and beauty products powered by our SmartPatch platform. As we move from development into commercialization, manufacturing becomes the critical unlock for scale, quality, and customer trust.
  
  
We are seeking a Director of Manufacturing Operations to own this transition end-to-end. This role is responsible for translating innovative R&D into reliable, high-quality, and scalable commercial production across both cosmetic and medical device products. You will define how manufacturing operates at Panther, from selecting and standing up partners, to leading technology transfer, to building the systems that allow us to scale from thousands to millions of units. Some travel will required approximately 10% -30%
